vaktavya
śrī 1008 vardhamāna vīra bhagavāna ke siddha hojāne ke lagabhaga 600 chaha sau varṣa bīta jāne para magadha vihāra meṃ bhayaṃkara durbhikṣa paḍa़ā aura jo mahāvratī nirmatha sādhu usa durbhikṣa ke saṃkaṭa se bacane ke liye subhikṣa deśa dakṣiṇa meṃ vihāra kara gaye, ve to apane aṭhāīsa mūla guṇoṃ ko śrī vīravāṇī ke anusāra nirdoṣa pālana karane meṃ samartha hue aura jo magadha meṃ hī raha gaye ve ati bhayaṃkara durbhikṣa kī māra na saha sake aura nigraṃtha se sagraṃtha ho gaye| unhoṃne śrīmahāvīra bhagavāna kā upadiṣṭa acelakatva ( digambarapanā choḍa diyā, vastra dhāraṇa kara liye tathā vītarāga jinavāṇī meṃ bhī māna kaṣāya vaśa kucha parivartana kara śāstroṃ ko vikṛta kara diyā| aise hī samaya meṃ ācārya kundakunda deva kā āvirbhāva huā aura unhoṃne apane jñāna aura tapake prabhāva se mahāvīra bhagavāna ke mūla upadiṣṭa dharmakā adhyayana kiyā, ṭakṣiṇa se utā lihāra kara digambara jaina dharmakā prasāra kiyā| usa samaya kī pracalita bhāṣā prākṛta meṃ aneka graṃthoṃkī racanā śrīmahāvīra bhagavāna kī divyadhvani anusāra kī|
samyagdarśana, samyagjñāna aura samyakcāritra ko dhāraṇa kara bhavyajana apanā kalyāṇa kara paramātmā bana sakeṃ isaliye samayaprāmṛta, paṃcāstikāya saṃgraha ( prābhṛta ) pravacanasāra ina tīna graṃthoṃkī pradhānatayā racanā kī tathā inake sahāyaka anya prābhṛtoṃ ( mokha pāhuḍa-mokṣa prābhṛta ādi) kī racanā kī|
sarvajña vītarāga ne jina tattvoṃkā varṇana kiyā hai unakā jñāna kara śraddhāna karanā samyagdarśana haiṃ| koī manuṣya jineṃdra vāṇīkā jñāna to kara le parantu usakā śraddhāna na kare, to koī kārya kī siddhi nahīṃ hotī, yahī kāraṇa hai ki-gyāraha aṃga nau pūrva taka jina vāṇī kā pāṭhī bhī saṃsāra meṃ hī rulatā rahatā hai aura 'tuṣa māṣa bhitra mātra alpa jñānakā śraddhānī saṃsāra se pāra ho jātā hai| isīliye tattvajñāna kī śraddhāna rūpa samyagdarśanakī prāpti ko sarvādhika mahattva diyā gayā hai|
sarvajña bhagavāna ke upadiṣṭa tattva kauna-kauna se haiṃ isakā jñāna karanā bhī āvaśyaka hai, kāraṇa tattvoṃkā jñāna binā kiye śraddhāna kisakā kare ? alpajña kaṣāyayukta vyaktiyoṃ ke upadiṣṭa asat padārthokā śraddhāna karalene se bhī ātmākā hita nahīṃ hotā, ācārya kundakunda devane isa paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta meṃ sarvajña vītarāga bhagavāna dvārā upadiṣṭa sāta tattva, nava padārtha, chaha dravya, pā~ca astikāya aura kāla dravyakā viśada varṇana kiyā hai|
isakā svādhyāya karanā sarvadhāraṇa ko sulabha ho jāya aura ācārya kā abhiprāya sahī sahī samajha meṃ ājāya isaliye do saṃskṛta ṭīkāe~ aura usakā hiṃdī śabdārtha isameṃ chapāyā gayā hai|
brahmacārī śrīlāla jaina kāvyatīrtha

śrīsarvajñavītarāgāya namaḥ śrīmadbhagavat-kundakundācāryadevapraṇīta
śrīpaṃcāstikāya prābhūta
śrīmad amṛtacandrasūri-viracita samayavyākhyā, tathā śrījayasenācāryakṛta tātparyavṛtti sahita do saṃskṛtaṭīkāyeṃ aura unakā hindī anuvāda
[1] ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāya varṇana śrīmadamṛtacandrasūriviracitā samayavyākhyā
sahajānandacaitanyaprakāśāya mahīyase |
namo'nekāntaviśrāntamahimne paramātmane ||1|| mūla gāthāoṃ kā tathā samayavyākhyā nāmaka ṭīkā kā
hindī anuvāda prathama hī śrīmadācārya amṛtacandradeva pāpa vināśaka sukha vidhāyaka maṃgalācaraṇa karate hue paramātmā ko namaskāra karate haiṃ
ślokārtha-jisameṃ sahaja-sadā sātha rahane vāle ānanda aura caitanya kā pūrṇa prakāśateja prakaṭa ho gayā hai, jo sabase mahān hai tathā anekānta meṃ sthita jisakī mahimā hai. usa paramātmā ko namaskāra ho | (1)

﻿________________

laga-vāhillāyavarṇana durnivāranayānīkavirodhadhvaṃsanauṣadhiḥ | syātkārajīvitā jīyājjainī siddhāntapaddhatiḥ ||2|| samyagjñānāmalajyotirjananī dvinayānayā | athātaḥ samayavyākhyā saṃkṣepeṇā'bhidhīyate ||3|| paṃcāstikāyaṣadravyaprakāreṇa prarūpaṇam | pūrva mūlapadārthānāmiha sūtrakṛttā kṛtam ||4|| jīvājīvadviparyāyarūpāṇāṃ citravarmanām | tato navapadārthānāṃ vyavasthā pratipāditā ||5|| tatastattvaparijñānapūrveṇa tritayātmanā | proktā mārgeṇa kalyāṇī mokṣaprāptirapaścimā ||6||
( aba ṭīkākāra ācāryadeva śloka dvārā jinavāṇī kī stuti karate haiṃ) ślokārtha-syātkāra jisakā jīvana hai, jo nayasamūha ke durnivāra virodha kā nāśa karane vālī auṣadhi hai aisī jainī ( jinabhagavāna kī ) siddhāntapaddhati jayavanta ho ! || 2 ||
( aba ṭīkākāra ācārya isa paṃcāstikāyaprābhṛta nāmaka śāstra kī ṭīkā racane kī pratijñā karate hai)
ślokārtha-aba yahā~ se, jo samyagjñānarūpī nirmala-jyotikī jananī hai aisī dvinayāśrita ( do nayoṃ kā āśraya karanevālī ) samayavyākhyā ( samayavyākhyā nāmaka ṭīkā ) saṃkṣepa se kahī jātī hai || 3||
(aba, tīna ślokoṃ dvārā ṭīkākāra ācāryadeva atyanta saṃkṣepa meṃ yaha batalāte haiṃ ki isa paṃcāssikāyaprābhṛta nāmaka śāstrameṃ kina-kina viṣayoṃ kā nirūpaṇa hai)
ślokārtha—yahā~ prathama sūtrakartā ne mūla padārthoṃ kā paṃcāstikāya evaṃ ṣaḍdravya ke prakāra se prarūpaṇa kiyā hai || 4 ||
ślokārtha—paścāt ( dūsare adhikāra meṃ ), jīva aura ajīva-ina do kī paryāyoṃrūpa nava padārthoṃ kī—ki jinake vartma arthāt kārya bhinna-bhinna prakāra ke haiṃ unakī-vyavasthā pratipādita kī hai || 5 ||
ślokārthapaścāt ( dūsare adhikārake antameṃ ), tattvake parijñāna pūrvaka ( paṃcāstikāya, ṣadravya tathā nava padārthoṃ ke yathārtha jñānapūrvaka ) trayātmaka mārga se ( samyagdarśanajñānacāritrātmaka mārga se ) kalyāṇasvarūpa uttama mokṣaprāpti kahī hai || 6 ||

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta śrījayasenācāryakṛtatātparyavṛttiḥ svasaṃvedanasiddhāya jināya paramātmane |
· śuddhajīvāstikāyāya nityānandacide namaḥ ||1|| atha śrīkumāranandisiddhāntadevaśiṣyaiḥ prasiddhakathānyāyena pūrvavidehaṃ gatvā vītarāgasarvajñaśrīmaṃdarasvāmotīrthakaraparamadevaṃ dṛṣṭvā tanmukhakamalavinirgatadivyavāṇīśravaṇāvadhāritapadārthācchuddhātmatattvādisārārtha gṛhītvā punarapyāgata: śrīmatkundakundācāryadevaiḥ padmananyāyaparābhidheyairantastattvabahistattvagauṇamukhyapratipattyartha, athavā śivakumāramahārājādisaṃkṣeparuciśiṣyapratibodhanārtha viracite pañcāstikāyaprābhṛtaśāstra yathākrameṇādhikāraśuddhipūrvakaṃ tātparyārthavyākhyānaṃ kathyate | __(upodghāta:) tadyathā-prathamatastāvat “iṃdasayavadiyāṇaṃ' ityādipāṭhakrameṇakādaśottaraśatagāthābhiḥ pañcāstikāyaṣadravyapratipādanarūpeṇa prathamo mahādhikāraḥ, athavā sa evāmṛtacandraṭīkābhiprāyeṇa tryadhikaśataparyantaśca | tadanantaraṃ "abhivaṃdiūṇa sirasā'' ityādi pañcāśadgāthābhiḥ saptatannanavapadārthavyākhyānarūpeṇa dvitīyo mahādhikāraḥ, atha sa evāmṛtacandraṭīkābhiprāyeṇāṣṭācattvāriśahāthāparyantaśca | athānantaraṃ jīvasvabhāvoṃ ityādi viṃśatigāthābhirmokṣamārgamokṣasvarūpakathanamukhyatvena tṛtīyo mahādhikāra iti samudāyenaikāśītyuttaraśatagāthābhirmahādhikāratrayaṃ jñātavyaṃ | tatra mahādhikāre pāṭhakrameṇāntarādhikārāḥ kathyante | tadyathā-ekādaśottaraśatagāthāmadhye "iṃdasaya'' ityādi gāthāmādikṛttvā gāthāsaptakaṃ sabhavyaśabdārthapīṭhikā vyākhyānamukhyatvena, tadanantaraṃ caturdaśagāthādravyapīṭhikā vyākhyānena, atha gāthāpañcakaṃ kāladravyamukhyatvena, tadanantaraṃ tripañcāśadgāthā jīvāstikāyakathanarūpeṇa, atha gāthādaśakaṃ pudgalāstikāyamukhyatvena, tadanantaraṃ gāthāsaptakaṃ dharmādharmāstikāyavyākhyānena. atha gāthāsaptakamākāśāstikāyakathanamukhyatvena, tadanantaraṃ gāthāṣṭakaṃ cūlikopasaṃhāravyākhyānamukhyatvana kathayatītyaṣṭabhirantarādhikāraiḥ pañcāstikāyaṣadravyaprarūpaṇaprathamamahādhikāre samudāyapātanikā | tatrā gantarādhikāreṣu madhye prathamata: saptagāthābhi: samayaśabdārthapīṭhikā kathyate nāsu saptagāthā madhya gāthādvayeneṣṭādhikṛtābhimatadevatānamaskāroṃ maṅgalārtha:, atha gāthātrayeṇa pañcāstikāyasaṃkṣepavyākhyānaṃ, tadanantaraṃ ekagāthayā kālasahitapañcāstikāyānāṃ dravyasaṃjñā, punarekagāthayā saṃkaravyatikaradoṣaparihāramiti samayaśabdārthapīṭhikāyāṃ sthalatrayeṇa samudāyapātanikā ||
tātparyavṛtti ke hindī anuvādaka kā maṃgalācaraṇa vaṃdoṃ vīra mahāprabhu, sanmati sukha dātāra | varddhamāna ativīrako, mahāvīra guṇa dhāra ||1|| vṛṣabha ādi teīsa jina, bharata tīrtha kartāra | tinake vaṃdoṃ yuga caraṇa, pāvana parama udāra || 2|| sarva siddha sukhakāra haiṃ, svātama tatva maṃjhāra | sudhā-siṃdhumeṃ nita magana, vandoṃ bārambāra ||3|| ācāraja uvajhāya muni, saṃgarahita śama dhāra | kṣamā ādi dhāraka satata, nija guṇa magana apāra || 4|| kundakunda munirājake, caraṇa dhyāna dātāra | samayasārameṃ rati kareṃ, sumaroṃ sumati pracāra ||5||

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana prākṛta gāthāmeṃ racyo,grantha kāya paṃcāsti | jayasenācāraja kiyo, saṃskṛtavṛti praśasti ||6|| bālabodha bhāṣā nahīṃ, marma na samajho jāya | tāteṃ udyama hama kiyā, jina caraṇāmbuja dhyāya ||7||
bhāvārtha-apane svānubhava ke dvārā siddhako prāpta, karma vijayī, śuddha jīvamayī va nitya ānaṃdako bhāganevāle paramātmāko maiṃ namaskāra karatā hū~|
utthānikā-yaha kathā prasiddha hai ki śrī kumāranandi siddhāntadevake śiṣya śrīmat kundakundācārya deva jinake padmanandi ādi ( ailācārya, vanagrīva, gṛddhapiccha ) nāma bhī prasiddha haiṃ, pūrvavidehameṃ gae| vahā~ vītarāga sarvajña śrīmaṃdarasvāmī tīrthakara paramadevake darśana kiye tathā unake mukhakamalase pragaṭa divyavāṇīko suna karake va usase padārthoṃ ko samajhakara śuddha ātmīkatattva sāra artha grahaṇa kiyā phira lauṭakara unhoṃne aṃtaraṃgatattva bahiraṃgatattvako gauṇa yā mukhyapane pratyāre liyayā śivakumāra mahārājako ādi lekara saṃkṣepa rucike dhāraka śiṣyoṃko samajhāneke liye isa paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta śāstrako racā| isī anthakā tātparya artharūpa vyākhyāna yathākramase adhikāroṃ kī śuddhike sātha kiyā jātā hai
___ upodghāta-pahale hī "iṃdasayavaṃdiyāṇaṃ" ityādi pāṭhake kramase 111 gāthāoṃ se paṃcāstikāya chaḥ dravyako kahate hue prathama mahā adhikāra hai athavā yahī adhikāra śrī amṛta candrakī ṭīkāke abhiprāyase eka sau tīna ( 103) gāthā paryaṃta hai| isake pīche "abhivaṃdiūṇa sirasā" ityādi pacāsa (50) gāthāoṃse sāta tattva,nava padārthake vyākhyāna rūpase dūsarā mahā adhikāra hai athavā yahī śrī amṛcandrakī ṭīkāke abhiprāyase 48 gāthā paryaṃta hī hai| isake pīche "jīvasvabhāvo" ityādi bīsa gāthāoṃse mokṣamārga va mokṣakā svarūpa kahanekī mukhyatāse tīsarā mahādhikāra hai| isa taraha samudāsase eka sau ikyāsī gāthāoṃ ke dvārā tīna mahā adhikāra jānane cāhiye| aba isa prathama mahā adhikārameṃ pāṭhake kramase aṃtara adhikāra kahe jāte haiṃ | eka sau gyāraha gāthāoṃ ke madhyameṃ "iṃdasaya" ityādi gāthā sāta taka samaya śabdakā artha pīṭhikāke vyākhyānakī mukhyatā se hai phira caudaha gāthāoṃmeṃ dravyoṃ kā svarūpa pīṭhikāke vyākhyāna dvārā kiyā hai | phira pā~ca gāthā kāladravyako mukhyatāse haiṃ | pīche trepana gāthāeṃ jīvāstikāyakā kathana karatī haiṃ | phira dasa gāthāoṃmeṃ pudgalāstikāyakī mukhyatā hai | paścāt sāta gāthāeṃ dharma adharma astikāyake kathanakī vyākhyānarūpase haiṃ, phira sāta gāthāe~ ākāśa astikāyake kathanīkī mukhyatāse haiṃ | paścāt āṭha gāthāe~ cūlikārūpa saṃkṣepa vyākhyānakī mukhyatāse kahī haiṃ| isa taraha āṭha aṃtara adhikāroṃse paṃcāstikāya chaḥ dravyako kahate hue prathama mahā adhikārameṃ samudāya pātanikā huī|

antātītaguṇebhyo namo jinebhyo jitabhavebhyaḥ ||1|| anādinā saṃtānena pravartamānā anādinaiva saṃtānena pravarttamānairindrāṇāṃ śatairvanditā ye ityanena sarvadaiva devādhidevatvātteṣāmevāsādhāraṇanamaskārārhatvamuktam | tribhuvanamūrdhvādhomadhyalokavartī samasta eva jīvalokastasmai niābādhaviśuddhātmatattvopalambhopāyābhidhāyitvāddhitaṃ, paramārtharasikajanamanohāritvānmadhuraṃ, nirastasamastaśaṃkādidoṣāspadatvādviśadaṃ vākyaṃ divyo dhvaniryeṣāmityanena samastavastuyāthātmyopadeśitvāt prekṣāvatpratīkṣyatvamākhyātam | antamatīta: kṣetrānavacchinnaḥ kālānavacchinnaśca paramacaitanyaśaktivilāsalakṣaṇo guṇo yeṣāmityanena tu paramādbhutajñānātiśayaprakāśanādavāptajñānātiśayānāmapi yogīndrāṇāṃ vandyatvamuditam | jito bhava ājabaṃjavo yairityanena tu kṛtakṛtyatvaprakaṭanātta evānyeṣāmakṛtakṛtyānāṃ śaraṇamityupadiṣṭam | iti sarvapadānāṃ tātparyam ||1|| ___ aba ina āṭha aṃtara adhikāroṃmeṃ se pahale hī sāta gāthāoṃse samaya śabdake arthakī pīṭhikā kahate haiṃ | ina sāta gāthāoṃ se do gāthāoṃmeṃ iṣṭa va mānya va adhikāraprāpta devatā ko namaskārarūpa maṃgalācaraṇa hai| phira tīna gāthāoṃse paṃcāstikāyakā saṃkṣepa vyākhyāna hai| phira eka māthāse kāla sahita paṃcāstikāyoṃko dravyasaṃjñā hai| phira eka gāthāse saṃkara vyatikara doṣakā tyāga hai| isa taraha samaya śabdārthakī pīṭhikāmeṃ tīna sthalake dvārā samudāyapātanikā kahī hai|
gāthā-1 ___ anvayārtha—( indraśatavanditebhyaḥ ) jo sau indroṃ se vandita hai, ( tribhuvana-hitamadhuraviśadavākyabhyaḥ ) tīna loka ko hitakara, madhukara evaṃ viśada ( nirmala, spaṣṭa ) jinako vāṇī hai. 6
ṣaḍdravya - paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
samayī kānuvāda- yahā~ ( isa gāthā meṃ ) "jinoṃ ko namaskāra ho" aisā kahakara śāstrake ādi meṃ jinako bhāvanamaskārarūpa asādhāraṇa maṃgala kahā hai| "jo anādi pravāha se pravartate [ cale ārahe ] haye anādi pravāha se hī pravartamāna ( cale ā rahe ! sau indroṃ se vandita haiṃ- aisā kahakara sadaiva devādhidevapane ke kāraṇa ve hī [ jinadeva hī ] asādhāraṇa namaskāra ke yogya haiṃ- aisā kahā| jinakī vāṇī arthāt divyadhvani tīna loka ko ūrdhva adho-madhya lokavartī samasta jīvasamūhako viśuddha ātmatattva kī upalabdhi kā upāya kahanevālī hone se hitakara hai, paramārtharasika janoṃ ke manako haranevālī hone se madhura hai aura samasta śaṃkādi doṣoṃ ke sthāna dūra kara dene se viśada [ nirmala, spaṣṭa ] hai" – aisā kahakara [ jinadeva ] samasta vastuke yathārthasvarūpa ke upadeśaka hone se vicāravaṃta buddhimāna puruṣoṃke bahumānake yogya haiṃ [ arthāt jinakā upadeśa vicāravaṃta buddhimāna puruṣoṃ ko bahumānapūrvaka vicāranā cāhiye aise haiṃ ] aisā kahā | ananta - kṣetra se aṃta rahita aura kāla se aṃta rahita paramacaitanyaśaktike vilāsasvarūpa guṇa jinake vartate haiṃ aisā kahakara [ jinoṃ ko ] parama adbhuta jñānātiśaya pragaṭa hone ke kāraṇa jñānātiśaya ko prāpta yogīndroṃ se bhī baṃdha haiṃ aisā kahā | 'bhava arthāt saṃsāra para jinhoṃne vijaya prāpta kī hai" aisā kahakara kṛtakṛtyapanā pragaṭa ho jāne se ve hī ( jina hī ) anya akṛtakṛtya jīvoṃko śaraṇabhūta haiṃ, aisā upadeśa diyā aisā sarva padoṃ kā tātparya hai |
tātparyavṛttiḥ
-
atha prathamata indraśatavanditebhya ityādinā jinabhāvanamaskārarūpamasādhāraṇaṃ śāstrasyādauṃ maṃgalaṃ kathayāmītyabhiprāyaṃ manasi dhṛtvā sūtramidaṃ pratipādayati, " ṇamo jiṇāṇa' mityādipadakhaṇḍanarūpeṇa vyākhyānaṃ kriyate, ṇamo jiṇāṇaṃ namaḥ namaskāro'stu | kebhyaḥ ? jinebhyaḥ | kathaṃbhūtebhyaḥ ? • iṃdasayavaṃdiyāṇaṃ- indraśatavanditebhyaḥ | punarapi kathaṃbhūtebhyaḥ ? tihuvaṇahidamahurabisadavakkāṇaṃtribhuvanahitamadhuraviśadavākyebhyaḥ | punarapi kiṃ viśiṣṭebhyaḥ | aṃtātīdaguṇāṇaṃ- antātītaguṇebhyaḥ | punarapi kiṃ viśiṣṭebhyaḥ ? jidabhavāṇaṃ- jitabhavebhyaḥ iti kriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ | indraśatavanditebhyaḥ tribhuvanahitamadhuraviśadavākyebhyaḥ antātītaguṇebhyo namo jinebhyo jitabhavebhyaḥ | “padayorvivakṣitaḥ saṃdhirna samāsāntaragatayo" riti paribhāṣāsūtrabalena vivakṣitasya saṃdhirbhavatīti vacanātprāthamika śiṣyapratisukhabodhārthamatra bhanthe saṃdherniyamo nāstīti sarvatra jñātavyaṃ | evaṃ viśeṣaṇacatuṣṭayayuktebhyo jinebhyo namaḥ ityanena maṃgalārthamanantajñānādiguṇasmaraṇarūpo bhāvanamaskāro stviti saṃgrahavākyaṃ | athaiva kathyate - indraśatairvanditā indraśatavanditāstebhya ityanena pūjātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ | kimuktaṃ bhavati — ta evendraśatanamaskārārhā nānye ? teṣāṃ devāsurādiyuddhadarśanāt | tribhuva nāya śuddhātmasvarūpaprāptyupāyapratipādakatvāddhitaṃ vītarāganirvikalpasamādhisaṃjātasahajāpūrvaparamā
nandarūpapāramārthikasukharasāsvādaparamasamarasībhāvarasikajanamanohāritvānmadhuraṃ calitapratipattigacchattṛṇasparśaśuktikārajatavijñānarūpasaṃśayavimohavibhramarahitatvena śuddhajīvāstikāyādisaptatattvanavapadārtha

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta dravyapañcāstikāyapratipādakatvāt athavā pūrvāparavirodhādidoṣarahitatvāt athavā karṇāṭamāgadhamālavalāṭagauḍagurjarapratyekaṃ trayamityaṣṭādaśamahābhāṣāsaptaśatakṣullakabhāṣātadanta dagatabahubhāṣārūpeṇa yugapatsarvajīvānāṃ svakīyasvakīyabhāṣāyāḥ spaṣṭārthapratipādakatvātpratipattikārakatvāt sarvajīvānāṃ jñāpakatvāt viśadaṃ spaṣṭa vyaktaṃ vākyaṃ divyadhvaniryeṣāṃ tribhuvanahitamadhuraviśadavākyāstebhyaḥ | tathā coktaṃ-“yatsarvātmahitaṃ na varṇasahitaṃ na spanditoṣṭhadvayaṃ, no vāṃchākalitaṃ na doṣamalinaṃ nocchavāsaruddhakramaṃ | śāntāmarṣaviṣaiḥ samaṃ paśugaṇairākarṇitaṃ karṇibhistanna: sarvavido vinaṣṭavipada: pāyādapūrvaṃ vacaḥ ||1||" ityanena vacanātiśayapratipādanena tadvacanameva pramāṇaṃ na caikāntenāpauruṣeyavacanaṃ na citrakathākalpitapurāṇavacanaṃ cetītyuktaṃ bhavati | antātītadravyakṣetrakālabhāvaparicchedakatvādantātītaṃ kevalajñānaguṇaḥ sa vidyate yeṣāṃ te'ntātītaguṇāstebhya ityenana jñānātiśayapratipādanena buddhyādisaptarddhimatijñānādicaturvidhajñānasaṃpannānāmapi gaṇadharadevādiyogīndrāṇāṃ vaṃdyāste bhavantītyuktaṃ | jito bhavaḥ pañcaprakārasaṃsāra ājavaṃjavo yaisle jitabhavāstebhya ityanena ghānika pāyātiśayapratipādanena kṛtakṛtyatvaprakaṭanādanyeṣāmakṛtakṛtyānāṃ ta eva śaraṇaṃ nānya iti pratipāditaṃ bhavati| evaṃ viśeṣaṇacatuṣṭayayuktebhyo namaḥ, ityanena maṃgalārthamantajñānādiguṇasmaṇarūpo bhāvanamaskāra: kṛtaḥ | idaṃ viśeṣaṇacatuṣṭayaṃ anekabhavagahanaviṣayavyasanāprāpaṇahetūn karmārātīn jayatīti jinaḥ iti vyutpattipakṣe śvetaśaṃkhavatsvarūpakathanārthaṃ, avyutpattipakṣe nāmajinavyavacchedanārthaṃ | evaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇasaṃbandharūpeṇa śabdārtha: kathitaḥ | anantajñānādiguṇasmaraṇarūpabhāvanamaskāro'śuddhaniścayanayena, namo jinebhya iti vacanātmakadravyanamaskāropyasadbhūtavyavahāranayena, śuniścayanayena svasminnevārādhyārādhakabhāva iti nayārthopyuktaḥ | ta eva namaskārārhā nānye cetyādirūpeṇa matārthopyuktaḥ | indraśatavanditā ityāgamārthaḥ prasiddha eva | anantajñānādiguṇayuktaśuddhajīvāstikāya evopādeya iti bhāvārthaḥ | anena prakāreṇa śabdanayamatāgamabhāvārthaḥ sūcitaḥ anena prakāreṇa śabdanayamatāgamabhāvārtha vyākhyānakāle sarvatra yojanīyamiti saṃkṣepeṇa maṃgalārthamiṣṭadevatānamaskāraḥ kṛtaḥ | maṃgalamupalakṣaṇaṃ nimittahetuparimāṇānāmakartṛrūpāḥ paścādhikārāḥ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vaktavyāḥ | idānīṃ punarvistararuciśiṣyāṇāṃ vyavahāranayamāśritya yathākrameṇa maṃgalādiṣaḍa़dhikārāṇāmiyattā parimitaviśeṣaṇavyākhyānaṃ kriyate
"maṃgala-ṇimitta-heū parimāṇā ṇāma taha ya kattāraṃ |
ghāgariya chappi pacchā vakkhāṇau satya-māirio ||2||" "vakkhāṇau-vyākhyātu | sa kaḥ kartā | āirio-ācāryaḥ | kiṃ | satthaṃ-śāstraṃ | pacchā-paścāt | kiṃkṛtvā pūrvaṃ | vāgariya-vyākṛtya vyākhyāya | kān | chappi-ṣaḍapi maṃgalaṇimittaheū parimāṇā ṇāma taha ya kattāraṃ-maṃgalanimittahetuparimāṇanāmakartṛtvādhikārāṇīti | tadyathā-malaṃ pāpaṃ gālayatti vidhvaṃsayatīti maṃgalaṃ, athavā maṃgaṃ puṇyaṃ sukhaṃ tallāti ādate gṛhṇāti vā maṃgalaṃ | catuṣṭayaphalaṃ samīkṣyamāṇā granthakārā: śāstrasyādau tridhā devatāyāstredhā namaskāraṃ kurvanti maṃgalārtha || "nāstikyaparihārastu śiṣṭācāraprapālanam | puṇyāvāptiśca nirvighnaṃ śāstrādau tena saṃstutiḥ ||3||"

śāstrādau śāstrakārāḥ maṃgalārtha parameṣṭhiguṇastrotraṃ kurvanti yadeva śāstraṃ prārabdhaṃ tadeva kathyatāṃ maṃgalamaprastutaṃ | na ca vaktavyaṃ, maṃgalanamaskāreṇa puṇyaṃ bhavati puṇyena nirvighnaṃ tadayuktaṃ, pūrvācāryā iṣṭadevatānamaskārapurassarameva kārya kurvanti, yaduktaṃ bhavatā-namaskāre kṛte puṇyaṃ bhavati puṇyena nirvighnaṃ bhavati iti na ca vaktavyaṃ tadapyuktaṃ | kasmāt ? devatānamaskārakaraṇe puṇyaṃ bhavati tena nirvighnaṃ bhavatīti tarkādiśāstre suvyavasthāpitatvāt | punaśca yaduktaṃ tvayā vyabhicāro dṛśyate tadapyayuktaṃ | kasmāditi cet ? yatra paṃcāstikāya prāmṛta tathācottaṃ-"śeyomārgasya saṃsiddhiḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ| ityāhustadguṇastotra śāstrādau munipuṃvagavāḥ ||17||" "abhimataphalasiddherabhyupāya: subodhaḥ, sa ca bhavati suśāstrāttasya cotpattirāptāt | iti bhavati sa pūjyastatprasādātprabuddhairna hi kṛtamupakāraṃ sādhavo vismaranti ||18||" iti saṃśega maṃgalaṃ vyākhyāsam |
nimittaṃ kathyate-nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ vītarāgasarvajñadivyadhvaniśāstre pravṛtte kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ? bhavyapuṇyapreraṇāt | tathā coktaṃ "chadavvaṇavapayatthe suyaṇāṇāiccadivbateeṇa| passaṃtu bhavyajīvā iya suaraviṇo have udao||19||" atha prābhṛtagraṃthe śivakumāramahārājo nimittaṃ anyatra dravyasaṃgrahādau momāśreṣṭhyādi jñātavyaṃ | iti saṃkṣepeṇa nimittaṃ kathitaṃ | idānīṃ hetuvyākhyānaṃ | hetuḥ phalaṃ, hetuśabdena phalaṃ kathaṃ bhaṇyata iti cet, phalakāraṇātphalamupacārāt| tacca phalaṃ dvividhaṃ pratyajñaparokṣabhedāt | pratyakṣaphalaṃ dvividhaṃ sākṣātparaṃparābhedena | sākṣātpratyakṣaṃ kiṃ ? ajñānavicchitti:
jñānotpattyāsaṃkhyātaguṇaśroṇikarmanirjarā ityādi| paraṃparāpratyakṣaṃ kiṃ ? śiṣyapratiśiṣyapūjāpraśaṃsāśiṣyaniṣpatyādi | iti saṃkṣepeṇa pratyajñaphalaṃ| iṃdānī parokṣaphalaṃ bhaṇyate| tacca dvividha-abhyudayaniśreyasasukhabhedāt | abhyudayasukhaṃ kathyate | rājādhirāja, mahārāja, arthamaṃḍalīka, maṃḍalīka, mahāmaṃḍalīka, ardhacakravarti, sakalacakravarti, indra, gaṇadhara deva, tīrthakara-paramadeva kalyāṇatraya paryatamiti| rājādilakṣaṇaṃ kathyate-koṭi prākāri aṣṭādaśaśreṇīnāṃ patiḥ sa eva mukuṭadharaḥ kathyate mukuṭabaddhapaṃcaśatādhipatiradhirājā, tasmād dviguṇadviguṇakrameṇa sakalacakriparyanta iti abhyudayasukhaṃ | atha niśreyasasukhaṃ kathyate-arhatapadaṃ kathyate “khavidaghaṇāghāikammā cautīsātisayā paṃcakallāṇā | aṭṭha mahāpāḍiherā arahaṃtā maṃgalaṃ majjhaṃ ||20|| siddhapadaṃ kathyate "mūluttarapayaḍīṇaṃ vaṃdhodayasattakammaummukkā| maṃgalabhūdā siddhā aṭṭhaguṇātīdasaṃsārā ||21|| iti saṃkṣepeṇa abhyudayaniśreyasasukhaṃ kathitaṃ | idamatra tātparya yaḥ kopi vītarāgasarvajñapraṇītapaṃcāstikāyasaṃgrahādikaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhati śraddhatte tathaiva ca bhāvayati sa ca itthaṃbhūtaṃ sukhaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | idānī parimāṇaṃ pratipādyate | tacca dvividha-graṃthārthabhedāt | granthaparimāṇaṃ granthaparisaṃkhyā yathāsaṃbhavaṃ, arthaparimāṇamanantamiti nāma dvidhā anvarthayadṛcchabhedena | anvarthanāma kiṃ ? yādṛśaṃ nāma tādṛśorthaḥ yathā tapatīti tapana āditya ityarthaḥ, atha ca paṃcāstikāyā yasmin śāstre granthe sa bhavati, paṃcāstikāyaḥ, dravyāṇāṃ saṃgraho dravyasaṃgraha ityādi| yadṛcchaṃ kāṣṭhābhāreṇeśvara ityādi | kartā kathyate sa ca tridhā | mūlatantrakartā uttaratantrakartā uttarottaratantrakartābhedeneti | mūlakartā kālāpekṣayā śrīvardhamānasvāmī aṣṭādaśadoṣarahito'nantacatuṣṭayasaṃpanna iti, uttara kartā śrīgautamasvāmī gaṇadharadevaścatunidharaḥ saptarddhisaṃpannaśśa, uttarottarā kāro bahavo yathāsaṃbhavaṃ | kartā kimarthaṃ kathyate ? kartṛprāmāṇyādvacanapramāṇamiti jñāpanārtha | iti saṃkṣepeṇa maṃgalāghadhikāraṣaṭkaṃ pratipāditaṃ vyākhyātaṃ evaṃ maṃgalārthamiṣṭadevatānamaskāragāthā gatā ||1||

ṣaḍdravya - paṃcāstikāyavarṇana hindī tātparyavṛtti
āge prathama hī śāstrakī ādimeṃ “indraśatavanditebhyaḥ" ityādi jinendrako bhāva namaskāra rūpa asādhāraṇa maṃgala kahū~gā aisā abhiprāya manameṃ dharakara ācārya prathama sūtra kahate haiṃ---
10
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha - ( iṃdasadabaṃdiyāṇaṃ ) sau indroṃse vandanīka, ( tihuaṇa-hidamadhura - visada-vakkāṇaṃ) tīna jagatako hitakārī madhura aura spaṣṭa vacana kahane vāle, ( aṃtātīda- guṇāṇaṃ) anaṃtaguṇoṃke dhārī tathā (jidabhavāṇaṃ) saṃsārako jītanevāle ( jiṇāṇaṃ ) arahaṃtoṃko ( ṇamo ) namaskāra ho |
viśeṣārtha - yahā~ ke liye ko namaskāra kiyā gayā hai | arahaṃtoṃke anantajñāna ādi guṇoṃkā smaraṇa rūpa bhāva namaskāra kahalātā hai| sau indroṃne arahaṃtoṃko namaskāra kiyā - aisā kahanese arahaṃtake pūjyapane ke māhātmyako pragaṭa kiyā gayā hai tathā yaha batāyā hai ki sau indroṃse namaskāra karaneke yogya ye hī arahaṃta deva haiṃ aura nahīṃ| śrī arahaṃtake vacana śuddhātmāke svarūpakī prāptikā upāya dikhalāne ke kāraṇase hita rūpa haiṃ, vītarāga aura vikalparahita samādhise utpanna jo svābhāvika apūrva parama ānanda vahī hai niścaya sukha usake rasakā svāda vahī hai parama samatārasamaī bhāva, usake rasika jo manuṣya haiṃ unake manako mohita karane vāle haiṃ, aura ve spaṣṭa tathā vyakta haiṃ, kyoṃki una vacanoṃmeṃ saṃśaya-vimoha-vibhrama nahīṃ hai| yahī sīpa hai yā cā~dī hai, aise caṃcala jñānako saṃśaya kahate haiṃ| pagameṃ tṛṇoṃkā sparśa hote hue kucha hogā aise niścaya karane kī icchā na rakhanevāle bhāvako vimoha kahate haiṃ| sīpako cā~dī jāna lenā so vibhrama hai tathā ve vacana isaliye bhī spaṣṭa haiṃ, kyoṃki śuddha jīvāstikāyako ādi lekara sāta tattva, nava padārtha, chaḥ dravya aura pā~ca astikāyakā svarūpa batānevāle haiṃ athavā una vacanoṃ meṃ pūrvāpara virodha nahīṃ hai isase bhī spaṣṭa hai | athavā arahaṃtoṃ kī usa divyadhvaniko sarva jīva apanī apanī bhāṣā meṃ sunakara usase spaṣṭa samajha jāte haiṃ| karṇāṭaka, māgadha, mālavā, lāṭa, gauḍa aura gurjarainameṃ pratyekake tīna bheda, aisī 18 mahābhāṣā aura sātasau choṭī bhāṣāko ādi lekara aneka bhāṣāoṃmeṃ vaha vāṇī eka hī samayameṃ saboṃko sunāī detī hai, isase bhī vaha viśada hai |
arahaṃtakī vāṇīke sambandhameṃ aisā anya granthameṃ kahā hai
sarva āpattiyoṃse rahita śrīsarvajña bhagavānakā vaha apūrva vacana hamārī rakṣā kare jo sarva ātmāoṃkā hitakārī hai akṣara rūpa nahīṃ hai, donoṃ oṭhoṃke halana binā pragaṭa hotā hai, icchā rahita hotā hai, doṣoṃse malīna nahīṃ hai, na usameṃ śvāsocchvāsake rukanekā krama hai,

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta jisako krodhasamā viṣa ko śāṃta kie hue paśugaṇa bhī apane kānoṃse suna sakate haiṃ ||1|| isa taraha vacanake māhātmya dvārā pragaṭa jo arahaṃtakā vacana vahī pramāṇa hai| ekāṃta karake apauruṣeya vacana jo kisī puruṣakā na kahā huā ho aura na nānā kathāoṃse racita purāṇavacana pramāṇabhūta hai|
bhāvārtha-vacana vahī pramāṇabhūta hai jo anekāṃta yā syādvāda dvārā varṇana kare va jo kisī sarvajña puruṣakī paramparāse kahā huā ho | jina arahaṃtoṃ ke ananta dravya, kṣetra, kāla, bhāvako jāna lene se anaṃtakevalajñāna ādi guṇa pāe jāte haiṃ, aisā kahanese yaha batāyā hai ki ve arahaṃta una gaṇadhara devako ādi lekara yogīśvaroṃ se bhī namaskāra yogya hai, jo buddhi ādi sāta ṛddhi va matijñāna ādi cāra jñānake dhārī haiṃ tathā jina arahaṃtoṃne dravya, kṣetra, kāla, bhava, bhāvarūpa paṃca parāvartanarūpa saṃsārako jīta liyā hai| aisā kahanese yaha batāyā hai ki unhoṃne yātiyā koṃka nāśake māhātmyase kṛtakṛtyapanā apane meṃ pragaṭa kara liyā hai| isīse jo kṛtakṛtya nahīṃ haiṃ aise jo alpajñānī saṃsārī jīva unake liye ve arahaṃta hī śaraṇarūpa haiṃ aura koī nahīṃ| isa taraha cāra viśeṣaṇoṃ sahita śrī jinendroṃ ko namaskāra kiyā hai| isa taraha maṃgalake liye anantajñāna ādi guṇoṃkā smaraṇarūpa bhāva namaskāra kiyā gayā | jo aneka bhavarūpī vana aura indriya viṣaya va āpattimeṃ ḍālaneke kāraṇa karmarūpī śatru haiṃ unako jītanevālā hai vaha jina hai, usīke ye cāra viśeṣaṇa isī nyāyase kiye gaye haiṃ | jaise yaha kahanā ki śaṃkha śvetta hai | kevala śaṃkha kahanese bhī usakī saphedīkā bodha hotā jātā hai vaise kebala jina śabdako vyutpatti se hī unake anantaguṇoṃ kā bodha hojātā hai, to bhī viśeṣatā batāneke liye tathā nāma mātra jina kahalānevāleko namaskāra nahīṃ kiyā gayā hai aisā batāneke lie viśeṣaṇa diye haiṃ| aisā bhāva viśeṣaṇa va viśeṣyakā jānanā cāhiye| isa taraha śabdārtha kahā gayā|
anantajñānādi guṇoṃkā smaraṇarūpa bhāva namaskāra aśuddha niścaya nayase jānanā "namo jinebhyaḥ' aisā vacanarūpa dravya namaskāra hai so asadbhūta vyavahāranayase jānanā tathā śuddha niścaya nayase apane ātmāmeṃ hī ārādhya aura ārādhakabhāva samajhanā ki yaha ātmā hī ārādhanake yogya va vahī ārādhanevālā hai aisā abhedabhāva rūpa honā | isa taraha nayoṃke dvārā artha kahā gayā | ye hī arahaṃta deva namaskārake yogya haiṃ anya koī rāgī dveṣī alpajña nahīṃ, aisā kahanese jinamatakā artha bhī jhalakāyā gayā| sau indroṃse vandanīka haiṃ aisā kahanese paraṃparā āgamakā artha prasiddha kiyā gayā tathā isa maṃgalācaraṇakā bhāvārtha yaha hai ki anantajñānādiguṇoṃse yukta śuddha jīvāstikāya hī grahaṇa karane yogya hai| isa taraha śabdārtha, nayārtha, matārtha, āgamārtha aura bhāvārtha jānanā cāhiye | isī taraha jahā~ kahīṃ

12
dravya - paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
vyākhyāna ho vahā~ sarva ṭhikāne śabda, naya, mata āgama tathā bhāva ina pā~coṃke artha lagānā cāhiye | isa taraha saṃkṣepameṃ maṃgalake liye iṣṭadevatāko namaskāra kiyā gayā, maṃgala yaha upalakṣaṇapada hai jahā~ maṅgala kiyā jāve usake sātha pā~ca bāteṃ yathāsaṃbhava aura bhī kahanī cāhiye arthāt grantha kā nimitta, hetu, parimāṇa, nāma aura karttā |
aba yahāṃ para vistāra rucise sunanevāle śiṣyoṃke liye vyavahāranaya ke āśrayako lekara yathākrama maṅgala ādi chaḥ adhikāroṃ kā viśeṣa vyākhyāna kiyā jātā hai| yaha ārṣa vākya hai
ācārya mahārāja anyakartā pahale maṅgala, nimitta, hetu, parimāṇa, nāma aura karttā-ina chaḥ ko kahakara phira śāstrakā vyākhyāna kare | 2| sohī āge dikhāte haiṃ
(1) maṃ arthāt mala yā pāpako jo gālayati arthāt galāve so maṅgala hai athavā maṃga jo puṇya tathā sukha use jo lāti arthāt deve vaha maṅgala hai | granthakāra śāstrakī ādimeṃ maṅgalake liye cāra prakāra phalako cāhate hue tīna prakāra devatākā tīna prakāra namaskāra karate haiṃ| cāra prakāra phalake liye kahā hai
bhāvārtha- nāstikapaneke tyāgake liye arthāt pranthakartā āstika hai yaha batāneke liye, śiṣṭācāra jo paraṃparāse calā āyā vinayakā niyama usako pālanake liye, puṇyakī prāptike liye tathā vighnake dūra karane ke liye ina cāra bātoṃko cāhate hue granthake ādimeṃ iṣṭadevakī stuti kī jātī hai | 3| tīna prakāra devatākā bhāva yaha hai, ki jisako namaskāra kiyā jāve vaha apaneko iṣṭa arthāt priya ho, adhikṛta ho arthāt jisakā yahā~ adhikāra ho tathā abhimata ho arthāt jo mānanīya ho | namaskāra bhī tīna prakāra hai- eka āśīrvādarūpa, dūsare vastusvarūpa kathanarūpa, tīsare namaskārarūpa | yaha maṅgala do prakārakā hai - eka mukhya, dūsarā gauṇa mukhya maṃgala jinendra- guṇa stavana hai | jaisā kahā hai
bhāvārtha- buddhimānoṃne kahā hai ki ādi madhyama tathā antameṃ maṅgala karanā cāhiye jisase vighnoṃkā nāśa ho| vaha maṃgala śrī jinendrake guṇoṃkā stotra hai ||4|| aura bhī kahā hai
bhāvārtha - śrī jinendroṃkā guṇagāna karanese vighnoṃkā nāśa hotā hai, kabhī bhaya nahīṃ lagatā hai, na nīca deva ullaṃghana karate haiṃ tathā apane icchita padārthokā sadā lābha hotā hai || 5 || aura bhī kahā hai

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta bhāvārtha--ādimeṃ maṃgala karanese śiṣya vidyāke pāragāmī hote haiṃ, madhyameṃ maṃgala karanese vidyā binā vighnake ātī hai va aṃtameṃ maṃgala karanese vidhākā phala prāpta hotā hai ||6||
āge gauṇa maṃgalako kahate haiṃ
bhāvārtha-siddhārtha, pūrṇakumbha, vaṃdanamālā, śvetachatra, śvetavarṇa, ādarśa yā darpaṇa, nātha (rājā), kanyā aura jayapanā ||7|| jina jinavaroṃne vrataniyama saṃyamādi guṇoṃke dvārā paramārtha sādhana kiyā hai aura jinakī siddha saṃjñā hai isaliye ve siddhārtha maṃgala haiṃ||8|| jo sarva manorathoṃse aura kevalajñānase pūrṇa haiṃ aise arahaṃta isa lokameṃ pūrṇakumbha maṃgala haiṃ ||9|| bharata cakrīkṛta vaṃdanamālāmeṃ kisī dvārase nikalate yā praveśa hote jo caubīsa tīrthakara vaṃdanīka ho jāte haiṃ isaliye vaṃdana-mālāko maṃgala kahā hai ||10|| jagake prāṇiyoṃke liye arahaṃta bhagavāna sugamya kartā haiṃ inake samāna rakṣaka haiṃ isaliye śvetachatrako kahā hai ||11|| jina arahaṃtoṃke śvetavarṇa śukladhyāna hai va śuklaleśyā hai aura jinake cāra adhātiyā karma śeṣa haiṃ aise arahaṃtoṃko śveta varṇa maṃgala kahā hai ||12|| jaise darpaṇameṃ pratibiṃba jhalakatā hai vaise jina jinendroṃ ke kevalajñānameṃ loka aloka dikhatā hai isaliye ādarśa maṃgala hai ||13|| jaise vītarāga sarvajña jinendra maṃgalarūpa haiṃ vaise jagat meṃ rājā aura bālakanyāko bhī maṃgala jānanā cāhiye ||14|| jinhoṃne karma śatruoṃko jītakara mokṣa prāpta kara liyā hai- aise cāroṃ dhātiyārūpī śatruke dalako jītanese jayarūpa maṃgala hai ||15||
athavā maṃgala do prakāra hai-eka nibaddha maṃgala, dūsarā anibaddha maṃgala | jo maṃgala usa hī granthakārane kiyā ho vaha nibaddha maṃgala hai, jaise 'mokṣamārgasya netāram' ityādi | jo dūsare granthase lākara namaskāra kiyā gayā ho vaha anibaddha maṃgala hai, jaise "jagattrayanāthāya'' ityādi |
isa sambandhameṃ koī śiṣya yaha pūrvapakṣa uṭhākara tarka karatā hai ki-kisaliye śāstrake prārambhameṃ śāstrakāra maṃgalake liye parameṣṭhīke guṇoṃ kā stotra karate haiṃ | jo śāstrā śuru kiyā ho use hī kahanā cāhiye, maṃgalakī jarūrata nahīṃ haiṃ| yaha bhī kahanā nahīṃ cāhiye ki maṃgalarūpa namaskārase puṇya hotā hai tathā puṇyase kārya vighnarahita hotā hai, kyoṃki aisā kahane se vyabhicāra ātā hai| kahīṃ para to namaskāra, dāna, pūjā ādi karate hue vighna hotā dikhāī detā hai tathā kahīṃpara dāna, pūjā, va namaskāra na karate hue bhī nirvighna kāma dikhāī paḍa़tā hai ? isakā samādhāna ācārya karate hai ki-he śiṣya ! tumhārā yaha kahanā yogya nahīṃ hai| pūrvakālameṃ ācāryoṃ ne iṣṭadevatāko namaskāra pahale karake hī kārya śuru

14
ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana kiye the| tumane kahā ki aisā na kahanā cāhiye ki namaskārase puṇya hotā hai va puṇyase vighna nahīṃ hotā hai | so yaha bhī tumhārā kahanā ṭhīka nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki tarkaśāstrā ādimeṃ siddha kiyā gayā hai ki devatāko namaskāra karanese puṇya hotā hai aura puṇyase nirvighna kārya hotā hai| phira jo tumane kahā ki aisā mānanese vyabhicāra ātā hai so bhī ṭhīka nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki jahā~ devatāko namaskāra, dāna pūjā ādi tharmake karate hue bhī vighna ho jātā hai vahā~ yaha samajhanā cāhiye ki pūrva meṃ kiye hue pāpakā hī phala haiṃ, yaha dharmasādhanakā doṣa nahīṃ hai tathā jahā~ devatāko namaskāra dāna pūjādi dharmake binā bhī nirvighna kārya hotā dekhā jātā hai vahā~ yaha samajhanā cāhiye ki yaha pūrvameṃ kiye hue dharmahīkā phala hai, yaha pāpakā phala nahīṃ hai | phira śiṣya kahatā hai ki-śāstra svayaṃ maṃgalarūpa hai yā amaṃgala hai| yadi śāstra maṃgalarūpa hai taba maṃgalakā maṃgala karanese kyā prayojana hai aura yadi śāstra amaṃgalarūpa hai taba aise śāstrase kyā prayojana siddha hogā? ācārya mahārāja isakā bhī samādhāna karate haiṃ ki-bhaktike liye maṃgalakā bhī maṃgala kiyā jātā hai| jaisā ki kahā hai
bhāvārtha-dīpakase saryako, jalase samudrako, vāṇīse jinavāṇī arthāt sarasvatīko loga pūjate haiṃ, isī taraha maṃgalase hī maṃgalakī pūjā karate haiṃ ||16|| aura bhī yaha hai ki iṣṭadevatāko namaskāra karanese unake prati upakārakī svīkāratā hotī hai, jaisā kahā hai

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-3 anvayārtha—( paṃcānāṃ samavādaḥ ) pā~ca astikāya kā samabhāvapūrvaka nirūpaṇa ( vā ) athavā { samavāyaḥ ) unakā samavāya ( paṃcāstikāyakā samyak bodha athavā samṛha ) ( samayaḥ | vaha samaya hai ( iti ) aisā ( jinottamaiḥ prajñaptam ) jinavaroṃne kahā hai| ( saḥ ca eva lokaḥ bhavati ) vahī loka hai ( pā~ca astikāya ke samūha jitanā hī loka hai ) ( tata: ) usase āge ( amita: aloka: ) asīma aloka ( kham ) ākāśasvarūpa hai|
ṭīkā—yahā~ ( isa gāthā meṃ ) śabdarūpase, jñānarūpase aura artharūpase ( śabdasamaya, jñānasamaya aura arthasamaya )-aise tīna prakārase "samaya" śabdakā artha kahā hai tathā lokaalokarūpa vibhāga kahā hai|
__vahā~, ( 1 ) 'sama' arthāt madhyastha yānī jo rāgadveṣase vikṛta nahīṃ huā, 'vāda' arthāt varṇa ( akṣara ), pada ( śabda ) aura vākyake samūhavālā pāṭha | pā~ca astikāya kā 'samavāda' arthāt madhyastha ( rāgadveṣase vikṛta nahīṃ huā ) pāṭha | maukhika yā śāstrārūḍha़ nirūpaṇa ) vaha śabdasamaya hai arthāta śabdāgama vaha śabdasamaya hai| (2) mithyādarśanake udaya kā nāśa hāne para, usa paṃcāstikāyakā hī samyak avāya arthāt samyak jñāna va jñānasamaya hai, arthāt jñānāgama vaha jñānasamaya hai| ( 3 ) krathanake nimittase sāta hue usa paṃcāstikāyakā hī vasturūpase samavāya arthāt samūha vaha artha samaya hai, arthāt sarvapadārthasamūha vaha arthasamaya hai | usameṃ, yahā~ jñānasamayakī prasiddhike hetu śabdasamayake saṃbaṃdhase arthasamayakā kathana ( śrīmada bhagavatkundakundācāryadeva ) karanā cāhate haiṃ|
aba, usī arthasamayakā loka aura alokake bhedake kāraṇa dvividhapanā hai| vahīṃ paṃcāstikāyasamūha jitanā hai utanā loka haiṃ | usase āge amāpa arthāt ananta aloka hai | vaha aloka abhāvamātra nahīṃ haiṃ kintu paṃcāstikāyasamūha jitanā kṣetra choḍa़kara śeṣa anantakṣetravālā ākāśa hai ||3||
saṃskṛta tātparya vṛtti gāthā-3 atha gāthāpūrvārddhana śabda-jñānārtha-rūpeṇa tridhābhidheyataṃ samayaśabdasya, uttarārddhana tu lokālokavibhāgaṃ ca pratipādayāmītyabhiprāyaṃ manasi dhṛtvā sūtramidaṃ kathayati | evamagrepi vakṣyamāṇaṃ vivakṣitāvivakṣitasūtrārthaṃ manasi saṃpradhārya, athavāsya sūtrasyāgre sūtramidamucitaṃ bhavatītyevaṃ niścitya sūtramidaṃ pratipādayatīti pātanikālakṣaṇamanena krameṇa yathāsaṃbhavaṃ sarvatra jñātavyam, samatāo paṃcaṇhaṃ-paṃcānāṃ jīvādyarthānāṃ samavāyaḥ samūhaḥ, samayamiṇaṃ-samayoyamiti jiṇavarehiṇa paṇṇattaṃjinavaraiḥ prajñapta: kathita: | so ceva havadi logo-sa caiva paṃcānāṃ melāpaka: samūho bhavati, sa kaḥ, lokaḥ, tatto-tatastasmātpaṃcānāṃ jīvādyarthānāṃ samavāyādahibhūta: amao-amito'pramāṇa:

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta athavā 'amao' akṛtrimo na kenāpi kṛtaḥ, na kevalaṃ lokaḥ, aloyakkhaṃ-aloka ityākhyā saṃjñā yasya sa bhavatyalokākhyaḥ, aloya khaṃ iti bhinnapadapāṭhāntare ca aloka iti kortha: khaṃ śuddhākāśamiti saṃgrahavākyaṃ | tadyathā-samayaśabdasya śabdajñānārthabhedena pūrvoktameva tridhā vyākhyānaṃ vivāyate.-paṃcānāṃ jīvādyastikāyānāṃ pratipādako varṇapadavākyarūpo vādaḥ pāṭhaḥ śabdasamayo dravyāgama iti yāvat, teṣāmeva paṃcānāṃ mithyātvodayābhāve sati saṃśayavimohavibhramarahitatvena samyagavāyo bodhī nirṇayo niścayo jñānasamayo'rthaparicchitti vaśrutarūpo bhāvāgama iti yāvat tena dratyāgamarūpaśabdasamayena vācyo bhāvaśrutarūpajñānasamayena paricchedyaḥ paṃcānāmastikāyānāṃ samūho'rthasamaya iti bhaṇyate | tatra śabdasamayādhāraṇa jñānasamayaprasiddhyarthamarthasamayotra vyākhyātuṃ prārabdhaḥ sa caivārthasamayā loko bhaṇyate | kathamiti cet ? yad dṛśyamānaṃ kimapi paṃcendriyaviṣayayogyaṃ sa pudgalāstikāyo bhaṇyate, yatkimapi cidrūpaṃ sa jīvāstikāyo bhaṇyate, tayorjīvapudgalayorgatihetulakṣaṇo dharmaḥ, sthitihetulakṣaṇo'dharmaḥ, avagāhanalakṣaṇamākāśaṃ, vartanālakṣaṇa: kālaśca, yāvati kṣetre sa lokaḥ | tathā coktaṃ-lokyante dṛśyante jīvādipadārthā yatra sa lokaḥ tasmādbahirbhūtamanantaśuddhākāśamalāka iti sūtrārthaḥ ||3||
hindī sāyarṣabhṛti māyā...3 utthānikā-āge ādhī gāthāse samaya śabdako śabda, jñāna va artha rūpase tīna prakāra kahate hue āgekī ādhī gāthāse loka-alokakā vibhāga kahatā hū~ aisā abhiprāya manameṃ dhārakara agalā sūtra kahate haiṃ| isī taraha āge bhī kahe jānevāle vivakṣita yā avivakṣita sūtrake artha ko manameṃ dhārakara athavā isa sūtrake āge yaha sūtra ucita hai aisā niścaya karake yaha sūtra kahate haiṃ aisī pātanikākā lakṣaṇa isī kramase yathāsaṃbhava sarva ṭhikāne isa granthameṃ jānanā cāhiye|
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( paṃcaṇha) pā~ca jīvādi dravyoṃkā ( samavāo) samūha { samautti ) samaya hai aisā ( jiṇuttamehi paṇṇattaṃ ) jinendroṃne kahā hai| ( so ceva ) vahī pā~coṃkā mela yā samudāya ( loo havadi ) loka hai| (tatto) isase bāraha [ amio] apramāṇa [ aloo] aloka ( khaṃ) mātra śuddha ākāśarūpa hai ||
viśeṣārtha-yahā~ samaya śabdakā śabda, jñāna, arthake bhedase pahale hī tīna prakāra vyākhyāna kahate haiṃ | pā~ca jīvādi astikāyoṃkī pratipādana karanevālā varṇa, pada vākyarūpa jo pāṭha hai usako śabdasamaya yā dravyāgama kahate haiṃ | mithyādarśanake udayakā abhāva hote hue una hī pāṃcoṃkā saṃśaya, vimoha,vibhrama rahita yathārtha avāya, niścaya, jñāna yā nirṇaya use jñānasamaya, arthajñāna, bhāvaśruta yā bhāvāgama kahate haiṃ tathā usa dravyāgamarūpa śabdasamayase

ṣaḍdravya - paṃcāstikāya varṇana
kahane yogya jo bhāvaśrutarūpa jñānasamaya usase jānane yogya jo pā~ca astikāyoṃ kā samūha so 'arthasamaya hai, yahā~ śabdasamayake ādhārase jñānasamayakī prasiddhike liye arthasamayake vyākhyānakā prāraṃbha hai| isa hī arthasamayako loka kahate haiṃ| vaha isa taraha para hai ki jo kucha bhī pā~coṃ indriyoṃke grahaṇa yogya dikhalāī paḍa़tā hai vaha saba pudgalāstikāya kahalātā hai | jo koī bhī caitanya rūpa hai use jīvāstikāya kahate haiṃ| ina jīva aura puhalakī gatimeṃ nimittarūpa dharma hai tathā sthitimeṃ nimitta rūpa adharma haiṃ, avagāhanā denekā nimitta ākāśa hai tathā vartanāmeṃ nimittarūpa kāla hai| jitane kṣetrameṃ ye haiṃ so hī loka hai| aisā hī kahā haijahā~ jīvādi padārtha dikhalāī paḍa़e so loka hai, isake bāraha ananta śuddha ākāśa haiṃ so aloka hai, aisā sūtrakā artha hai || 3 ||

utthānikā- āge pā~ca astikāyoṃkī viśeṣa saṃjñā aura unameṃ sāmānya yā viśeṣa astitva tathā kāyatva ko pragaṭa karate haiṃ
samayavyākhyā gāthā- 4
atra paṃcāstikāyānāṃ viśeṣasaṃjñā sāmānyaviśeṣāstitvaṃ kāyatvaṃ coktam | jīvā puggala - kāyā dhammā-dhammā taheva āgāsaṃ | atthittamhi yaṇiyadā aṇaṇṇa- maiyā aṇu-mahaṃtā || 4 | jīvāḥ pulakāyā dharmādharmau tathaiva ākāśam | astitve ca niyatā ananyamayā aṇumahāntaḥ | | 4 | |
tatra jīvāḥ puhalā dharmādharmau ākāśamiti teṣāṃ viśeṣasaṃjñā anvarthāḥ pratyeyāḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣāstitvañca teṣāmutpādavyayadhrauvyamayyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣasattāyāṃ niyatatvādvyavasthitatvādavaseyam | astitve niyatānāmapi na teṣāmanyamayatvam, yataste sarvadaivānanyamayā ātmanirvṛttāḥ | ananyamayatve'pi teṣāmastitvaniyatatvaṃ nayaprayogāt | dvau hi nayau bhagavatā praṇītau dravyārthikaḥ paryāyārthikaśca | tatra na khalvekanayāyattā deśanā kiṃtu tadubhayāyattā | tataḥ paryāyārthādeśādastitve svataḥ kathaṃciddhine'pi vyavasthitā dravyārthādeśātsvayameva santaḥ sato'nanyamayā bhavantīti | kāyatvamapi teṣāmaṇumahattvāt | aṇavo'tra pradeśā mūrtā'mūrtaśca nirvibhāgāṃśāstaiḥ mahānto'ṇumahāntaḥ pradeśapracayātmakā iti siddhaṃ teṣāṃ kāyatvam | aṇubhyāṃ mahānta iti vyutpattyā dvyaṇukapulaskandhānāmapi tathāvidhatvam | aṇavaśca mahāntaśca vyaktiśaktirūpābhyāmiti paramāṇunāmekapradeśātmakatve'pi tatsiddhiḥ | vyaktyapekṣayā śaktyapekṣayā ca pradeśapracayātmakasya mahattvasyābhāvātkālāṇūnāmastitvaniyatatve'pyakāyatvamanenaiva sādhitam |

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
ata eva teṣāmastikāyaprakaraṇe satāmapyanupādānamiti | | 4 | | hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā - 4
anvayārtha - ( jīvāḥ ) jīva, ( pudgalakāyāḥ ) pulakāya, ( dharmādharmau ) dharma, adharma, ( tathā evaṃ ) tathā ( ākāśam ) ākāśa ( astitve niyatā: ) astitvameṃ niyata (ananyamayāḥ ) ( astitva se ) ananyamaya [ ] aura ( aṇumahāntaḥ ) aṇumahān ( pradeśameṃ baḍa़e ) haiṃ |
ṭīkā – yahā~ ( isa gāthā meṃ ) pā~ca astikāyoṃkī viśeṣasaṃjñā, sāmānya- viśeṣa - astitva tathā kāryatva kahā hai|
vahā~ jīva, pudgala, dharma, adharma aura ākāśa - graha unakī viśeṣa saṃjñāe~ anvarthaṃ jānanā | ve utpāda - vyaya, dhrauvyamayī sāmānyaviśeṣasattāmeṃ niyata vyavasthita ( niścita vidyamāna } honese unake sāmānyaviśeṣa-- astitva bhī haiṃ aisā niścita karanā cāhiye| ve astitva meṃ niyata hone para bhī astitvase anyamaya nahīṃ haiṃ, kyoṃki sadaiva ananyamayapanese unakī niṣpatti hai "astitva se ananyamaya' hone para bhī unakā "astitvameṃ niyatapanā" nayaprayoga haiṃ| bhagavānane do naya kahe haiṃ- dravyārthika aura paryāyārthika| vahā~ kathana eka nayake ādhīna nahīṃ hotā kintu do nayoṃke ādhīna hotā hai| isaliye ve paryāyārthika kathanase jo apane se kathaṃcit bhinna bhī haiṃ aise astitvameṃ vyavasthita ( niścita sthita ) haiṃ aura dravyārthika kathanase svayameva sat ( vidyamāna ) hone ke kāraṇa astitvase ananyamaya haiṃ |
23
unake kāyapanā bhī haiṃ, kyoṃki ve aṇumahān haiṃ| yahā~ aṇu arthāt pradeśa mūrta aura amūrta nirvibhāga [ choṭese choṭe ] aṃśa, 'unake dvārā ( bahu pradeśoṃ dvārā ) mahān ho' vaha aṇumahāna, arthāt pradeśapracayātmaka ( pradeśoṃke samūhamaya ) ho vaha aṇumahān haiṃ | isa prakāra unheṃ ( uparokta pā~ca dravyoṃke ) kāyatva siddha huā | [ ūpara jo aṇumahānkī vyutpatti kī usameṃ aṇuoṃ ke arthāt pradeśoṃke liye bahuvacana kā upayoga kiyā hai aura saṃskṛta bhāṣā ke niyamānusāra bahuvacanameṃ dvivacanakā samāveśa nahīṃ hotā isaliye aba vyutpattimeṃ kiṃcit bhāṣā parivartana karake dvi- aṇuka skandhoṃ ko bhī aṇumahān batalākara unakākāyatva siddha kiyā jātā hai ] 'do aṇuoṃ ( do pradeśoṃ ) dvārā mahān ho' vaha aṇumahān - aisī vyutpattise dvi- aṇuka pudgalaskandhoṃko bhī| agumahānapanā hone se ) kāyatva haiṃ | [ aba, paramāṇuoṃko aṇumahānapanā kisa prakāra hai| vaha batalākara paramāṇuoṃ ko bhī kāyatva siddha kiyā jātā hai ] vyakti aura śaktirūpase aṇu tathā mahān honese ( arthāt paramāṇu vyaktirūpase ekapradeśī tathā śaktirūpase anekapradeśī honeke kāraṇa ) paramāṇuoṃko bhī unake ekapradeśātmakapanā hone para bhī ( aṇumahānapanā siddha hone se ) kāyatva siddha hotā hai | kālāṇuoṃko vyakti apekṣāse tathā śakti apekṣā se pradeśatracayātmaka mahānapane kā abhāva hone se, yadyapi ve astitvameṃ niyata haiṃ tathāpi, unake

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana akrāyatva hai-aisā isīse ( isa kathanase hī ) siddha huā | isīliye, yadyapi ve sata ( vidyamāna ) haiṃ tathāpi unheṃ astikāyake prakaraṇameṃ nahīṃ liyā hai ||4||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-4 atha paṃcāstikāyānāṃ viśeṣasaṃjñāḥ sāmānyaviśeṣāstitvakāyatvaṃ ca pratipādayati,-jīvā poggalakāyā dhammādhammaṃ taheva āyāsaṃ-jīvapudgaladharmādharmākāśānīti paṃcāstikāyānāṃ viśeṣasaṃjñā anvarthī jñātavyā atthittamhi ya ṇiyadā-astitve sāmānyaviśeṣasattāyāṃ niyatā: sthitāḥ | tarhi sattāyāḥ sakāśātkuṇḍe vadarāṇīva bhinnā bhaviṣyanti | naivaṃ | aṇaṇṇamaiyā ananyamanyā apṛthagbhṛtā: yathā ghaṭeṃ rūpādayaḥ śarīre, hastādayaḥ stambhesāra ityanena vyākhyānenādhārādheyabhāvepyavināstitvaṃ bhaṇitaṃ bhavati | idānī kāyatvaṃ cocyate | aṇumahaṃtā-aṇumahāntaḥ āṇunā paricchinnatvādāśabdenātra pradeśaḥ gṛhyante, aṇubhiḥ pradeśairmahāntoāṇumahāṃta: | dvayaṇukaskandhāpekṣayā dvābhyāmagṛbhyāṃ mahānto'ṇumahāntaḥ iti kāyatvamuktaṃ | ekapradeśāgo: kathaṃ kāyatvamiti cet ? skandhānāṃ kāraṇabhṛtāyā: snigdharūkṣatvaśakte: sadbhāvādupacāreṇa kāyatvaṃ bhavati | kālāṇūnāṃ punarbandhakāraṇabhūtāyā: srigdharūkṣatvaśakterabhāvādapacāreṇāpi kāyatvaṃ nāsti | śaktyabhāvopi kasmāna? amartattvāditi paṃcāstikāyānāṃ viśeṣasaṃjñā astitvaṃ kāyatvaṃ coktaṃ | atra gāthāsūtre'nantajñānādirūpaḥ śuddhajīvāstikāya evopādaya iti bhāvārtha: ||4||
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-4 anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( jīvā ) anaṃtānaṃta jīva ( puggalakāyā) anantānta pudgalāstikāya [ dhammādhammā] eka dharmāstikāya eka adharmāstikāya ( taheva ) taise hī (āyāsaṃ) eka akhaṃḍa ākāśa-ye saba [ asthitamhi ] apane astitvameṃ yā apanī sattāmeṃ [ṇiyadā ] niścita haiṃ (ya) aura [aṇaṇṇamaiyā ] apanī sattā se apṛthagbhūta haiṃ yā ekameka haiṃ, aura [ aṇumahaṃtā] pradeśoṃmeṃ aneka haiṃ yā bahu pradeśī haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-sattāke do bheda haiṃ-eka sattāsāmānya yā mahāsattā, dūsare sattāviśeṣa yā avāntarasattā | ye jīvādi pāṃcoṃ astikāya ina donoṃ prakārakī sattāmeṃ sthita haiṃ so isa taraha nahīṃ haiṃ jaise eka kuṃḍī meṃ bera phala alaga alaga ho kiṃtu ve pā~coṃ apanī apanī sattāse ekameka yā ananya haiṃ | jaise ghaṭameṃ rūpādi vyāpaka haiṃ yā śarīrameṃ hātha-paga ādi haiṃ yā khaṃbhemeṃ usakā sāra yā gūdā hai| isa kathanase yaha dikhāyā ki ādhāra aura ādheyake binā bhī sattākā inake sātha ekamekapanā kahā jātā hai | aṇuse jānane yogya pradeśa hotā hai isaliye yahā~ aṇuśabdase pradeśa lenā cāhiye, so ye pā~coṃ hī dravya yā astikāya apane pradeśoṃ kī apekṣā baḍa़e haiṃ ataḥ aṇumahanta; haiṃ | do aṇuka skandha do aṇuoṃ ke dvārā mahān

paṃcāstikārya prābhṛta hai ataḥ aṇumahanta haiṃ| isaliye inameṃ kāyapanā kahā gayā | eka pradeśī paramāṇuko kāyapanā isa apekṣāse hai ki ve paramāṇu apane snigdha yā rūkṣa guṇake kāraṇase skaṃdha banane ke kāraṇa hai isaliye upayāra yā vyavahāra se unako kāyapanā hai| kālāṇuoṃmeṃ paraspara baṃdhake kāraṇa snigdha yā rūkṣapanekī śakti nahīṃ hai isaliye upacārase bhī unameṃ kāyapanā nahīṃ hai| unameṃ isa śaktikā abhāva isīliye hai ki sarva kālāṇu amūrtīka haiṃ| isa taraha isa gāthāmeṃ pā~ca astikāyoṃ ke viśeṣa nāma va usakā astitva va kāyapanā batāyā gayā | isa sūtrase yaha tātparya lenā cāhiye ki inameṃ eka śuddha jīvāstikāya hī grahaṇa karane yogya hai ||4||

te bhavantyastikāyāḥ niṣpannaṃ yaistrailokyam ||5|| asti hyastikāyānāṃ guṇaiḥ paryāyaiśca vividhai saha svabhāvo ātmabhāvo'nanyatvam | vastuno viśeṣā hi vyatirekiṇa: paryāyā guṇastu ta evānvayinaḥ | tata ekena paryāyeṇa pralīyamānasyānyonopajāyamānasyānvayinā guṇena dhrauvyaṃ vibhrāṇasyaikasyā'pi vastunaḥ samucchedotpādadhrauvyalakṣaṇamastitvamupapadyata eva | guṇaparyāyaiḥ saha sarvathānyatve tvanyo vinaśyatyanya: prādurbhavatyanyo dhruvatvamālambata iti sarva viplavate | tata: sādhvastitvasaṃbhavaprakārakathanam | kāyatvasaṃbhavaprakārastvayampadiśyate | akyavino hi jīvapugaladharmādharmākāśapadārthāsteṣāmavayavā api pradeśākhyā: parasparavyatirekitvātparyāyā: ucyante | teṣāṃ taiḥ sahānanyatve kāyavasiddhirupapattimatī| niravayavasyāpi paramāṇo: sāvayavatvaśaktisadbhāvāt kāyavasiddhiranapavādā | na caitadāśayam-pudgalādanyeṣāmamūrtatvādavibhājyānāṃ sāvayavatvakalpanamanyāyyama| daśyata evāvibhājye'pi vihāyasīdaṃ ghaṭākāśamidamaghaṭākāśamiti vibhāgakalpanam | yadi tatra vibhāgo na kalpeta tadā yadeva ghaṭākāśaṃ tadevāghaṭākāśaṃ syāt | na ca tadiṣṭam | tataḥ kālāṇubhyo'nyatra sarveṣāṃ kāyatvākhyaṃ sāvayavatvamavaseyam | trailokyarūpeṇa niṣpanatvamapi teṣāmastikāyatvasādhanaparamupanyastam | tathā ca-trayāṇāmūrdhvā'dhomadhyalokānāmutpādatryayadhrauvyabantastadviśeṣātmakā bhāvā bhavantasteṣāṃ mūlapadārthānāṃ guṇaparyāyayogapūrvakamastitvaṃ sādhayanti | anumīyate ca dharmādharmākāśānāṃ pratyekamūrdhvā'dhomadhalokāvibhāgarūpeṇa pariṇamanātvāyatvākhyāṃ sāvayavatvam | jovānāmapi

. hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-5 anvayārtha---[ yeṣām ] jinheṃ [ vividhaiḥ ] vividha ( guṇaiḥ ) guṇoṃ aura ( paryayaiḥ ) paryāyoṃ ke ( saha ) sātha [svabhāva: ] apanatva ( asti ) hai ( te ) ve ( astikāyāḥ bhavanti ) astikāya haiṃ [yaiḥ ] ki jinase ( trailokyam ) tīnoṃ loka ( niṣpatram ) haiṃ| ___ṭīkā-yahā~, ( isa gāthādvārā ) pā~ca astikāyoṃko astitva kisaprakāra hai aura kāyatva kisa prakāra hai vaha kahā gayā hai| ___vāstavameṃ astikāyoṃko vividha guṇoṃ aura paryāyoṃke sātha svapanā-apanāpana-ananyapanā hai| vastuke vyatirekī viśeṣa ve paryāyeṃ hai aura anavayī viśeṣa ve guṇa haiṃ | isaliye eka paryāyase pralayako prāpta honevālī, anya paryāyase utpanna honevālī aura anvayī guṇase dhruva rahanevālī eka hī vastuko vyayautpāda-dhrauvya lakṣaṇa astitva ghaṭita hotā hī hai| aura yadi guṇoṃ tathā paryāyoṃ ke sātha ( vastumeṃ) sarvathā anyatva ho taba to anya koī vināśako prāpta hogā, anya koī prādurbhāvako ( utpādako ) prāpta hogā aura koī anya dhruva rahegā-isa prakāra saba viplava ko prāpta ho jāyagā | isaliye ( pāṃca astikāyoṃko) astitva kisaprakāra hai tatsambandhī yaha ( uparyukta ) kathana satya-yogya-nyāyayukta hai|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
27 (1) ūrdhva-adho-madhya tīnalokake utpāda-vyaya-dhrauvyavāle bhāva-jo ki tīnalokake viśeṣasvarūpa haiṃ-bhavate hue ( pariṇamita hote hue ) apane mūla padārthoṃ kā guṇaparyāyayukta astitva siddha karate haiṃ|
(2) punaśca, dharma, adharma aura ākāśa-yaha pratyeka padārtha ūrdhva-adho-madhya aise lokake ( tīna ) vibhāgarūpa se pariṇamita honese unake kāyatva nāmakā sāvayavapanā hai aisā anumāna kiyā jā sakatā hai | pratyeka jīvake bhī ūrdhva-adho-madhya aise tīna lokake ( tīna ) vibhāgarūpase pariṇamita lokapūraṇa avasthārūpa vyaktikī śaktikā sadaiva sadbhāva hone se jīvoṃ ko bhī kāyatva nāmakā sākyavapanā hai aisā anumāna kiyā hī jā sakatā hai pugala bhī ūrdhvaadho—madhya aise loka ke ( tīna ) vibhāgarūpa pariṇamita lokapūraṇa avasthārūpa vyaktikī śaktikā sadaiva sadbhāva honese jīvoṃkoṃ bhī kāyatva nāmakā sāvayavapanā hai aisā anumāna kiyā hī jāsakatā hai pudgala bhī ūrdhva-adho—madhya aise loka ke ( tīna ) vibhāgarūpa pariṇata mahāskandhapanekī prāptikī vyaktivāle athavā śaktivāle honese unheṃ bhī vaisī ( kāyatva nāmakī) sāvayavapanekī siddhi hī hai ||5||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-5 . atha pūrvoktamastitvaṃ kāyatvaṃ ca kena prakāreṇa saṃbhavatīti prajñāpayati,—jesi asthisahāo guṇehiṃ saha pajjayehi vivihehiṃ te hoti asthi-yeṣāṃ paṃcāstikāyānāmastitvaṃ vidyate | sa kaḥ | svabhāvaḥ sattā astitvaṃ tanmayatvaṃ svarūpamiti yāvat | kaiḥ saha | guṇaparyāyaiḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ | vicitrai nāprakāraiste asti bhavanti ityanena paṃcānāmastitvamuktamiti vārtikaṃ | tathā kathyateanvayino guṇāḥ vyatirekiṇaḥ paryāyāḥ, athavā sahabhuvo guṇāḥ, kramavartinaḥ paryāyāste ca dravyātsakāśāt saṃjñālakṣaṇaprayojanādibhedena bhitrāḥ pradeśarūpeṇa sattārūpeṇa vā cābhinnāḥ | punarapi kathaṃbhūtāḥ vicitrā nānāprakārāḥ | kena kṛtvā | svena svabhāvavibhāvarūpeṇārthavyaṃjanaparyāyarūpeṇa vā | jīvasya tāvatkathyante | kevalajñānādaya: svabhāvaguṇā matijñānādayo vibhāvaguṇāḥ, siddharūpa: svabhāvaparyāya:, naranārakādirūpā vibhāvaparyāyāḥ | pudgalasya kathyante| śuddhaparamāṇau varṇādayaḥ svabhāvaguṇā: dvayaṇukādiskande varṇādayo vibhāvaguṇāḥ, śuddhaparamāṇurūpeṇāvasthānaṃ svabhāvadravyaparyāya: varṇādibhyo varṇāntarādipariṇamanaṃ svabhāvaguṇaparyāya: 'dvayaṇukādiskandarūpeṇa pariṇamanaṃ vibhāvadravyaparyāyāḥ teṣveva vyaṇukādiskandheṣu varṇāntarādipariṇamanaṃ vibhāvaguṇaparyāyāḥ| ete jīvapudgalayorviśeṣaguṇāḥ kathitāḥ | sāmānyaguṇāḥ punarastittvavastutvaprameyattvāgurulaghutvādayaḥ sarvadravyasādhāraṇā: | dharmādīnāṃ viśeṣaguṇaparyāyā: agre yathāsthāneṣu kathyante | itthaṃbhūtaguṇaparyāyaiḥ saha yeṣāṃ pañcāstikāyānāmastitvaṃ vidyate testi bhavantīti | idānī kāyatvaṃ cocyate | kāyā: kāyā iva kāyā bahupradeśapracayatvāccharoravat| kiṃkṛtaṃ taiḥ paṃcāstikāyai: "ṇippaṇṇaṃ jehiṃ tellokaṃ.'' niṣpannaṃ yaiḥ paṃcāstikāyaiḥ | kiṃ niṣpannaṃ | trailokyaṃ | anenāpi gāthācaturthapādenāstitvaṃ

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana kāyattvaṃ coktaṃ | kathamiticet ? trailokye ye kecanotpādavyayadhrauvyavantaḥ padārthāste utpādavyayadhrauvyarūpamastitvaṃ kathayanti | tadapi kathamiti cet ? utpādavyayadhrauvyarūpaṃ saditi vacanāt ūrdhvādhomadhyabhāgarūpeṇa jīvapudgalādīnāṃ tribhuvanākārapariṇatānāṃ sāvayavatvātsāṃśakatvāta sapradeśatvāt kāladravyaṃ vihāya kāyatvaṃ ca vidyate, na kevalaṃ pūrvoktaprakāreṇa, anena ca prakāreṇāstitva kāyatvaṃ ca jñātavyaṃ | tatra śuddhajīvāstikāyasya yānantajñānādiguṇasattā siddhaparyāyasattā ca śuddhāsaṃkhyātapradeśarūpaṃ kāyatvamupādeyamiti bhāvārthaḥ ||5|| evaṃ gāthātrayaparyantaṃ paṃcāstikāyasaṃkṣepavyākhyānaṃ dvitīyasthalaṃ gataṃ |
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-5 utthānikā-āge yaha prakāśa karate haiṃ ki pahalī gāthā meṃ jisa astitva va kāyatva ko kahā gayā hai, vaha kisa prakāra saṃbhava hai ?
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( jesiṃ ) jina pāṃca astikāyoṃkā ( vivihehiṃ ) nānā prakāra ke ( guṇehiṃ pajjaehiṃ saha) guṇa aura paryāyoṃke sātha [ asthi sahāo ] astisvabhāva hai (te) ve [ asthikāya ] astikāya ( hoti ) hote haiṃ | | jehiṃ ) jinake dvārā ( tiilukkaṃ ) yaha tīna loka (ṇippaṇṇaṃ) racā gayā hai|
viśeṣārtha-yahā~ astisvabhāvako sattā, tanmayapanā yā svarūpa kahate haiṃ| vicitra nānā prakāra ke guṇa paryāyoṃ ke sātha ve rahate haiṃ| isa prakāra pāṃcoṃ ke astitva kā kathana huā| yaha vārtika hai | anvayī guṇa hote haiṃ aura vyatireka paryāya hotī haiṃ | athavā jo dravyake sātha-sātha raheṃ unako guṇa kahate haiṃ | jo alaga-alaga kramase hoṃ unakoṃ paryāya kahate haiṃ | ye guṇa aura paryāya apane dravyake sātha saṃjñā, lakṣaṇa, saṃkhyā, prayojanādikī apekṣā bheda rakhate hue bhī pradeśa rūpase yā sattā rūpase bhinna nahīṃ haiṃ, abheda haiṃ| ye guṇa aura paryāya nānā prakārake hote haiṃ | jaise svabhāva guṇa, vibhāva guṇa yā svabhāva paryāya, vibhāva paryāya tathā artha paryāya aura vyaṃjana paryāya |
jīvake sambandhake kahate haiṃ ki-kevalajñāna ādi jīvake svabhāva guṇa haiṃ, matijñāna ādi jīvake vibhāṣa guṇa haiṃ| siddharūpa svabhāva paryāya hai| naranārakādi rūpa vibhāva paryāya hai | pudgala ke sambandhameṃ kahate haiṃ-śuddha ( abaṃdha ) paramāṇumeṃ jo varṇādi hai ve svabhāva guṇa haiṃ, do aṇuke skaṃdha ādimeṃ jo varṇādi haiṃ ve vibhāva guṇa haiṃ| śuddha paramāṇu rūpase rahanā so svabhāva dravya paryāya hai | śuddha paramāṇu kā varṇādise anya varṇādi rūpa pariṇamanā so svabhāṣa guṇa paryāya hai| paramāṇuoṃ kā do aṇu ādike skaṃdha rūpa pariṇamanā so

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta vibhāva dravya paryāya hai una hī dviaṇukādi skaṃdhoṃmeṃ varṇādise anya varṇādi rūpa palaṭanā so vibhāva guṇa paryāya hai | ye jīva pudgalake viśeṣa guṇa kahe gae | sāmānya guṇa astitva, vastutva, prameyatva, aguruladhutva ādi haiṃ jo sarva dravyoṃmeṃ sādhāraṇa pāe jāte haiṃ | dharmādidravyoṃke viśeṣa guṇa va paryāya āge jahā~ unakā kathana hogā, kaheṃge| isa tarahake guṇa paryāyoṃke sātha jina pā~ca astikāyoṃkī sattā hai isase ve asti rūpa haiṃ | aba kāyapaneko kahate haiṃ | śarīrake samāna jo hoṃ use kāya kahate haiṃ arthāt jisameṃ bahutase pradeśoṃ kā samūha ho | ina hī pāṃca astikāyoṃke dvārā tīna lokakī racanā hai| tīna lokameṃ jo koī utpāda vyaya prauvyavāna padārtha haiṃ ve hī utpāda dhyaya prauvya rūpa astipaneko sūcita karate haiṃ| kyoṃki sūtrameṃ yaha vacana hai "utpādavyayadhrauvyarūpaṃ sat" jīva pudgala ādi tīna lokameṃ bhare hue tīna lokake ākāra pariṇamana karanevāle haiṃ | ṇe lāda, mā ta bāyo tīna bāreṃ hai| gīta aura pudgala ādi pāṃca dravya avayava yā aṃśa yā pradeśa sahita haiṃ| isaliye inameṃ kāyapanā isa rūpase bhī jānanā cāhiye, kevala pūrva kahe pramāṇa hī nahīṃ, kāla dravya eka pradeśī hai isaliye isameṃ kāyapanā nahīṃ hai| isa taraha astitva aura kāyatva jānanā cāhiye | inameṃ jo śuddha jīvāstikāyake anaṃtajñānādi guṇoṃkī sattā va usakī siddhaparyāyakī sattā va usakā śuddha asaṃkhyāta pradeśa rūpa kāyapanā hai so grahaṇa karanā yogya hai ||5||
isa taraha tīna gāthātaka paṃcāstikāyakā saṃkṣepa vyākhyāna karate hue dūsarā sthala pūrṇa huā ||3-4-5 ||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-6 atra pañcāstikāyānāṃ kālasya ca dravyatvamuktam | te ceva asthikāyā tekāliya-bhāva-pariṇadā ṇiccā | gacchaṃti daviya-bhāvaṃ pariyaṭṭaṇa-liṃga-saṃjuttā ||6||
te caivāstikāyāḥ traikālikabhāvapariṇatā nityāḥ ||
gacchanti dravyabhāvaṃ parivartanaliṅgasaṃyuktāḥ ||6|| dravyāṇi hi sahakramabhuvāṃ guṇaparyāyāṇāmananyatayādhārabhūtāni bhavanti, tato vṛttavartamānavartiṣyamāṇānāṃ bhāvānāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ svarūpeṇa pariṇatatvādastikāyānāṃ parivartanaliṃgasya kālasya cāsti dravyatvam| na ca teṣāṃ bhūtabhavadbhaviṣyadbhāvātmanā pariṇamamānānāmanityatvam yataste bhūtabhavadbhaviṣyadbhāvāvasthāsvapi pratiniyatasvarūpāparityāgānityā eva | atra kālaḥ pugalādiparivartanahetutvātpudlādiparivartanagamyamānaparyāyatvāccāstikāyeṣvantarbhāvārthaṃ sa parivartanaliṃga ityukta iti ||6||

30
ṣaḍvya--paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-6 anvayārtha—(kālikabhāvapariṇatāḥ ) jo tīna kālake bhāvoṃrūpa pariṇamita hote haiṃ tathā (nityāḥ ) nitya haiṃ [ te ca eva astikāyāḥ ] aise ve hī astikāya, ( parivartanaliṅgasaṃyuktāḥ) parivartanaliṃga ( kāla ) sahita gabhāva pavanti ) damana ko prāpta hote haiṃ ( arthāt ve chahoṃ dravya haiṃ| )
ṭīkā-yahā~ pā~ca astikāyoṃko tathā kālako dravyapanā kahā hai|
dravya vāstavameṃ sahabhāvī guṇoṃko tathā kramabhāvī paryāyoṃko ananyarūpa se ādhārabhūta haiṃ| isaliye jo varta cuke haiṃ, varta rahe haiṃ aura bhaviṣyameṃ vartege una bhāvoṃ-paryāyoṃrūpa pariṇamita hone ke kāraṇa ( pā~ca ) astikāya aura parivartanaliṃga kāla ( ve chahoṃ ) dravya haiṃ | bhūta, vartamāna
aura bhāvī bhāvoṃsvarūpa pariṇamita honese ve kahīṃ anitya nahīṃ haiṃ, kyoṃki bhūta, vartamāna aura bhāvī bhāvarūpa avasthāoṃme bhī pratiniyata (-apane-apane niścita ) svarūpako nahīṃ choḍa़te isaliye ve nitya hī haiṃ|
yahā~ kāla pudgalādike parivartanakā hetu honese tathā pudgalādike parivartana dvārā usakī paryāyeṃ gamya ( jñāta ) hotī haiṃ isaliye usakā astikāyoṃmeṃ samāveśa karaneke hetu use 'parivartanaliṃga' kahā hai|
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-6 atha paṃcāstikāyānāṃ kālasya ca dravyasaṃjñāṃ kathayati,
'te ceva asthikāyā tikkāliyabhāvapariṇadā ṇiccā' te caiva pūrvoktā: paṃcāstikāyā: yadyapi paryāyārthikanayena vaikālikabhāvapariṇatāstrikālaviṣayaparyāyapariṇatāḥ saṃta: kṣaṇikā anityā vinaśvarā bhavanti tathāpi dravyārthikanayena nityā eva| evaṃ dravyārthikaparyāyārthikanayābhyāṃ nityānityātmakā: saṃtaḥ gacchaṃti 'daviyabhāvaṃ' dravyabhāvaṃ gacchanti dravyasaṃjñāṃ labhante | punarapi kathaṃbhūtā: saṃta: "pariyaṭṭaṇaliṃgasaṃjuttā' parivartanameva jīvapuṭralādipariṇamanamevāgnedhūmavat kāryabhūtaṃ liṃgaṃ cinhaṃ gamakaṃ jñāpakaṃ sūcanaṃ yasya sa bhavati parivartanaliṅgaḥ kālāṇurdravyakālastena saṃyuktāḥ | nanu kāladravyasaṃyuktā iti vaktavyaṃ parivartanaliṅgasaṃyuktā iti avyaktavacanaṃ kimarthamiti | naivaṃ, paṃcāstikāyaprakaraṇe kālasya mukhyatā nāstīti padārthānāṃ navajīrṇapariṇatirūpeṇa kāryaliṅgana jñāyate yataḥ kāraṇāt tenaiva kāraṇena parivartanaliṅga ityuktaṃ | atra ṣaḍdravyayeṣu madhye dṛṣṭa śrutānubhūtāhārabhayamaithunaparigrahādisamastaparadravyālambanotpannasaṃkalpavikalpaśūnyaśuddhajīvāstikāyaśraddhānajñānānuchānarūpābhedaratnatrayalakṣaṇanirvikalpasamādhisaṃjātavītarāgasahajāpūrvaparamānandarūpeṇa svasaṃvedanajñānena gabhyaṃ prāpyaṃ bharitāvasthaṃ śuddhaniścayanayena svakīyadehāntargataṃ jīvadravyamevopādeyamiti bhāvārtha: ||6||
iti kālasahitapaṃcāstikāyānāṃ dravyasaṃjñākathanarūpeṇa gāthā gatā|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
31 hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-6 anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( te ceva) ye hī ūpara kahe ( asthikāyā) pāṃca astikāya ( pariyaṭṭhaṇaliṃgasaṃjuttā) dravyoṃkā parivartana karanā hai cinha jisakā aise kāla sahita (tekāliyabhāvapariṇadā) tīnakāla sambandhī paryāyoṃmeṃ pariṇamana karate hue va (ṇiccā ) avināśī rahate hue ( daviyabhāvaṃ) dravyapaneko ( gacchaṃti ) prāpta hote haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-paryāyārthika nayase ve hī pūrvokta paṃcāstikāya traikālika paryāyoṃ se pariṇata hote hue kṣaṇika, anitya, vinaśvara haiṃ tathāpi dravyārthika naya se nitya haiṃ isa prakāra dravyārthi yāyārthi se nisthāniyāmaka haiṃ | jaise dhūma agnike batānake liye kāryarūpa liṃga hai vaise hī jīva, pudralādi dravyoṃkā pariṇamanā yā palaṭanā hī kāla dravyakā cihna, gamaka, jñāyaka tathā sūcanārūpa hai| arthāt dravyoṃke palaṭane meṃ koī bhī jo nimitta kāraṇa hai vahī parivartana liṃga kālāṇu yā draṣyakāla hai| yahā~para koī śaṃkā karatā hai ki 'kāladravyasaṃyuktā' aisā kyoṃ nahīṃ kahā, parivartanaliṃgasaṃyuktā aisā aspaṣṭa vacana kyoṃ kahā? isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki paṃcāstikāyake prakaraṇameṃ kālakī mukhyatā nahīṃ hai| kyoṃki padārthoṃkā naese purānāpanā hotā hai isa pariṇatirūpa kārya liṃgase hī kālakā jānapanā hotā hai isīliye hī isa bātakī sucanāke liye parivartanaliṃga aisā kahā hai| ina chaḥ dravyoṃke madhyameṃ dekhe, sune, anubhava, kiye hue āhāra, bhaya, maithuna, parigraha ādiko icchārūpa sarva paradravyoṃke ālambanase utpanna jo saṃkalpa-vikalpa unase śūnya jo śuddha jīvāstikāya hai usakā śraddhāna, jñāna, va ācaraṇarūpa abheda ratnatrayamayī jo vikalpa rahita samādhi yā samabhāva usase utpanna jo vītarāga sahaja apūrva paramānaṃda usarūpa svasaṃvedana jñānase prāpta hone yogya va anubhavane yogya athavā usase bharapūra śuddha niśyacanayase apane hī śarīrake bhītara prāpta jo jīva dravya hai vahī graṇaha karane va anubhavane yogya hai |
isa taraha kāla sahita pā~ca astikāyoṃko dravyasaṃjñā hai aisā kathana karate hue gāthā pūrṇa hūī ||6||
utthānikā-āge kahate haiṃ ki ye chahoṃ dravyaparaspara atyanta milāpa rakhate hue bhī apane apane svarūpase girate nahīṃ haiṃ|
samayavyākhyā gāthā-7 atra ṣaṇṇā dravyāṇāṃ parasparamatyantasaṃkare'pi pratiniyatasvarūpādapracyavanamuktaṃ |

32
ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana aṇṇoṇṇaṃ pavisaṃtā ditā ogāsa-maṇṇa-maṇṇassa | melaṃtā vi ya ṇiccaṃ sagaṃ sabhāvaṃ ṇa vijahaṃti ||7||
anyo'nyaṃ praviśanti dadantyavakāśamanyo'nyasya | __ milantyapi ca nityaṃ svakaṃ svabhāvaṃ na vijahanti ||7|| ata eva teṣā pariṇāmavattve'pi prāgnityatvamuktam | ata eva ca na teṣāmekatvāpattirna ca jīvakarmaṇorvyavahāranayādeśādekatve'pi parasparasvarūpopādānamati ||7||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-7 anvayārtha—(anyonyaṃ praviśanti ) ve eka-dūsaremeṃ praveśa karate haiṃ, ( anyonyasya ) anyonya ko ( avakāśaṃ dadanti ) avakāśa dete haiṃ, ( milanti ) paraspara ( kṣīranīravat ) mila jāte haiṃ, ( api ca ) tathāpi ( nityaṃ ) sadā ( svakaṃ svabhāvaṃ ) apane-apane svabhāvako ( na vijahanti ) nahīṃ choḍa़te|
____ṭīkā- yahā~ chaha dravyoṃko paraspara atyaṃta saṃkara hone para bhī ve pratiniyata ( apane-apane niścita ) svarūpase cyuta nahīṃ hote aisā kahā hai | isīliye ( apane-apane svabhāvase cyuta nahīṃ hote isīliye ), pariṇāmavāle hone para bhī ve nitya haiṃ-aisā pahale ( chaṭhī gāthāmeṃ ) kahā thā, aura isīliye ve ekatvako prāpta nahīṃ hote, aura yadyapi jīva tathā karmako vyavahāranayake kathanasa ekatva ( kahā jātā ) haiṃ tathāpi ve ( jīva tathā karma ) eka-dūsare svarūpako grahaṇa nahīṃ karate ||7||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-7 atha ṣaṇṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ parasparamatyantasaṃkare svakīyasvakīyasvarūpādacyavanamupadiśani,aṇṇoṇṇaṃ pavisaṃtā-anyakṣetrātkṣetrāntaraṃ prati parasparasaṃbaṃdhārthamāgacchanta:, detā ogāsamaṇaṇamaṇṇassaāgatānāṃ parasparamavakāśadānaṃ dadataḥ, melaṃtāvi ya ṇiccaṃ-avakāśadānānantaraṃ parasparamelāpakena svakīyāvasthānakālaparyantaṃ yugapatprāptirūpa: saṃkaraḥ parasparaviṣayagamakarūpavyatikara: tābhyāṃ vinā nityaṃ sarvakālaṃ tiṣṭhantopi “sagasabbhāvaṃ paṇa vijahaṃti' svasvarūpaṃ na tyajantīti | athavā anyonyaṃ prāviśantaḥ sābiyābāntataḥ jīvāpudgalāpekṣā, āgatānāmavakāśaṃ dadataḥ itti saniyanniḥni gadravyamelāpakāpekṣayā, nityaṃ sarvakāla melāpavena tiṣṭhanta iti dharmādharmākāśakālani: kriyadravyāpekṣayā, iti ṣadravyamadhye khyātipūjālābhadṛṣṭaśrutānubhūtakṛṣṇanīlakāpotāśubhaleśyādisamastaparadravyālambanotpatrasaṃkalpavikalpakallolamālārahitaṃ vītarāganirvikalpa samādhisamutpannaparamānandarūpasukharasāsvādaparamasamarasībhāvasvabhāvena svasaṃvedanajñānena gamyaṃ prāpyaṃ sālambaṃ ādhāraṃ bharitāvasthaṃ śuddhapāriṇāmikaparamabhāvagrāhakeṇa śuddhadravyārthikanayeneti pāṭhaḥ |

﻿________________

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta niścayanayena svakīyadehāntargataṃ śuddhajīvāstikāyasaṃjñaṃ jīvadravyamevopādeyamiti bhāvārthaḥ | yatpunaranyeṣāmekāntavādināṃ rāgadveṣamohasahitatānāmapi vāyudhāraṇādisarvaśūnyadhyānavyākhyānamākāśadhyāna vā tatsarvaṃ nirarthakameva | saṃkalpavikalpayorbheda: kathyate-bahirdravye cetanācetanamiśre mamedamityādipariṇāma: “saṃkalpa:'" abhyantare sukhyahaṃ du:khyahaṃ ityādiharṣaviṣādapariṇāmo “vikalpa' iti saṃkalpavikalpalakṣaṇaṃ jñātavyaṃ vītarāganirvikalpasamādhau vītarāgaviśeṣaṇamanarthakamityukte sati parihāramāha-ārtaraudrarūpasya viṣayakaṣāya-nimittasyāśubhadhyānasya varjanārthatvāt hetuhetumadbhāvavyākhyānatvādvā karmadhārayasamāsatvādvā bhāvanāgranthe punaruktadoṣābhāvatvādvā svarūpasya viśeṣaṇatavādvā dṛḍhīkaraṇārthatvādvā| evaṃ vītarāganirvikalpasamādhi-vyākhyānakāle sarvatra jñātavyaṃ | vītarāgasarvajñanirdoṣiparamātmaśabdādiṣvapyanenaiva prakāreṇa pūrvapakṣe kṛte yathāsaṃbhavaṃ parihāro dātavyaḥ iti | yata evaṃ kāraṇādvītarāgastata eva kāraṇānirvikalpasamādhiḥ iti hetuhetumadbhāvaśabdasyārthaḥ ||7||
saṃkaravyatikaradoṣaparihāreṇa gāthā gatā evaṃ svatantragāthādvayena tṛtīyasthalaṃ gataṃ | iti prathamamahādhikāre saptagāthābhiḥ sthalatrayeṇa samayaśabdārthapīṭhikāvidhāna: prathamontarādhikāra: samāptaḥ ||
"atha sattā sancapayatthā'' imāṃ gāthāmādiṃ kṛtvā pāṭhakrameṇa caturdaśagāthābhirjīvapudgalādidravyavivakṣārahitvena sāmānyadravyapīṭhikā kathyate | tatra caturdaśagāthāsu madhye sāmānyaviśeṣasattālakṣaṇakathanarūpeṇa "sattā savvapayatthā'' ityādi prathama nāthāsūtroka, sadanātaraṃ sattādravyayorabhedo dravyaśabdavyutpattikathanamukhyatvena ca “daviyadi'' ityādi dvitīyasthale sūtramekaṃ, atha dravyasya lakṣaṇatrayasūcanarūpeṇa “davvaṃ salakkhaṇīyamityādi" tṛtīyasthale sūtramekaṃ, tadanantaraṃ lakṣaṇadvayapratipādarūpeṇa “uppattī ya viṇāso' ityādi sūtramekaṃ, atha tṛtīyalakṣaṇakathanena "pajjayarahiāyaṃ' ityādi gāthādvayaṃ | evaṃ samudāyena gāthātrayeṇa dravyārthikaparyāyārthikaparasparasāpekṣanayadvayasamarthanamukhyatayā caturthasthalaṃ | atha paṃcamasthale sarvaikāntamatanirākaraṇārthaṃ pramāṇasaptabhanavyākhyānamukhyatvena "siyaatthi' ityādi sūtramekaṃ | evaṃ caturdaśagāthāsu madhye sthalapaṃcakasamudāyena prathamasaptakaṃ gataṃ, atha dvitīyasaptakamadhye prathamasthale bauddhamataikāntanirākaraṇā) dravyasthāpanamukhyatvena "bhāvassa ṇatthi ṇāso'' ityādyadhikāragāthāsūtramekaṃ tasya vivaraṇārthaṃ gāthācatuṣṭayaṃ, tatra gāthācatuṣṭayamadhye tasyaivādhikārasūtrasya dravyaguṇaparyāyavyākhyānamukhyatvena 'bhāvā jīvādīyā' ityādi sūtramekaṃ, atha manuṣyādiparyāyasya vināśotpādakatvepi dhruvatvena vināśo nāstīti kathanarūpeṇa 'maṇuattaṇeṇa' ityādi sūtramekaṃ atha tasyaiva dṛḍhīkaraṇārtha 'so ceva' ityādi sūtrameṃka, athaiva dravyārthikanayena sadasatorvināśotpādau na sta: paryāyārthikanayena punarbhavata iti nayadvayavyākhyānopasaṃhārarūpeṇa ‘evaṃ sado viṇāso' ityādi upasaṃhāragāthāsūtramekaṃ iti dvitīyasthale samudāyena gāthācatuṣṭayaṃ, tadanantaraṃ tṛtīyasthale siddhasya paryāyārthikanayenāsadutpādamukhyatayā "ṇāṇāvaraṇādīyā' ityādi sūtramevaṃ,athaiva caturthasthale dravyarūpeṇa nityatvepi paryāyārthikanayena saṃsārijīvasya devatvādyutpādavyayakartṛtvavyākhyānopasaṃhāramukhyatvena dravyapīṭhikāsamāptyartha vā “evaṃ bhāvaṃ"

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana ityādi gāthāsūtramekaṃ, iti samudāyena catubhi:sthalairdvitīyasaptakaṃ gataṃ | evaṃ caturdaśamāthābhinarvabhirantarasthalairdravyapīṭhikāyāṃ samudāyapātanikā | tadyathā | athāstitvasvarūpaṃ nirūpayati, athavā sattāmūlāni dravyāṇīti kṛtvā pūrva sattāsvarūpaṃ bhāṇatvā paścāt dravyavyākhyānaṃ karomītyabhiprāya manasi dhṛtvā sūtramidaṃ pratipādayati bhagavān
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-7 anvaya sahita sāmānyārdha-( aṇṇopaṇaṃ pavisaṃtā ) anya kṣetrase anya kṣetrameṃ parasparasambaṃdha ke liye prāpta hue [ aṇṇaṃ aṇṇasa ] eka dūsareko ( ogāsaṃ) paraspara avakāśa (ditā) dete hue [ṇiccaṃ milaṃtā vi ya] aura sarvakāla paraspara milate hue bhī ( saga sambhāva) apane apane svabhāvako [pā vijahaṃti ] nahīṃ choḍa़te haiṃ |
viśeṣārtha-ye chaḥ dravya paraspara avakāśa dete hue apane apane ṭhaharaneke kāla paryaṃta ṭhaharate haiṃ, parantu unameṃ saṃkara vyatikara doṣa nahīṃ ātā hai | ekameka ho jāneko saṃkara doṣa kahate haiṃ, paraspara viṣaya gamakarūpa vyatikara doṣa hotā hai arthāt eka dravyakā viṣaya dūsare dravyameṃ calā jāve jaise jīvakā guṇa pudralameṃ | isa gāthāmeṃ eka dūsare meṃ praveśa karanā jo vākya hai vaha kriyāvāna yā halana-calana karanevāle jīva aura puiloṃkī apekṣāse hai, āe huoṃko avakāśa denā yaha vākya sakriya dravya jīva pudgaloṃkā ni:kriya dravya ke milāpakī apekṣāse hai, nitya sarva kāla milake rahate haiṃ, yaha vākya niḥkriya dravya dharma, adharma, ākāśa aura kālakī apekṣāse hai | isa taraha chaḥ dravyake madhyameṃ apanī prasiddhi, pūjā va lābha va dekhe-sune anubhave hue kṛṣṇa, nīla, kāpota tīna aśubhaleśyāko ādi lekara sarva paradravyoṃke ālambana se utpanna jo saṃkalpa-vikalpa kī taraṃgamālā unase rahita tathā vītarāga nirvikalpa samādhise utpanna paramānandarūpa sukharasakā āsvāda aisā jo parama samatārasamaya bhāva usa svabhāvase jñānase prāpta hone yogya va usase pūrṇa śuddha pāriṇāmika paramabhāvako gaṃṇa karanevāle śuddha dravyārthikanayase yā niścayanaya se apane hī śarīrake bhītara prāpta jo śuddha jīvāstikāyarūpa jīva dravya hai so hī grahaṇa karane yogya hai tathā dūsare ekāṃtavādī jo rāga, dveṣa, mohasahita hai unake yahā~ vāyuko rokanerūpa ityādi jo sarva śūnya dhyānakā vyākhyāna hai yā ākāśakā dhyāna hai so sarva vyartha hī hai |
yahā~ saṃkalpavikalpakā bheda kahate haiṃ
bāharī cetana va acetana yā miśra dravyameṃ yaha pariṇāma karanā ki yaha mere haiṃ so saṃkalpa hai| bhītara harṣa yā viṣādakā yaha pariṇāma karanā ki maiṃ sukhī duḥkhī hū~ so vikalpa hai|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta aisā saṃkalpa-vikalpakā lakṣaṇa jānanā cāhiye | yahā~ koī kahe ki vītarāga nirvikalpasamādhimeṃ vītarāga kā viśeṣaṇa nirarthaka hai usakā samādhāna karate haiṃ ki vītarāga viśeṣaṇa nīce likhe kāraṇoṃse nirarthaka nahīṃ hai| eka to isase yaha batāyā hai ki ārta yā raudradhyānarūpa jo viṣaya kaṣāyake nimitta aśubha dhyāna haiṃ unakā yahā~ niṣedha hai| dūsare isase hetu va hetumadbhāvakā kathana kiyā gayā| tīsare karmadhāraya samāsa hai| cauthe bhāvanāke granthameṃ punarukta doṣako nahīṃ ginate haiṃ| pāṃcave svarūpakā viśeṣaṇa hai| chaṭhe dṛḍha karane kā abhiprāya hai| aisā jahā~ kahī vītarāga nirvikalpasamādhikā vyākhyāna ho, vahā~ yahī bhāva sarva sthānoṃmeṃ jānanā cāhiye | yadi vītarāga sarvajña nirdoṣa paramātmā śabda aise hī aura śabda kahī āveṃ aura koī aisā hī pūrva pakṣa kare to usakā samādhāna isī taraha karanā yogya hai | hetuhetumad bhāvakā yaha artha hai ki jisa kāraṇase vītarāga hai usa hī kāraṇa se nirvikalpa samādhi hai ||7||

saṃskṛta tātparya vṛtti gāthā-8 hadi bhavati | kā kauṃ | sattā | sattā kathaṃbhūtā | saccapadatyā sarvapadārthā | punarapi kathaṃbhūtā ? savissarūvā saviśvarūpā| punarapi kiṃ viśiṣṭā| aṇaṃtapajjāyā-anaṃtaparyāyā| punarapi ki viśiṣṇā | bhaṃgupyādadhuvattā-bhaṅgotpādadhrauvyātmikā | punaśca kiṃ viśiṣṭā ? ekkā-mahāsattārūpeṇakā | evaṃ paṃcaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭā sattā kiṃ niraṃkuśā ni:pratipakṣā bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ | sappaḍivakhāsapratipakṣaveti vārtika | tathāhi-svadravyādicatuṣṭayarūpeṇa sattāyāḥ paradravyādicatuṣṭayarūpeṇāsattā pratipakṣaḥ, sarvapadārthasthitāyāḥ sattāyāḥ ekapadārthasthitā pratipakṣaḥ, mūrto ghaṭaḥ sauvaṇoṃ ghaṭa: tāmro ghaṭaḥ ityādirūpeṇa saviśvarūpāyā nānarūpāyā ekaghaṭarūpā sattā pratipakṣaḥ, athavā vivakṣitaikaghaṭa varṇākārādirūpeṇa viśvarūpāyā: sattāyā vivakṣitaikagandhādirūpā pratipakṣa:, kālatyāpekṣayānantaparyāyāyā: sattāyā vivakṣinekaparyāyasattā pratipakṣaḥ, utpādavyayadhrauvyarūpeṇa trilakṣaṇāyāḥ sanāyā vivakṣitaikasyotpādasya vā vyayasya vā dhrauvyasya vā sattā pratipakṣa:, ekasyā mahāsattāyā avāntarasanā pratipakṣa iti śuddhasaṃgrahanayavivakṣāyāmekā mahāsattā aśuddhasaṃgrahanayavivakṣāyāṃ vyavahāranayavivakṣāyāṃ vā sarvapadārthasaviśvarūpāyavāntarasattā | sapratipakṣavyākhyānaṃ sarva naigamanayāpekṣayā jñātavyaṃ | evaṃ naiṃgamamaṃgrahavyavahāranayatrayeṇa yojanīyaṃ, athavaikā mahāsattā śuddhasaṃgrahanayena, sarvapadārthādyavāntarasanā vyavahānayeneti nayadvayavyākhyānaṃ kartavyaṃ | atra śuddhajīvāstikāyasaṃjñasya śuddhajīvadravyasya yā sattā sa~vāpādeyo bhavatīti bhāvārthaḥ ||8|| iti prathamasthale sattālakṣāgamukhyatvena vyākhyānena gāthā gatā|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha:-(ja) jo ( sallavakhaṇiyaṃ ) sat lakṣaṇavālā hai, ( uppādavvayadhuvattasaṃjuttaṃ ) utpāda-vyaya-dhauvya sahita hai, (vā) athavā ( guṇapajjayāsayaṃ ) guṇa
aura paryāyoṃkā āśrayarūpa hai, (taṃ) usako arthāt ukta tīna lakṣaṇa vāle ko (savaṇhū ) sarvajña bhagavān [ davvaṃ ] dravya ( bhaṇṇaṃti ) kahate haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-dravyakā lakṣaṇa sat rūpa dravyārthika nayase kiyā gayā hai | isase bauddhamatakā niṣedha hai jo saba vastuko asat mānate haiṃ| paryāyārthika nayase utpāda-vyaya-prauvya yā guṇaparyāyavāna lakṣaṇa kiyā gayā | isase kūṭastha nitya mānanevāle sāṃkhya aura naiyāyikakā niṣedha hai | sattā lakṣaṇa dravya hai aisā kahanese utpāda-vyaya-prauvya lakṣaṇa yā guṇa-paryāyavāna lakṣaṇa niyamase prāpta hotā hai| utpāda vyaya dhauvyayukta hai aisā lakṣaṇa karanese sattā lakṣaṇa yā guṇa paryāyavāna lakṣaṇa niyamase prāpta hotā hai | guṇaparyāyavāna lakṣaṇa karanese utyādavyaya- dhrauvya lakṣaṇa yā sattā lakṣaṇa niyamase prāpta hotā hai | eka koī lakṣaṇa ko kahate hue anya do lakṣaṇa kisa taraha prāpta hote haiṃ ? isakā uttara yaha hai ki ina tīnoṃ lakṣaṇoṃ meṃ paraspara avinābhāva hai arthāt saba eka dūsaremeṃ garbhita hai| yahā~ yaha bhāvārtha hai ki śuddha jīvadravya upādeya haiṃ jisakā śuddha sattā lakṣaṇa hai kyoṃki usameṃ mithyātva va rāgadveṣādi nahīṃ haiṃ| usī kā paryāya dṛṣṭi se agurulaghu guṇake dvārā ṣaḍguṇī hāni vṛddhi hote hue śuddha utyāda- vyaya-dhrauvya lakṣaṇa hai tathā akṛtrima jñānādi anantaguṇa rūpa va sahaja sukha siddha paryāvarūpa lakṣaṇa hai aise tīna lakṣaṇoṃko thāranevālā śuddha jīvāstikāya hai | isa vyākhyānase
kṣaṇika ekānta matake mānanevāle bauddha kā, nitya ekānta matako mānanevāle sāṃkhyakā, nitya tathā anitya donoṃkā ekānta mānanevāle naiyāyika aura mīmāṃsaka matakā nirākaraṇa hai| aisā hī kathana sarva jagaha anya matake vyākhyānake samaya jānanā cāhiye | kṣaṇika ekāntamatako kyoṃ dūṣaṇa dete haiṃ ? isa praśnakā uttara yaha hai ki jisane ghaṭa ādi banāne kī kriyā prāraṃbha kī vaha usa hī kṣaṇameṃ naṣṭa ho gayā taba usase ghaṭakī kriyā pūrṇa nahīṃ ho sakī ityādi | isī taraha nitya ekāṃta mānanemeṃ yaha dūṣaṇa hai ki jo baiṭhā hai use baiṭhā hī rahanā cāhiye, jo sukhī hai yaha sukhī hī rahegā, jo duḥkhī hai vaha duḥkhī hī rahegā ityādi | ṭaṃkotkīrṇa kūṭastha nitya padārtha honese unameṃ anya paryāya nahīṃ ho sakegī isī taraha paraspara apekṣā binā dravyaparyāya donoṃkā ekāṃta mānanese pūrvameṃ kahe hue donoṃ hī doṣa prāpta hoṃge| jainamatameṃ paraspara sāpekṣa dravyaparyāya mānanese koī dūṣaṇa nahīṃ āsakatā hai ||10||
isa taraha tīsare sthalameṃ dravyakā lakṣaṇa sattādi tīna prakāra hai isa sūcanākī mukhyatāse gāthā pūrṇa huī|

ṣaḍdradhya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-11 umpattī va viṇāso dabbassa ya ṇatthi asthi sambhāvo | viga-muṇyāda-dhuvattaṃ kareṃti tasseva pajjāyā ||11||
utpattirvā vināśo dravyasya ca nāstyasti sadbhāvaḥ |
vigamotpādadhruvatvaṃ kurvanti tasyaiva paryāyāḥ ||11|| dravyasya hi sahakramapravṛttaguṇaparyāyasadbhāvarūpasya trikālāvasthāyino'nādinidhanasya na samucchedasamudayau yuktau | atha tasyaiva paryāyāṇāṃ sahapravṛttibhājāṃ keṣāṃcit dhrauvyasaṃbhave'pyapareṣāṃ kramapravṛttibhājāṃ vināśasaṃbhavasaṃbhāvanamuphpannam | tato dravyārpaṇāyāmanutpādamanucchedaṃ satsvabhāvameva dravyaṃ, tadeva paryāyārthārpaṇāyāṃ sotpādaṃ socchedaṃ cāvaboddhavyam | sarvamidamanavadyañca dravyaparyāyāṇāmabhedāt ||11||

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta kareṃti tasseva pajjāyā-tasyaiva dravyasya vyayotpādadhruvatvaṃ kurvanti | ke kartāraḥ| paryāyāḥ | anena kimuktaṃ bhavati-dravyārthikanayena dravyasyaivotpādavyayadhrauvyāṇi na bhavanti kiṃ tu paryāyārthikanayena bhavanti | kena dṛṣṭāntena | suvarṇagorasamṛttikābālavṛddhakumārādipariṇatapuruṣeṣu bhaṃgatrayarūpeṇa, ityanena pūrvagāthābhaṇitameva nityaikāntamatanirākaraṇaṃ dṛḍhīkṛtaṃ | atra sūtre śuddhadravyārthikanayena naranārakādivibhāvapariṇāmotpattivināśarahitamapi paryāyārthikanayena vītarāganirvikalpasamādhisaṃbhavena sahajaparamānandarūpasukharasāsvādena svasaṃvedanajñānarūpaparyāyeṇa pariṇataṃ sahitaṃ śuddhajīvāstikāyasaṃjñaṃ śuddhajīvadravyamevopādeyamiti sūtratātparya ||11|| evaṃ dravyārthikapayāṃthāthikalakṣaṇanavadvayavyākhyānena sūtraṃ gataṃ |
hindī, tātparyavṛtti gāthā-11 utthānikā-āge ādhī gāthā pūrvārddhase dravyārthikanayake dvārā dravyakā lakṣaṇa tathā dūsarī ādhī uttarārddhase paryāyārthikanayake dvārā paryāyakā lakṣaṇa kahate haiṃ
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( davvasya) dravyakā ( uppattī va viṇāso) upajanā aura vinasanā (tthi) nahīṃ hotā hai (ya) kintu ( sambhāvo) usakā sattāmātra astipanā [ asthi ] hai | (tasseva) usīhīkī ( pajjāyā) paryāyeṃ ( vigamuppādadhuvattaṃ ) vyaya utpāda tathā śuvapanā ( kati) karatī haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-dravya anādi nidhana hai usameṃ dravyārthika nayase utpatti aura vināśa nahīṃ hotā hai, vaha apane astitvase sadā banā rahatā hai| itanā kahanese dravya kṣaṇika hai isa ekānta matakā nirākaraṇa kiyā| utpāda-vyaya-dhrauvyaphnā paryāyoṃkā paryāyārthika nayase hotā hai| usake dṛṣṭāṃta aneka haiṃ| jaise suvarṇa eka dravya hai usake kuṃḍala banāe taba kuṃḍalakā utpāda, savarṇakī pūrva avasthākā vyaya va suvarṇake sāmānya guṇoṃkā dhruvapanā rahā, gorasa eka dravya hai usakī malāī banāī taba malāīkā utpāda, patale dūdhapanekā vyaya va gorasake sāmānya guṇoṃkā dhruvapanā hai | miṭṭī eka dravya hai usakā ghaḍa़ā banāyā saba ghaḍa़kī pūrvadaśākā vyaya tathā miṭṭīpanekā dhruvapanā hai jo sarva daśāoṃmeṃ banā rahatā hai | puruṣa eka vyakti hai vaha bālakase kumāra huā | kumārase yuvāna va yuvānase vṛddha huā, ina avasthāoṃmeṃ jaba āgeko avasthā paidā huī taba pichalī avasthākā vyaya huā, puruṣapanā dhruva rahā | isase nitya ekāṃta matakā nirākaraṇa dṛḍha kiyā gayā | isa sūtrameṃ śuddha dravyārthika nayase jo jīvadravya nara-nāraka ādi vibhāva paryāyoṃkī utpatti aura vināśase rahita hai vahī paryāyārthika nayase vītarāga nirvikalpa samādhise utpanna jo sahaja paramānanda rūpa sukharasakā āsvādana rūpa jo svasaṃvedana jñānamaya paryāya usameṃ pariṇamana karate hue jo śuddha jīvāstikāya nāmadhārī śuddha jīva dravya hai vahī upādeya yā grahaṇa yogya hai, yaha sūtrakā tātparya hai |

viśeṣārtha-jaise dahī, dūdha ādi paryāyoṃke binā gorasa nahīṃ mila sakatā hai vaise paryāyoṃke binā dravya nahīṃ hotā hai | athavā jaise gorasake binā dahī dūdha ādi paryāyeṃ nahīṃ ho sakatīṃ vaise dravyake binā paryāya nahīṃ hotī haiṃ isīliye donoṃkā abheda hai | abheda naya se dravya aura paryāya meṃ bheda nahī hai isaliye hī dravya aura paryāya donoṃ meṃ ananyabhūta abhinna bhāva astitva rūpa sattā sarvajña ne kahī hai | athavā pichalī ādhī gāthākā yaha bhī artha hai ki dravya aura paryāyoṃ kā ekībhāvarūpa padārtha hai aisā śramaṇa kahate haiṃ| bhāva śabdako padārtha kahate haiṃ| jaise kahā hai 'dravyaparyāyātmako bhāvaḥ padārtho vastvasti' arthāt dravya paryāyarūpa bhāva yā padārtha yā vastu hotī hai|
