paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta bhāvassa ṇatthi ṇāso ṇatthi abhāvassa ceva uppādo| guṇa-pajjayesu bhāvā uppāda-vae pakuvvaṃti ||15||
bhāvasya nāsti nāśo nāsti abhāvasya caiva utpādaḥ |
guṇaparyāyeṣu bhāvā utpādavyayān prakurvanti ||15|| bhāvasya sato hi dravyasya na dravyatvena vināśaḥ, abhāvasyāsato'nyadravyasya na dravyatvenotpādaḥ | kintu bhāvāḥ santi dravyāṇi saducchedamasadutpādaṃ cāntareṇaiva guṇaparyāyeṣu vināśamutpādaṃ cārabhante | yathā hi ghṛtotpattau gorasasya sato na vināśaḥ, na cāpi gorasavyatiriktasyārthāntarasyāsataḥ utthādaḥ, kintu gorasasyaiva saducchedamasadutpādaṃ cānupalabhamānasya sparśarasagandhavarṇādiṣu pariṇāmiṣu guṇeṣu pūrvāvasthayā vinaśyatsūttarāvasthayā prādurbhavatsu naśyati ca navanītaparyāyo ghṛtaparyāya utpadyate tathā sarvabhāvānāmapīti ||15||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-15 anvayārtha—(bhāvasya ) bhāvakā ( satkā) ( nāśaḥ ) nāśa ( na asti ) nahī haiṃ ( ca ena ) tathā ( abhāvasya ) abhāvaka ra asatkā, ( utpāda) itpāda | na asti) nahīṃ hai, ( bhāvāḥ ) bhāva ( sat dravye ) ( guṇaparyāyeṣu ) guṇaparyāyoṃmeṃ ( utpādavyayān ) utpādavyaya ( prakurvanti ) karate haiṃ|
ṭīkā-yahā~ utpādameṃ asatke prādurbhāvakā aura vyayameṃ satke vināśakā niṣedha kiyā
bhāvakā–sat dravyakā-dravyarūpase vināśa nahīṃ hai, abhāvakā-asat anya dravyakādravyarūpase utpāda nahīṃ hai, parantu bhāva-sat dravye, satake vināśa aura asatke utpāda binā hī, guṇaparyāyoṃmeṃ vināśa aura utpāda karate haiṃ| jisa prakāra ghīkī utpattimeṃ gorasakāsatkā-vināśa nahīṃ hai tathā gorasase bhitra padārthāntarakā asatkā-utpāda nahīṃ hai, kintu gorasako hī satkā vināśa aura asatkā utpāda kiye binā hī, pūrva avasthāse vināśako prāpta honevāle aura uttara avasthāse utpanna honevāle sparśa-rasa-gaṃdha-varṇādika pariṇāmī guṇoṃmeṃ makkhanaparyāya vināśako prāpta hotī hai tathā ghī paryāya utpanna hotī hai, sarvabhāvoṃkā bhī usī prakāra vaisā hī hai ( arthāt samasta dravyoṃko navīna paryāyakī utpatti meṃ satkā vināśa nahīṃ hai tathā asatkā utpāda nahīṃ hai, kintu satkā vināśa aura asatkā utpāda kiye binā hī, pahalekī ( purānī ) avasthāse vināśako prāpta honevāle aura bādakī ( navīna ) avasthāse utpanna honevāle pariṇāmī guṇoṃmeṃ pahalekī paryāyakā vināśa aura bādakī paryāyakī utpatti hotī hai|)

ṣadravya--paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-15 atha sati dharmiṇi dharmāściṃtyante dravyaṃ nāsti saptabhaṃgā: kasya bhaviṣyatīti bauddhamatānusāri - śiṣyāṇa pūrvapakṣe kṛte sati parihārarūpeṇa gāthāpātanikāṃ karoti-dravyārthikanayena sata: padārthasya vināśo nāstyasata utpādo nāstītivacanena kṣaṇikaikāntabauddhamataṃ niṣedhayati
bhāvasya ṇasthi ṇāso gasthi yā bhāvassa ceva uppādo-yathā gorasasya gorasadravyarūpeṇotpādo nāsti vināśopi nāsti | guṇapajjaemu va bhāvā uppādavaye pakuvvaṃti-tathāpi varṇarasagaṃdhamparśaguṇeṣu varṇarasagaṃdhāṃtarādirūpeṇa pariṇāmighu naśyati navanītaparyāya utpadyate na ghṛtaparyāyaḥ tathā mano vidyamānabhāvasya padārthasya jīvādidravyasya dravyārthikanayena dravyatvena nāsti vināśa:, nāstyasato'vinamānabhāvasya padārthasya jīvādidravyasya dravyārthikanayena dravyatvenotpādaḥ tathāpi guṇaparyāyeṣvadhikaraṇabhūteṣū bhāvā: padārthā jīvādi ṣaḍadravyāṇi kartṛṇi paryāyārthikanayena vivakṣitanaranārakādidvayaṇukādigatisthityavagāhanavartanādinaḥ yayā sāṃbhavamurādanā- māna ' aba ṣaḍa़dravyeṣṇu madhye śuddhapāriṇāmikaparamabhāvagrāhakeṇa śuddhadravyārthikanayeneti vā pāṭhaḥ, niścayanayena krodhamānabhāyālobhadṛś śrutānubhūtabhogākāṃkṣārūpanidānabaṃdhādiparabhāvaśūnyamapi utpādavyayarahitena vā pāṭhaḥ | āyatarahitena cidānaṃdaikasvabhāvena bharitāvasthaṃ śuddhajīvāstikāyābhidhānaṃ śuddhātmadravyaṃ dhyātavyamityabhiprāyaḥ ||15|| iti dvitīyasaptakamadhye prathamasthale auddha prati dravyasthāpanārtha sūtragāthā gatā|
hiṃdī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-15 utthānikā-āge bauddha matānusārī śiṣyane yaha śaṃkā kī yā pūrva pakṣa kiyā ki yadi dharmī koī ho to usake dharma yā svabhāvoṃkā vicāra karanā cāhiye | yadi dravya hī nahīṃ hai to sāta bhaṃga kisake hoṃge? isakā uttara dete hue ācārya kahate haiṃ ki dravyārthikanayase sat padārthakā nāśa nahīṃ hai aura na asat padārthako utpatti hai | isa taraha bauddhoṃke kṣaṇika ekāṃta matakā niṣedha karate haiṃ
___ anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( bhāvassa ) satrūpa padārthakā ( ṇāso) nāśa ( ṇasthi ) nahīṃ hotā hai, ( ceva ) vaise hī ( abhāvassa ) abhāvakā yā avastukā yā asatkā ( uppādo) utpāda yā janma ( ṇasthi ) nahīṃ hotā hai| (bhāṣā) padārtha ( guṇapajjayesu ) apane guṇoṃkī paryāyoṃmeṃ ( uppādavae ) utpāda va vyaya ( pakuvvaṃti ) karate rahate haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-jaise gorasa eka dravya hai usakā apane gorasa nāmake dravyarūpase na utpāda hai, na nāśa hai tathāpi gorasake varṇa, rasa, gaṃdha, sparśa guṇoṃmeṃ anya varṇa, rasa, gaṃdha, sparśarūpa pariṇamana hote hue usa gorasakī jaba navanīta nāmakī paryāya nāśa hotī hai taba ghṛta nāmakī

ghaṃcāstikāya prākṛta paryāya upajatī hai taise hī satarūpa sadā rahanevāle jo jīva ādi chaḥ dravya haiṃ unakā dravyārthikanayase kabhī nāśa nahīṃ hotā hai aura jo asat yā nahīṃ vidyamāna jīvādi padārtha haiṃ unakā dravyārthikanayase dravyarūpase kabhī utpāda nahīṃ hotā hai tathāpi guṇoṃkī paryāyoṃke adhikaraṇameṃ jīva ādi chahoṃ dravya paryāyārthikanayase yathāsaṃbhava utpāda vyaya karate rahate haiṃ| jaise jīvoṃmeṃ nara nārakādi paryāyeṃ, pudgaloṃmeṃ dviaṃṇuka skaṃdha ādi paryāyeṃ hotī hai va dharmameṃ gatisahakārapanā, adharmameṃ sthitisahakārīpanā, ākāśameṃ avagāha sahakārīpanā tathā kālameṃ vartanā sahakārīpanā honese paryāyeṃ hotī haiṃ | yahā~ cha: dravyoṃke madhyameṃ śuddha pāriṇāmika paramabhāvako grahaṇa karanevālī śuddha dravyārthikanayase athavā niścayanayase krodha, māna, māyā, lobha tathā dekhe sune va anubhava kie hue bhogoṃkī icchā rūpa nidāna baṃdha ādi para-bhāvoṃse śūnya honepara bhī athavā utpāda va vyaya rahita honepara bhī anādi anaṃta cidānaṃdamaya eka svabhāvase bhare hue jīvāstikāya nāmake śuddha ātmadravyako dhyānā cāhiye, yaha abhiprāya hai| isa taraha dūsare saptakameṃ bauddhoṃ ke liye dravyakī sthāpanā karate hue sūtra kahā ||15||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-16 atra bhāvaguṇaparyāyāḥ prajñāpitāḥ bhāvā jīvādīyā jīvaguṇā cedaṇā ya uvaogo| sura-ṇara-ṇāraya-tiriyā jīvassa ya pajjayā bahugā ||16||
bhāvā jīvādhā jīvaguṇāścetanā copayogaḥ ||

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana viśedhārtha--jīva, pudgala, dharmaḥ adharma, ākāśa, kāla-ye cha dravya hai | unameṃ dharmādi cāra dravyoṃke guṇa paryāya āge yathāsthāna viśeṣarūpase kaheṃge| yahā~para pahale jīvake guṇa kahate haiṃ| jīvake guṇa, cetanā aura upayoga haiṃ| yaha saṃgraha vākya, samudāya kathana tātparya kathana yā saṃpiṃḍitārtha kathana jānanā | cetanāke do bheda haiṃ-śuddhacetanā aura aśuddhacetanā tathā upayogake do bheda haiṃ-jñānopayoga, darśanopayoga | jñānacetanāko śuddhacetanā kahate haiṃ | karmacetanā aura karmaphalacetanāko aśuddhacetanā kahate haiṃ | ina tīna prakāra cetanāke svarūpako āge cetanāke adhikārameṃ vistārase kaheṃge | jñānopayoga savikalpa hai, darśanopayoga nirvikalpa hai| jñānopayogake āṭha bheda haiṃ-mati, śruta, avadhi, mana:paryaya aura kevala-pā~ca samyagjñāna
aura kumati, kuśruta, vibhaṃgajñāna ye tīna ajñāna | inameṃ kevalajñāna sarva āvaraṇa rahita śuddha hai | bākīke sāta jñāna matijñānādi kṣāyopaśamika haiṃ, āvaraṇa sahita haiṃ tathā aśuddha haiṃ| darśanopayoga cāra prakārakā hai-cakṣudarśana, acakṣudarśana, avadhidarśana, kevaladarśana | unameṃ devanadarśana adhikā sādharaṇa rahiṭa hai tathā śuddha hai | cakṣu ādi tīna kṣāyopaśamika haiṃ| āvaraṇasahita haiṃ tathā aśuddha haiṃ| aba jīvakī paryāyeṃ kahate haiṃ--deva, manuṣya, nārakī, tiryaṃca ye jīvakī vibhāva dravyaparyāyeṃ bahuta prakārakī hotī haiṃ| paryāyoṃke do bheda haiṃdravyaparyāya aura guṇaparyāya | dravyaparyāyakā lakṣaṇa kahate haiṃ--aneka dravyasvarūpako eka tāke jñānakā jo kāraṇa ho use dravyaparyāya kahate haiṃ jaise aneka vastuoṃ se banī huī ko eka yāna yā vāhana kahanā | yaha dravyaparyāya do prakāra kī hai-eka samāna jātīya, dūsarī asamāna jātīya | samāna jātīya use kahate haiṃ ki do, tīna, cāra ādi paramāṇurūpa pudgaladravya milakara jo skandha ho jāte haiṃ ve acetanake sātha acetanake saṃbandhase hote haiṃ isaliye samāna jātīya dravyaparyāya kahalāte haiṃ | aba asamāna jātīyako kahate haiṃ- jīva jaba dūsarī gatiko jātā hai taba navīna śarīrarūpa nokarma pugaloṃko grahaṇa karatā hai usase manuṣya deva ādi paryāyakī utpatti hotī hai | cetanarūpa jīvake sātha acetana rūpa pudgalake milanese jo paryāya huī yaha asamāna jātīya dravya paryāya kahī jātī hai | ye samāna jātīya tathā asamāna jātīya aneka dravyoṃkī ekarūpa dravya paryāyeṃ jīva aura pudgalomeṃ hī hotī haiṃ tathā ye aśuddha hotī haiṃ, kyoṃki aneka dravyoṃke paraspara milanese huī haiṃ| dharma, adharma, ākāśa, kālameṃ paraspara milanerūpa koī paryāya nahīṃ hotī hai | na paradravyake sambandhase koī aśuddha paryāya hotī hai |
__ aba guṇa paryāyoṃko kahate haiṃ | ve bhī do prakāra haiṃ-svabhāva guṇaparyāya, vibhāva guṇaparyāya | guṇake dvārā andayarūpa ekatāke jñānakā kāraṇa rūpa jo paryāya ho use guṇaparyāya kahate haiṃ, vaha eka dravyake bhītara hī hotī hai jaise pudgalakā dṛṣṭāṃta āmake phalameṃ hai ki

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta usake varṇaguṇakī harī pīlī ādi paryāyeṃ hotī haiṃ | hara eka paryāyameṃ varṇaguṇakī ekatākā jñāna hai isase yaha guṇaparyāya hai | jīvake matijñāna śrutajñāna ādirūpase jñānakā anyajñānarūpa honā so jñāna guṇakī paryāyeṃ haiṃ | haraeka paryāyameṃ jñāna guṇakī ekatākā bodha hai | ye jīva
aura pugalakī vibhāva guṇa paryāyeṃ jānanī cāhiye | svabhāva guṇaparyāyeṃ agurulaghu guṇako ṣaḍguṇī hāni vṛddhirūpa haiṃ jo sarva dravyoṃmeṃ sādhāraṇa pāī jātī haiṃ| isa taraha svabhāva vibhāva guṇaparyāyoṃko jānanā cāhiye| athavā dūsarī tarahase paryāyoṃke do bheda haiṃarthaparyāya aura vyaṃjanaparyāya | inameṃ arthaparyāyeṃ atyanta sūkṣma kṣaṇakṣaṇa meṃ hokara naṣṭa honevālī hotī haiṃ jo vacanake gocara nahīṃ hotī haiṃ | vyaṃjanaparyāyeṃ jo sthūla hotī haiṃ ve derataka rahanevālī vacanagocara va alpajñānīko dṛṣṭigocara bhī hotī haiṃ| ye vibhāvarūpa vyaṃjanaparyāya jīvakī nara nāraka ādi haiṃ tathā svabhāva vyaṃjanaparyāya jīvakī siddha avasthā hai | aśuddha arthaparyāya jīvake kaṣāyoṃkī hāni vṛddhi honese viśuddhirūpa tathā saṃkleṣarūpa yā śubha-aśubha chaḥ leśyāke sthānoṃmeṃ hone vālī jānanī cāhiye | pudgalakī vibhāva arthaparyāyeṃ do aṇu ādike skaṃdhoṃmeṃ varṇādise anya varṇādirūpa honerūpa haiṃ| pudgalakī vibhāva vyaṃjanaparyāya do aṇu ādike skaṃdha haiṃ jo cirakālataka rahanevāle haiṃ| śuddha arthaparyāyeṃ aguruladhuguṇakī ṣaṭguṇī hāni vṛddhi rūpa haiṃ jinako pahale hī svabhāvaguṇaparyāyake vyākhyānake samaya sarva dravyoṃmeṃ kaha cuke haiṃ| ye arthaparyāyeṃ aura vyaṃjanaparyāyeṃ pahale kahī huī 'jesiṃ atyi sahāo' ityādi gāthāmeṃ jo jīva pudalakī svabhāva vibhāva dravya paryāya tathā svabhāva vibhāva guṇaparyāya kahī gaī haiṃ unameṃ hī garbhita haiṃ tathā yahā~ isa gāthāmeṃ jo dravyaparyāyeṃ aura guṇaparyāyeṃ kahī haiṃ unake madhyameṃ bhī tiṣṭhatī haiṃ taba phira alaga kyoṃ kahī gaī haiṃ ? isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki-artha paryāyeṃ mātra eka samaya rahanevālī kahī gaī haiṃ tathā vyaṃjanaparyāyeṃ cirakāla rahanevālī kahī gaī haiṃ isa kālakṛta bhedako batāneke liye kahī gaī haiṃ| yahā~ yaha bhāva hai ki siddharūpa paryāyameṃ pariṇamana karanevāle śuddha jīvāstikāya nāmake śuddhātma dravyako hī grahaṇa karanā yogya hai ||16||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-17 idaṃ bhāvanāśābhāvotpādaniṣedhodāharaṇam maṇusattaṇeṇa gaṭṭho dehī devo havedi idaro vā | ubhayastha jīvabhāvo ṇa ṇassadi ṇa jāyade aṇṇo ||17||

64
padravya-paṃcāstikāthavarṇana manuṣyatvena naṣṭo dehī devo bhavati itaro vā |
ubhayatra jīvabhāvo na naśyati na jāyate'nyaḥ ||17|| pratisamayasaṃbhavadagurulaghuguṇahānivṛddhinirvṛttasvabhāvaparyāyasaṃtatyavicchedenaikena sopādhinā manuṣyatvalakṣaṇena paryāyeṇa vinaśyati jīvaḥ, tathāvidhena devatvalakṣaṇena nārakatiryaktvalakṣaṇena vānyena paryāyeṇotpadyate | na ca manuṣyatvena nāśe jīvatvenāpi naśyati, devatvādinotpāde jīvatvenāpyutpadyate, kiṃ tu saducchedamasadutpādamantareṇeva tathā vivartata iti ||17||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-17 anvayārtha--( manuṣyatvena ) manuṣyatvase ( manuṣya paryāya se ) ( naṣṭaḥ ) naṣṭa huā ( dehī ) dehī ( jība ) ( deva: vā itaraḥ ) deva athavā anya paryāya rūpa ( bhavati ) hotā hai. ( abhayatra ) una donoṃmeṃ ( jīvabhāvaḥ ) jīvabhāva ( na naśyati ) naṣṭa nahīṃ hotā aura ( anya:) dūsarā jīvabhāva ( na jāyate ) utpanna nahīṃ hotā|
ṭīkā—'bhāvakā nāśa nahīṃ hotā aura abhāvakā utpāda nahīṃ hotā' usakā yaha udāharaṇa
pratisamaya honevālī agurulaghuguṇakī hānivṛddhise utpanna honevālī svabhāvaparyāyoṃkī saṃtatikā viccheda na karanevālī ekasopādhika manuṣyatvasvarūpa paryāyase jīva vināśako prāpta hotā hai
aura tathāvidha ( svabhāvaparyāyoṃke pravāhako na toḍanevālī sopādhika ) devatvasvarūpa, nārakatvasvarūpa yā tiryaścatvasvarūpa anya paryāyase utpanna hotā hai | vahā~ aisā nahīṃ hai ki manuṣyatvase vinaṣṭa hone para jīvatvase bhī naṣṭa hotā hai aura devatva ādise utpāda hone para jīvatvase bhī utpanna hotā hai kintu satke uccheda aura asatke utpāda vinā hī tadanusāra vivartana ( parivartana, pariṇamana ) karatā hai ||17||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-17 __ atha paryāyārthikanayenotpādavināśayorapi dravyārthikanayenotpādavināśau na bhavata iti samarthayatimaṇusattaṇeṇa ṇaṭṭho dehī devo va hodi idaro vā-manuṣyatvena manuṣyaparyāyeṇa naṣṭo vinaṣṭo mṛto dehī saṃsārī jīva: puṇyavaśāddevo bhavati svakīyakarmavaśāditaro vā nārakatiryagmanuṣyo bhavati | ubhayattha jīvabhāvo ṇa ṇassade ṇa jāyade aṇṇo-ubhayatra korthaḥ manuṣyabhave devabhave vā paryāyārthikanayena manuṣyabhave naṣṭe dravyārthikanayena na vinaśyati tathaiva paryāyārthikanayena devaparyāye jāte sati dravyārthikanayenānyo'pūrvo na jāyate notpadyate kiṃtu sa eva | kosauṃ ? jīvabhāvo jīvapadārthaḥ | evaṃ paryāyārthikanayenotpāpadavyayatvepi dravyārthikanayenotpādavyayatvaṃ nāstīti siddhaṃ | anena vyākhyānena kṣaṇikaikāntamataṃ nityaikāntamataṃ ca niṣiddhamiti sūtrārthaḥ ||17||

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-17 utthānikā-āge yaha samarthana karate haiṃ ki yadyapi paryāyārthika nayase dravyameṃ utpatti aura vināśa hote haiṃ| to bhī dravyārthika nayase utpatti aura vināśa nahīṃ hote haiṃ
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( dehī ) yaha dehadhārī saṃsārī jīva ( maṇusattaṇeṇa ) manuṣyapanekī paryāyase ( ṇaṭṭho) naṣṭa hotā huā ( devo) deva (vā) athavā ( idaro) dūsarā koī ( havedi) paidā hojātā hai | ( ubhayatta ) donoṃhī avasthāoṃmeṃ ( jīvabhāvo) jīva dravya ( ṇa ṇassadi ) na to nāśa hotā hai (ṇa apaṇo jāyade ) na dūsarā koī utpanna hotā hai|
viśeṣārtha-yaha saṃsārī jīva yadi manuṣya dehameṃ ho aura mare taba yaha puṇyake vaśase deva athavā apane apane karmake vaśase dūsarā koī nārakī, tiryaṃca yā manuṣya ho jātā hai yadyapi paryāyakī apekṣā manuṣya bhavakā nāśa huā parantu dravyakī apekṣā jisane manuṣyabhava dhārā thā usa jīvakā nāśa nahīṃ huā, vaise hī yadyapi paryāyārthika nayase deva paryāya utpanna huī tathāpi dravyārthika nayase koī dūsarā apūrva nahīṃ paidā huā kintu vahī jīva hai ho pahale manuṣya paryāyameṃ thā, isaliye yaha sāta sinda hai ki pariyārthita nāse utpāda- vyaya hone para bhī dravyārthika nayase utpāda vyaya nahīṃ hote haiṃ| isa vyākhyānase kṣaṇika ekāta matakā tathā nitya ekāṃta matakā niṣedha kiyā gayā ||17||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-18 atra kathaṃcidvyayotpādavattve'pi dravyasya sadāvinaṣṭānutpannatvaṃ khyāpitam
so ceva jādi maraṇaṃ jādi ṇa ṇaṭṭho ṇa ceva uppaṇṇo | uppaṇṇo ya viṇaṭṭho devo maṇusu tti pajjāo ||18||
sa ca eva jātiṃ maraṇaṃ yāti na naṣṭo na caivotpannaḥ |
utpannaśca vinaṣṭo devo manuṣya iti paryāyaḥ ||18|| yadeva pūrvottaraparyāyavivekasaṃparkāpāditāmubhayomavasthāmātmasātkurvāṇamucchidhamānamutpadyamānaṃ ca dravyamālakṣyate, tadeva tathāvidhobhayāvasthāvyāpinā pratiniyataikavastutvanibandhanabhūtena svabhāvenāvinaṣṭamanutpannaṃ vā vedyate | paryāyāstu tassa pūrvapūrvapariṇāmopamoṃttarottarapariṇāmotpādarūpāḥ praṇāśasaṃbhavadharmāṇo'bhidhīyante | te ca vastutvena dravyādapṛthagbhūtā evoktāḥ | tataḥ paryāyaiḥ sahaikavastutvājjāyamānaṃ mriyamāṇamapi jīvadravyaṃ sarvadānutpannāvinaṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyam | devamanuṣyādiparyāyāstu kramavartitvādupasthitātivāhitasvasamaya utpadyante vinaśyanti ceti ||18||

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
hindī samayavyākhyā gāthā-18 anvayārtha (saḥ ca eva ) vahī ( jāti) janma ko aura vahī ( maraṇaṃ yāti ) mṛtyu ko prāpta karatā hai tathāpi ( na eva utpannaḥ ) vaha utpanna nahīṃ hotā ( ca ) aura ( na naṣṭaḥ ) naṣṭa nahīṃ hotā, ( deva: manuṣyaḥ ) deva, manuṣya ( iti paryāya: ) aisī paryāya ( utpannaḥ ) utpanna hotī hai (ca) aura ( vinaṣṭaḥ) vinaṣṭa hotī hai|
ṭīkā-yahā~, dravya kathaṃcit vyaya aura utpādavālā hone para bhī usakā sadaiva avinaṣṭapanā aura anutpatrapanā kahā hai|
jo dravya pūrva paryāyake viyogase aura uttara paryāyake saṃyogase honavālī ubhaya avasthāoṃko ātmasāt ( apane rūpa) karatā huā vinaṣṭa hotā aura upajatā dikhāī detā hai, vahī ( dravya) vaisī ubhaya avasthāomeṃ vyāpta honevālā jo pratiniyata-eka-vastutvake kāraṇabhūta svabhāva usake dvārā ( usa svabhāvakī apekṣāse) avinaṣṭa evaṃ anutpanna jñāta hotā hai, usakī paryāyeṃ pūrva-pūrva pariṇāmake nāśarūpa aura uttara-uttara pariṇāmake utpādarūpa honese vināśa utpādadharmavālī kahī jātī haiṃ, aura ve ( paryāye ) vasturūpase dravyase apṛthagbhūta hī kahī gaī haiṃ| isaliye, paryāyoṃke sātha ekavastupaneke kāraṇa janmatā aura maratā hone para bhī jīvadravya sarvadā anutpatra evaṃ avinaṣṭa hī dekhanā ( śraddhā karanā ), deva-manuṣyādi paryāyeṃ upajatī haiṃ aura vinaṣṭa hotī hai kyoṃki ve kramavartī honese unakā svasamaya upasthita hotā hai aura bīta jātā hai ||18||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-18 atha tamevārthaṃ nayadvayena punarapi draḍhayati,-so ce jādi-sa ca eva jīvapadārtha: paryāyārthikanayena devaparyāyarūpāṃ jātimutpattiṃ jādi-yāti gacchati sa caiva maraṇaṃ-maraṇaṃ yāti | ṇa ṇaho ṇa uppapaṇo| dravyārthikanayena punarna naṣṭo na cotpannaḥ | tarhi kosau naṣṭaḥ kosau utpanna ? uppaṇṇo ya viṇaṭṭho maṇusoti pajjāo-paryāyārthikanayena devaparyāya utpanno manuṣyaparyāyo vinaṣṭa: | nanu yadyutpādavināśau tarhi tasyaiva padārthasya nityatvaṃ kathaṃ ? nityatvaṃ tarhi tasyaivotpādavyayadvayaṃ ca kathaṃ parasparaviruddhamidaṃ śītoṣṇavaditi pūrvapakṣe parihāramāhuḥ | yeṣāṃ mate sarvathaikāntena nityaṃ vastu kṣaṇikaṃ vā teṣāṃ dūṣaṇamidaṃ | kathamiti cet ? yenaiva rūpeṇa nityatvaṃ tenaivānityatvaṃ na ghaṭate, yena ca rūpaṇānityatvaṃ tenaiva nityatvaṃ na ghaṭate | kasmāt ? ekasvabhāvatvādvastunastanmate | jainamate punaranekasvabhāvaṃ vastu tena kāraṇena dravyārthikanayena dravyarūpeṇa nityatvaṃ ghaṭate paryāyārthikanayena paryāyarūpeṇānityatvaṃ ca ghaṭate | tau ca dravyaparyāyau parasparaṃ sāpekṣau, tacca sāpekṣatvaṃ "pajjayarahiyaṃ davyaṃ dabavimuttā ya pajjayā ṇatthi' ityādi pūrva vyākhyātaṃ tena kāraṇena dravyārthikaparyāyārthikanayayo: parasparagauṇamukhyabhāvavyākhyānādekadevadattasya janyajanakādibhāvavat ekasyāpi dravyasya nityānityatvaṃ ghaṭate, nāsti virodha iti sūtrārthaḥ ||18||

﻿________________

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-18 utthānikā-āge ina hī arthako do nayoṃse phira bhī dṛḍha karate haiṃ
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( so ceva jādi ) vahī jīva utpanna hotā hai jo ( maraṇaṃ jādi ) maraṇako prāpta hotā hai ( ṇa ṇaṭṭho) vāstavameṃ jīva na naṣṭa huā (ṇa caiva uppaṇṇo) aura na paidā huā ( devo maṇusutti pajjāo) deva yā manuṣya paryāya hī ( uppaṇṇo ya viṇaṭṭho) utpanna aura nāśa huī hai |
viśeṣārtha-paryāyārthika nayase yahī jīva devaparyāya rūpase utyattiko prāpta hotā hai jo pahale manuṣmā kāryāta rūpāśa hotā hai pākṣika go na koī jīva naṣṭa huā na paidā huā hai, taba phira kauna naṣṭa huā va kauna paidā huā? isake liye kahate haiṃ ki paryāyārthikanayase devaparyāya utpanna huī aura manuṣya paryāya naṣṭa huī| yahā~ koī śaṃkā karatā hai ki yadi padārtha meṃ utpatti aura vināśa hotā hai taba vaha nitya kisa taraha rahā aura yadi padārtha nitya hai to usameṃ utpāda vyaya kisa taraha haiṃ, ye donoṃ bāteṃ viruddha haiṃ jaise śīta aura uṣṇakā virodha hai | isa pūrva pakṣake karane para ācārya isakā samādhāna karate haiṃ ki jinake matameṃ sarvajñā ekāṃtase padārtha nitya hī hai yā kṣaṇika hī hai unake matameṃ yaha dūṣaṇa āsakatā hai, kyoṃki jisa apekṣāse nityapanā hai usī hī apekṣāse anityapanā nahīṃ ghaṭa sakatā hai tathā jisa apekṣāse anityapanā hai usa hī apekṣāse nityapanā nahīṃ ghaṭa sakatā hai, kyoṃki unake matameṃ vastu eka rūpa hī mānī hai | jainamatameṃ padārthako aneka svabhāva rūpa mānā hai, isaliye dravyārthikanayase dravyapanekī apekṣā vastumeṃ nityapanā ghaṭatā hai aura paryāyārthika gyase paryāyakī apekṣā vastumeṃ anityapanā ghaṭa jātā hai| ye dravya paryāya donoṃ paraspara apekṣā sahita haiṃ| vaha sāpekṣapanā pahale hī isa gāthāmeṃ 'pajjayarahiyaṃ davvaṃ davavimuttā ya pajjayā pāsthi' kahā jā cukā hai| isa kāraṇase dravyārthika aura paryāyārthika nayase paraspara mukhyagauṇa bhāvase vyākhyāna karanese eka hī dravyameṃ nitya aura anityapanā donoṃ ghaṭa jāte haiṃ jaise eka devadattameṃ hī pitā va putrapanā siddha hai | isameṃ koī virodha nahīṃ hai ||18||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-19 atra sadasattoravināśānutpādau sthitipakṣatvenopanyastau |

saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-19 athaivaṃ dravyārthikanayana sato vināśo nāstyasata utpādo nāstīti sthitamiti niścinotievaṃ sado viṇāso asado bhāvasya ṇasthi uppādo-evaṃ pūrvoktagāthādvayavyākhyānena yadyapi paryāyārthikanayena naranārakādirūpeṇotpādavināśatvaṃ ghaṭate tathāpi dravyārthikanayena sato vidyamānasya vināśo nāstyasataścāvidyābhānasya nāstyutpāda: | kasya ? bhāvasya jīvapadārthasya | nanu yadyutpādavyoṃ na bhavatastarhi palyatrayaparimāṇaṃ bhogabhūmau sthitvā paścāt mriyate, yat trayastriṃśatsāgaropamāṇi devaloke nārakaloke tiṣṭhati paścānpriyata ityādi vyākhyānaṃ kathaṃ ghaṭate ? tāvadiyo jīvāṇaṃ devo maṇusoti gadiṇāmo-tāvatpalyatrayādirūpaṃ parimāṇaṃ yajjīvānāṃ kathyate devo manuṣya iti yosau gatināmakamoṃdayajanitaparyāyastasya tatparimāṇaṃ, na ca tīvadravyasyeti veṇudaṇḍavannāsti virodhaḥ | tathāhiyathā mahato veṇudaṇḍasyānekāni parvāṇi svasthāneṣu bhāvabhāji vidyamānāni bhavanti paraparvasthāneṣvabhābhāñjavidyamānāni bhavanti vaṃśadaṇḍastu sarvaparvasthāneṣvanvayarūpeṇa vidyamānopi prathamaparvarūpeṇa dvitīyaparve nāstītyavidyamānopi bhaṇyate, tathā veṇudaṇḍasthānīyajīve naranārakādirūpāḥ parvasānīyā anekaparyāyā: svakīyāyu:karmodayakāle vidyamānā bhavanti parakīyaparyāyakāle cāvidyamānā bhavanti jīvaścānvayarūpeṇa sarvaparvasthānīyasarvaparyāyeṣu vidyamānopi manuṣyādiparyāyarūpeṇa devādiparyāyeṣu nāstītyavidyamānopi bhaṇyate | sa eva nityaḥ sa evānityaḥ kathaṃ ghaṭata iti cet | yathaikasya devadattasya putravivakṣākāle pitṛvivakṣā gauṇā pitṛvivakṣākāle putravivakṣā gauṇā, tathaikasya jīvasya jīvadravyasya vā dravyārthikanayena nityatvavivakṣākāle paryāyarūpeṇānityatvaṃ gauṇaṃ paryāyarūpeṇānitya-tvavivakṣākāle dravyarūpeṇa nityatvaṃ gauṇaṃ | kasmāt | vivakṣito mukhya iti vacanāt | atra paryāyarūpeṇānityatvepi śuddhadravyārthikanayenāvinaśvaramanantajñānādirūpaṃ śuddhajīvāstikāyābhidhānaṃ śuddhātmadravyaṃ rāgādiparihāreṇopādeyarūpeṇa bhāvanīyamiti bhāvārthaḥ ||19|| evaṃ bauddhamatanirākaraṇārthamekasūtragāthā prathamasthale pūrva bhaṇitā tasya vivaraṇārthaṃ dvitīyasthale gāthācatuṣṭayaṃ gatam |

anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( evaṃ) isa taraha jaisā pahale kaha cuke haiṃ (sado jīvassa) sat padārtha jīvakā (viṇāso) nāśa aura ( asado) asat padārtha jīvakā ( uppādo) janma ( sthi) nahīṃ hotā hai | ( jīvāṇaṃ ) saṃsārī jīvoṃkī ( tāvadio) jo itane pramāṇa sthiti hai so ( devo maṇusoti gadiṇāmo) unake deva yā manuṣyagati nāma karmaka udayakā vipāka hai|

ṣaḍchṣya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana viśeṣārtha-pahale tīna gāthāoṃmeṃ yaha kaha cuke haiṃ ki yadyapi paryāyārthikarayase jīva padārtha kā naranāraka ādi slapa se utpāda aura vināśa ghaṭatā hai tathāpi dravyārthikanayase satrūpa jo vidyamāna padārtha usakā vināśa nahīṃ hotā hai aura na asatrūpa avidhamāna padārthakā janma hotā hai| yahā~ koī śaṃkā karatā hai ki jīvakā janmamaraṇa nahīṃ hotā hai to phira yaha vyākhyāna kaise siddha hotā hai ki yaha jīva tīna palya pramāṇa bhogabhūmimeṃ ṭhaharakara phira maratā hai athavā taiṃtīsa sāgara pramāṇa devagati yā narakagatimeṃ rahatā hai phira maratā hai? isakā uttara yaha hai ki yaha jo tīna palya ādikī sthiti jīvoṃkī kahī gaī hai so deva yā manuṣyagati nāmā nāmakarmake udayase utpanna jo deva yā manuṣyakī paryāya usakī sthitikā parimāṇa hai, na ki jīva dravyakā | bāṃsakī lakaḍa़īke dṛṣṭāṃtase isameṃ koī virodha nahīṃ hai | jaise bahuta baḍa़e bāṃsakī lakaḍa़īmeṃ bahuta gāṃṭhe apane-apane para sthāna vidyamāna haiṃ, ve hī gāṃṭhe paraspara dūsarī gāṃṭhoṃpara nahīṃ maujūda haiṃ arthāt pratyeka gāṃṭha yā parva bhinna bhinna apanī sattā rakhatī hai parantu bāṃsakī lakaḍa़ī sarva hī paryoṃ meṃ anvayarūpase vidyamāna hai to bhī jaisī pahalī parvameṃ hai vaisī dūsarī parvake sthānameṃ nahīṃ hai yaha bhī kaha sakate haiṃ, taise hī bā~sakī lakaḍa़īke samāna isa jīta nāmā padārthameṃ paॉli. samāna narabāraka ādi aneka paryāyeṃ apane-apane āyukarmake udayake kālameṃ vidyamāna rahatī haiṃ| ye hī paryāyeṃ paraspara eka dūsareke paryāyake kālameṃ vidyamāna nahīṃ haiṃ-sarva paryāyeṃ bhinna-bhinna haiṃ tathā yaha jīva anvayarūpa se sarva paryoṃ ke samāna apanī sarva paryāyoṃ meṃ vidyamāna hai to bhī manuṣyādi paryāyake rūpase devādi paryāyoṃmeṃ nahīṃ hai aisā bhī kaha sakate haiṃ arthāt vahī jīva nitya hai, vahī jīva anitya hai yaha siddha hotā hai| kisa taraha ? so kahate haiṃ-jaise eka devadattako jaba putrakī apekṣāse dekhā jāyagā taba usameṃ pitāpanekī apekṣā gauṇapanā hai, jaba use pitākī apekṣāse dekheṃge taba usameṃ putrakī apekṣāko gauṇa karanā hogā| taise hī eka jīvadravyako dravyārthikanayase jaba nityakī apekṣā kareṃge taba usameṃ paryāyārthikanayase anityapanā gauṇarūpa rahegā aura jaba paryāyarūpase anityapanekī apekṣā kareṃge taba dravyarūpase nityapanā gauṇa rahegā kyoṃki jisakī vivakṣā hotī hai vaha mukhya ho jātā hai yaha vacana hai| yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki jo paryāyarūpase anitya hai, parantu śuddha dravyārthikanayase avināśī anantajñānādirūpa śuddha jīvāstikāya nāmakā śuddha ātmadravya hai, usīko rāgādi bhāvoṃko tyāgakara grahaṇa karanā cāhiye 4 usīkī bhāvanā karanā cāhiye ||19||
isa taraha bauddhamatako nirākaraṇa karane ke liye eka sūtra gāthā prathama sthalameṃ pahale kahī thī usīke viśeṣa varṇanake liye dūsare sthalameṃ cāra gāthāe~ kahīṃ |

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-20 atrātyantāsadutpādatvaṃ siddhasya niṣiddham | ṇāṇāvaraṇādīyā bhāvā jīveṇa suṭu aṇubaddhā | tesi-mabhāvaṃ kiccā abhūda-puvvo havadi siddho ||20||
jñānāvaraṇādyāḥ bhāvāḥ jīvena suṣṭhu anubaddhāḥ ||
teṣāṃ abhāvaṃ kṛtvā abhūtapūrvaḥ bhavati siddhaḥ ||20|| yathā stokakālānvayiṣu nāmakīvaśeṣāṃdayanivṛtteṣu jovasya devādiparyāyavekasmin svakāraṇanivṛttau nivṛtte'bhūtapūrva eva cānyasminnutpanne nāsadutpattiḥ, tathā dīrghakālānvayini jñānāvaraṇādikarmasāmānyodayanirvṛttasaṃsāritvaparyāye bhavyasya svakāraṇanivṛttau nivṛtte samutpanne cābhūtapūrve siddhatvaparyāye nāsadutpattiriti kiṃ ca-yathā drādhīyasi veṇudaṇḍe vyayahitāvyavahitavicitracitrakirmīratākhacitādhastanāprabhāge ekāntavyavahitasuviśuddhordhibhāge'vatāritā dṛṣṭiḥ samantato vicitracitrakirmīratāvyāptiṃ paśyantī samanuminoti tasya sarvatrāviśuddhatvaṃ, tathā kvacidapi jīvadravye vyavahitāvyavahitājñānāvaraṇādikamakiīratākhacitabahutarādhastanabhāge ekāntavyavahitasuviśuddhabahutaro+bhāge'vatāritā buddhiḥ samantato jñānāvaraṇādikakirmīratāvyāpti vyavasyantī samanuminoti tasya sarvatrāviśuddhatvam | yathā ca tatra veṇudaṇḍe vyāptijñānābhāsanibandhanavicitracitrakirmīratānvayaḥ, tathā ca kvacijjīvadravye jñānāvaraṇādikarmakirmīratāncayaḥ | yathaiva ca tatra veṇudaṇḍe vicitracitrakiīratānvayābhāvātsuviśuddhatvaṃ, tathaiva ca kvacijjīvadravye jñānāvaraṇādikakirmīratānvayābhāvādāptāgamasamyaganumānātīndriyajñānaparicchinnatsiddhatvamiti ||20||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-20 ___ anvayārtha--( jñānāvaraṇādyāḥ bhāvāḥ ) jñānāvaraṇādi bhāva ( jīvena ) jīvake sātha ( suṣṭhu) bhalī-bhāṃti ( anubaddhāḥ ) anubaddha haiṃ ( teṣām abhāvaṃ kṛtvā ) unakā abhāva karake vaha ( abhūtapūrvaḥ siddhaḥ ) abhūtapūrva siddha ( bhavati ) hotā hai|
ṭīkā-yahā~ siddhako atyanta asat-utpādakā niṣedha kiyā hai|
jisa prakāra kucha samaya taka anvayarūpase ( sātha-sātha ) rahanevāle nāmakarmaviśeṣake udayase utpanna honevālī jo devādiparyāyeṃ unameṃse jīvako eka paryāya svakāraṇase nivṛtta ho tathā anya koī abhūtapūrva paryāya hī utpanna ho, vahā~ asatkī utpatti nahīṃ hai, usī prakāra dīrghakāla taka anvayarūpase rahanevālī jñānāvaraṇādikarmasāmānyake udayase utpanna honevālī saṃsāritvaparyāya bhavyako svakāraṇase nivṛtta ho aura abhūtapūrva ( pūrvakālameṃ nahīṃ huī aisī ) siddhatvaparyāya utpanna ho, vahā~ asatkī utpatti nahīṃ hai|

72
ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana punaśca ( viśeṣa samajhāyā jātā hai )-- __ jisaprakāra jisakā vicitra citroṃse citrita nīcekā ardha bhāga kucha ḍhaṃkā huā aura kucha binā ḍhaṃkā ho tathā suviśuddha ( acitrita ) ūparakā ardha bhāga mātra ḍhaṃkā huā hī ho aise bahuta lambe bāṃsa para dṛṣṭi ḍālanese vaha dṛṣṭi sarvatra vicitra citroṃse hue citravicitrapaneko vyāptikā nirṇaya karatī huī “vaha bā~sa sarvatra aviśuddha hai ( arthāt sampūrṇa raṃgabiraṃgā hai)" aisā anumāna karatī hai, usī prakāra jisakā jñānāvaraṇādi karmoṃse huā citravicitratāyukta ( vividha vibhāvaparyāyavālā ) bahuta baḍa़ā nīce kā bhāga kucha ḍhakā huā aura kucha bina ḍhakā hai tathā suviśuddha ( siddhaparyāyavālā ), bahuta baḍa़ā ūparakā bhāga mātra ḍhakā huā hī hai aise kisī jīvadravyameṃ buddhi lagānese vaha buddhi sarvatra jñānāvarapādi karmase hue citravicitrapanekī vyāptikā nirṇaya karatī huī 'vaha jīva sarvatra aviśuddha hai' aisā anumāna karatī hai| punaśca, jisa prakāra usa bāṃsameṃ vyāptijñānābhāsakā kāraṇa [ nīceke khule bhāgameṃ 1 vicitra citroṃse hue citravicitrapanekā anvaya ( saṃtati, pravāha ) hai, usī prakāra usa jīvadravyameṃ vyāptijñānābhāsakā kāraṇa [ nīceke khule bhāgameṃ ] jñānāvaraṇādi karmase hue citravitritrapanekā anvaya hai| aura jisa prakāra usa bā~sameṃ ( ūparake bhāgameṃ ) suviśuddhapanā hai kyoṃki ( vahā~ ) vicitra citroṃse hue citravicitrapake anvayakā abhāva hai, usī prakāra usa jīvadravyameṃ ( ūparake bhāgameṃ ) siddhapanā hai kyoṃki ( vahā~) jñānāvaraṇādi karmase hue citravicitrapaneke anvayakā abhāva hai ki jo abhāva āptaāgama ke jñānase samyak anumānajñānase atīndriyajñānase jñāta hotā hai ||20|
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-20 atha yadyapi śuddhadravyārthikanayena sarvadeva śuddharūpastiṣṭhati tathāpi paryāyārthikanayena . siddhasyāsadutpādo bhavatītyāvedayati, athavā yadā manuṣyaparyāye vinaṣṭe devaparyāye sa eva jīvastathā mithyātvarāgādipariṇāmābhāvāt saṃsāraparyāyavināśe siddhaparyāye jāte sati jīvatvena vināśo nāstyubhayatra sa eva jīva iti darśayati, athavā parasparasāpekṣadravyārthikaparyāyārthikanayadyena pūrvoktaprakāreṇānekāntātmakaṃ tattvaṃ pratipādya paścātsaṃsārāvasthāyāṃ jñānāvaraṇādirūpabandhakaraṇabhūtaṃ mithyātvarāgādipariṇāmaṃ tyaktvā śuddhabhāvapariṇamanānmokṣaṃ ca kathayatīti pātanikātrayaṃ manasi dhṛtvā sūtramidaṃ pratipādayati-ṇāṇāvaraṇādīyā bhāvā jīveṇa suṭṭa aṇubaddhā-jñānācaraṇādibhāvadravyakarmaparyāyāḥ saṃsārijīvena suṣṭhu saṃśleṣarūpeṇānādisaṃtānena baddhāstiṣṭhanti tāvat 'tesimabhāvaṃ kiccā abhūdapubo havadi siddho' yadā kālādilabdhivaśājhedābhedaratnatrayātmakaṃ vyavahāraniścayamokṣamārga 'labhate tadā teṣāṃ jñānāvaraṇādibhāvānāṃ dravyabhāvakarmarūpaparyāyāṇāmabhāvaṃ vināśaṃ kṛtvā paryāyārthikanayenābhūtapūrvasiddho bhavati, dravyārthikanayena pūrvameva siddharūpa iti vārtikaṃ | tathāhi--yathaiko mahān veṇudaṇḍaḥ pūrvārdhamāge vicitracitreṇa khacitaḥ śabalito miśritaḥ tiṣṭhati tasmādūrvārddhabhāge vicitracitrābhāvācchuddha evaṃ tiṣṭhati tatra yadā kopi devadatto dṛṣṭyāvalokane karoti tadā bhrāntijñānavaśena

utthānikā- āge dikhalāte haiṃ ki yadyapi śuddha dravyārthika nayase yaha jīva sadā śuddha rahatā hai tathāpi paryāyārthika nayase siddha paryāyakā asat utpāda hotā hai arthāt jo siddha avasthā pahale kabhī pragaṭa nahīṃ thī usakā prakāśa hotā hai athavā yaha batāte haiṃ ki jaise manuṣyaparyāyake naṣṭa hote hue vā devaparyāyake janmate hue vahī jīva rahatā hai taise mithyādarśana va rāgadveṣādi pariṇāmoṃ ke cale jānepara saṃsāraparyāyake nāśa hote hue va siddhaparyāyake janma hote hue jīvakā jīvapanekī apekṣā nāśa nahīṃ huā hai arthāt donoṃ hī saṃsāra yā siddha avasthāmeṃ vahī jīva hai | athavā yaha kahate haiṃ ki paraspara apekṣā sahita pūrvokta dravyārthika aura paryāyārthika donoṃ nayoṃse tattvako samajhakara phira jo sāra avasthāmeṃ jñānāvaraṇādi kamoṃke baṃdhake kāraṇa mithyātva va rāgādi pariṇāma the unako choḍa़kara śuddha bhāvoṃmeṃ pariṇamana karatā hai usako mokṣa hotā hai| isa taraha tīna pātanikāoṃko manameṃ dharakara āgekā sūtra varṇana karate haiṃ |
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha - ( jīveṇa ) isa saṃsārī jīvadvārā ( ṇāṇāvaraṇādīyā ) jñānāvaraṇīya ādi āṭha prakāra ( bhāṣā) karmakī avasthāe~ (suṭhu ) gāḍha़ rūpase ( aṇubaddhā ) bāṃdhī huī haiṃ ( tesiṃ) una sabakā ( abhāvaṃ kiccā ) nāśa karake ( abhūdapuvo) abhūtapūrva arthāt jo pahale kabhī nahīṃ huā aisā ( siddho ) siddha ( havadi) ho jātā hai|

hindī tātparya vṛtti gāthā-21 utthānikā-āge yaha prakāśa karate haiṃ ki yaha jīva apane bhītara vidyamāna paryāyake nāśa tathā avidyamāna paryāyake utpādakā kartā hai tathā isa vyākhyānako saṃkocate bhī haiṃ
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( evaṃ ) isī taraha ( guṇapajjayehi sahido jīvo) apane guṇa aura paryāyake sāthameṃ rahatā huā yaha jīva ( saṃsaramāṇo) saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa karatā huā ( bhāvaṃ ) utpāda, aura ( abhāvaṃ) nāśako ( bhāvābhāvaṃ) vidyamāna paryāyake abhāvake prārambhako ( abhāvabhāvaṃ) avidyamāna paryāyake sadbhāvake prārambhako ( kuṇadi) karatā rahatā hai|
viśeṣārtha-jaisā yahale kaha cuke haiṃ ki yaha jīva dravyārthika nayase nitya hai to bhī paryāyārthika nayase pahale kī vidyamāna manuṣya paryāyakā nāśa karatā hai phira devagatimeṃ utpattike samayameṃ deva paryāyakā utpāda karatā hai phira bhī devaparyāyake chūṭaneke kālameṃ vidyamāna devaparyāyakā nāśa prārambha karatā hai tathā manuṣya paryāyakī utpattike kālameṃ avidyamāna manuṣya pāyakī utpattiko prārambha karatā hai| jo aisā karatā hai vaha jīva kumati jñānādi vibhāva guṇa nara nārakādi vibhāva paryāya sahita hotā hai| jo jīva kevalajñānādi svabhāvika guṇa aura siddhamaya śuddha paryāya sahita hotā hai vaha isa taraha gatiyoṃmeṃ bhramaṇa nahīṃ karatā hai, kyoṃki kevalajñānādike prakāśako avasthā hote hue naranāraka ādi vibhāva paryāyoṃkī utpatti asaṃbhava hai kiṃtu śuddha siddha paryāyameṃ bhī yaha jīva agurulaghu guṇake dvārā ṣaṭ-guṇī hānivṛddhi rūpa svabhāvaparyāyakī apekṣā utpāda va nāśa ādi karatā rahatā hai | isameṃ koī virodha nahīṃ hai | jaba aśuddha hotā hai taba jīva dravya, kṣetra, kāla, bhava, bhāvarūpa paṃca prakāra saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa karatā rahatā hai| isa sūtrameṃ yaha dikhāyā hai ki jaba yaha jīva sākṣāt grahaṇa karane yogya viśuddha jñāna, darśana svabhāva rūpa śuddha jīvāstikāyakā samyak śraddhāna jñāna aura cāritrarūpa niścaya ratnatrayamaya parama sāmāyikako

78
ṣaḍdravya - paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
na prāpta karatā huā dekhe sune va anubhava kiye hue āhāra, bhaya, maithuna, parigraha ina cāra saṃjñāoṃko ādi lekara sarva parabhāvoṃke pariṇāmoṃmeṃ mūrcchita, mohita yā āsakta hotā huā nara-narakādi vibhāṣa paryāyoṃmeṃ utpāda aura vyaya karatā rahatā hai taba isa jīvako śuddha ātmadravya samyak śraddhāna, jñāna tathā anubhava yā dhyāna nirantara jisa taraha bane usa taraha karanā yogya hai jisase vibhāvoṃmeṃ bhramaṇa na ho, yaha tātparya hai || 21 ||
isa taraha dravyārthika nayase nitya honepara bhī paryāyārthika nayase isa saṃsārī jīvake deva manuṣyādi paryāyoṃke utpāda yā nāśakā kartāpanā hai| isa vyākhyānake saṃkocakī mukhyatāse cauthe sthalameṃ gāthā pūrṇa huī| isa taraha cāra sthalāṃse dūsarā saptaka pūrṇa kiyā| isa prakāra pahalī gāthā saptakameṃ jo pā~ca sthala kahe the unako lekara nava antara sthaloṃse caudaha gāthāoṃke dvārā prathama mahā adhikārameṃ dravyapīṭhikā nāmakā dūsarā aṃtara adhikāra samāpta huā |
samaya vyākhyā gāthā - 22
atra sāmānyenoktalakṣaṇānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ madhyāt pañcānāmastikāyatvaṃ vyavasthāpitam | jīvā puggala - kāyā āyāsaṃ asthi - kāiyā sesā |
amayā atthitta mayā kāraṇa- bhūdā hi logassa || 22 || jīvāḥ pulakāyā ākāśamastikāyau śeṣau |
amayā astitvamāyāḥ kāraṇābhūtā hi lokasya || 22 ||
akṛtatvāt astitvamayatvāt vicitrātmapariṇatirūpasya lokasya kāraṇatvāccābhyupagamyamāneṣu ṣaṭsu dravyeṣu jīvapudgalākāśadharmādharmāḥ pradeśapracayātmakatvāt paṃcāstikāyāḥ na khalu kālastadabhāvādastikāya iti sāmarthyādavasīyata iti | 122 ||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā - 22
anvayārtha – [ jīvāḥ ] jīva ( pugalakāyāḥ ) pulakāya ( ākāśam) ākāśa aura [ śeṣa astikāya ] śeṣa do astikāya ( amayāḥ ) akṛta haiṃ, ( astitvamayāḥ ) astittvamaya haiṃ aura (hi) vāstavameṃ ( lokasya kāraṇabhūtāḥ ) lokake kāraṇabhūta haiṃ |
ṭīkā --- yahā~ ( isa gāthāmeṃ ), sāmānyataḥ jinakā svarūpa ( pahale ) kahā gayā hai aise chaha dravyoṃmeṃse pā~cako astikāyapanā sthāpita kiyā gayā hai|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta akṛta honese, astitvamaya honese aura anekaprakārakī apanī pariṇatirūpa lokake kāraṇa honese jo svīkāra ( saṃmata ) kiye gaye haiṃ aise chaha dravyoṃmeṃ jīva, pudgala, ākāśa, dharma aura adharma pradeśapracayātmaka ( pradeśoṃke samūhamaya ) honese ve pā~ca astikāya haiṃ| kālako pradeśapracayātmakapanekā abhāva honese vaha vāstavameṃ astikāya nahīṃ hai aisā ( binā kathana kiye bhī) sāmarthyase niścita hotā hai ||22||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā--22 atha kāladravyapratipādanamukhyatvena gāthāpañcakaṃ kathyate | tatra paṃcagāthāsu madhye ṣaḍdravyamadhyājjīvādipaṃcānāmastikāyatvasūcanārthaṃ "jīvā poggalakāyā" ityādi sūtramekaṃ, tadanantaraṃ niścayakālakathanarūpeṇa “sabbhāvasahāvāṇaṃ" ityādi sūtradvayaṃ ṭīkābhiprāyeṇa sūtramekaṃ punaśca samayādivyavahārakālamukhyatvena "samao ṇimiso” ityādi gāthādvayaṃ evaṃ sthalatrayeṇa tṛtīyāntarādhikāre samudāyapātanikā | atha sāmānyoktalakṣaṇānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ yathoktasmaraṇārthamagre viśeṣavyākhyānārthaṃ vā paṃcānāmastikāyatvaṃ vyavasthāpayati
jīvā poggalakāyā āyāsaṃ asthikāiyā sesā-jīvā: pudgalakāyā ākāśaṃ astikāyikī śeṣau dharmādharmī ceti ete paṃca | kathaṃbhūtāḥ | amayā--akṛtrimā na kenāpi puruṣaviśeṣeṇa kṛtāḥ | tarhi kathaṃ| niṣpannā: | atthittamayā-astitvaprayāḥ svakīyāstitvena svakīyasattayā nirvṛttā niṣpannā jātā ityanena paṃcānāmastitvaṃ nirūpitaṃ | punarapi kathaṃbhūtāḥ | kāraṇabhūdā du logassa-kāraṇabhūtāḥ | kasva? lokasya "jīvādiṣadravyāṇāṃ samavāyo melāpako lokaḥ" iti vacanāt | sa ca loka: utpādavyayadhrauvyavān tenāstittvaṃ lokyate, utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ saditi vacanāt | punarapi kathaṃbhūto lokaḥ | ūrdhvādhomadhyabhāgena sāṃśa: sāvayavastena kāyatvaṃ kathitaṃ bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ ||22|| evaṃ ṣadravyamadhyājjīvādipaṃcānāmastikāyatvasūcanarūpreṇa gāthā gātā|
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-22 utthānikā-āge kāladravyake kahanekī mukhyatāse pā~ca gāthāe~ kahī jātī hai, ina pā~ca gāthāoṃke madhyameṃ chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃse jīvādi pā~ca draṣyoṃkī astikāya saṃjñā hai yaha batāneke liye 'jīvā puggalakāyā' ityādi eka sūtra hai| phira niścayakālako kahate hue 'sambhāvasahāvāṇaṃ' ityādi sūtra do haiṃ va ṭīkāke abhiprāyase sūtra eka hai| phira samayādi vyavahāra kālakī mukhyatāse samao ṇimiso, ityādi gāthā do haiṃ| isa taraha tīna sthūladvārā tīsare antara adhikāra meṃ samudāya pātinakā kahī|
aba sāmānyapane jinakā lakṣaṇa kahacuke aise chaḥ bravyākai nāma smaraṇake liye va unakā viśeṣa vyākhyāna karaneke liye āthavā pā~ca dravyoṃke astikāyapanā sthāpanā karaneke liye sūtra kahate haiṃ

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( jīvā) anaṃta jīva (puggalakāyā) anaṃtapudgalakāya (āyāsaṃ) eka ākāśa ( sesā asthikāiyā) śeṣa do astikāya dharma aura adharma dravya ye pā~ca astikāya ( amayā) akṛtrima haiṃ, (asthittamayā) apanī sattāko rakhanevāle haiṃ tathā ( hi) niścayase ( logassa) isa lokake ( kāraṇabhūdā) kāraṇarūpa haiṃ !
viśeṣārtha-jīvādi pā~ca astikāya haiṃ| inako kisī puruṣaviśeṣane banāyā nahīṃ hai| ye apanī sattāse hī nivṛta athavā niṣpanna hue haiṃ ataḥ vidyamāna haiṃ| yaha loka ina pā~ca asti-kāyoṃkā va kāyarahita eka pradeśī kāla dravyakā isa taraha chaḥ dravyoṃkā samudāya hai jaisā kahā hai-'jīvādiṣadravyāṇāṃ samavāyo melāpako lokaḥ' iti tathā yaha loka utpādavyaya va dhrauvya svarūpa hai isīse isa lokakā astitva dekhā jātā hai, kyoṃki kahā hai "utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sat iti'' tathā yaha loka ardhva, madhya, adho ina tīna aṃśoṃko rakhanevālā avayavasahita hai isase isako bahu pradeśī yā kāyapanā kahā gayā hai| yaha sūtrakā bhāva hai ||22||
isa taraha chaḥ dravyoṃke madhyameṃ jīvādi pā~ca dravyako astikāya saṃjñā hai aisī sūcanā - karate hue gāthā pūrṇa kī|
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-23 atrāstikāthatvenānuktasyāpi kālasyārthāpannatvaṃ dyotitam | sambhāva-sabhāvāṇaṃ jīvāṇaṃ taha ya poggalāṇaṃ ca | pariyaṭṭaṇa-saṃbhūdo kālo ṇiyameṇa paṇṇatto || 23||
sadbhāvasvabhāvānāṃ jīvānāṃ tathaiva pudgalānāṃ ca | .
parivartanasambhūtaḥ kālo niyamena prajñaptaḥ ||23|| iha hi jīvānāṃ pudgalānāṃ ca sattāsvabhāvatvādasti pratikṣaṇamutpādavyayadhrauvyaikavṛttirūpaḥ pariṇāmaḥ | sa khalu sahakārikāraṇasaddhāve dṛṣṭaḥ, gatisthityavagāhapariṇāmavat | yastu sahakārikāraṇaṃ sa kālaḥ | tatpariṇāmānyathānupapattigamyamānatvādanukto'pi niścayakālo'stīti niścīyate | yastu niścayakālaparyāyarūpo vyavahārakālaḥ sa jīvapudgalapariṇāmenābhivyajyamānatvāttadāyatta evābhigamyata eveti || 23||

.
paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
hindī samadyā vyākhyā gāthā-23 anvayārtha-( sadbhāvasvabhāvānām ) sattāsvabhāvavāle ( jīvānām tathā eva pudgalānām ce ) jīvoṃ aura pudgaloṃke ( parivartanasambhūtaḥ ) parivartanase siddha honevāle [ kāla: ] aise kālakā ( niyamena prajñaptaḥ ) ( sarvajñoṃ dvārā ) niyamase ( niścayase) upadeśa diyā gayā hai|
ṭīkā-kāla astikāyarūpase anukta ( kathana nahīṃ kiyā gayā ) hone para bhī use arthapanā ( padārthapanā ) siddha hotā hai aisā yahā~ darśāyā hai| isa jagatmeṃ vāstava meṃ jīvoṃko aura egaloṃko sattāsvabhāvake kāraṇa pratikṣaṇa utpādavyayadhrauvyakī ekavṛttirūpa pariṇāma vartatā hai| vaha ( pariṇāma) vāstavameṃ sahakārī kāraṇa ke sadbhāvameṃ dikhāī detā hai, gati-sthiti avagāha pariṇāmakī bhā~ti | yaha jo sahakārī hai so kāla hai| vaha jīva pudgala ke pariṇāmakī anyathā anupapatti dvārā jñāta hotā hai isaliye, niścayakā [astikāyarūpake ] anukta hone para bhī-[ dravyarūpase ] vidyamāna hai aisā niścita hotā hai| aura jo niścayakālakī paryāyarūpa vyavahārakāla hai vaha jītra pudgalokake pariṇāmase vyakta ( gamya ) hotā hai isaliye āvaśyaka tadādhita hī [ jīva tathā puga़lake pariṇāmeṃ āśrita hī] ginā jātā hai ||23||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-23 athātra paṃcāstikāyaprakaraṇe'stikāyatvenānuttopi kāla: sāmathyena labdha iti pratipādaryāta-.
sambhāvasahāvāṇaṃ jīvāṇaṃ taha poggalāṇaṃ ca-sadbhāvassattā saiva svabhāvaḥ svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ te sadbhāvasvabhāvāsteṣāṃ sadbhāvasvabhāvānāṃ jīvapuṭralānāṃ athavā saddhāvānāmityanena dharmādharmākāśāni gṛhyante | pariyaṭṭhaṇasaṃbhūdo-parivartanasaṃbhūtaḥ parivartanaṃ navajīrṇarūpeṇa pariṇamanaṃ tatparivartanaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ samutpannaṃ yasmātsa bhavati parivartanasaṃbhūtaḥ kālo kālāṇurupodravyakāla: ṇiyameṇa niścayena paṇṇato prajñātaḥ kathitaḥ | kai: ? sarvajñaiḥ | tathāpi paṃcāstikāyavyākhyāne kriyamāṇe paramārthakālasyānuktasyāpyarthāpannatvamityuktaṃ pātanikāyāṃ tat kathaṃ ghaṭate ? praśne pratyuttaramāhuḥ-paṃcāstikāyāḥ pariṇāminaḥ pariṇāmaśca kārya, ca kāraṇamapekṣate sa ca dravyāṇāṃ pariṇatinimittabhūta: kālāṇurūpo dravyakālaḥ ityanayā yuktyā sāmarthenārthāpanatvaṃ dyotitaṃ | kiṃ ca samayarūpaḥ sūkṣmakāla: pudgalaparamāṇunā janitaḥ sa evaṃ niścayakālo bhaṇyate, ghaṭikādirūpa: sthalo vyavahārakālo bhāṇyate| ma ca ghaṭikādinimittabhūtajalabhājanavastrakāṣṭhapuruṣahastavyāpārarūpaḥ kriyādiviśeṣeṇa janito na ca dravyakāleneti pūrvapakṣe parihāramāhuḥ– yadyapi samayarūpa: sūkṣmavyavahārakāla pudgalaparamāṇunā nimittabhṛtena vyajyate prakaṭīkriyate jñāyate ghaṭikādirūpasthūlavyavahārakālaśca ghaṭikādinimittabhūtajalabhājanavastrādidravyaviśeṣeṇa jñāyate tathā samayaghaṭikādiparyāyarūpavyavahārakālasya kālāṇurūpo dravyakāla evopādānakāraṇaṃ | kasmāt | upādānakāraṇasadṛśaṃ kāryamiti vacanāt | kiṃvaditi cet | kumbhakāracakracīvarādivahiraṅganimittotpatrasya ghaṭakāryasya mṛtpiṇḍopādānakāraṇavat kuviṃdaturīvemasalākādibahiraṅga

82.
ṣaḍdravya - paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
nimittotpannasya paṭakāryasya taṃtusamūhopādānakāraṇavat indhanāgnyādibahiraṅganimittātpannasya śālyādyodanakāryasya śālyāditaṃḍulopādānakāraṇavat karmodayanimittotpannasya naranārakādiparyāyakāryasya jīvopādānakāraṇavadityādi || 23||
hindī tātparya vṛtti gāthā- 23
utthānikā- āge kahate haiṃ ki paṃcāstikāya prakaraṇameṃ astikāyake nāmase jisa kāla dravyako nahīṃ kahā hai tobhī paṃcāstikāyake prakaraṇako sāmarthya se kāladravya prāpta hotā I
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha - ( sababhāvasabhāvāṇaṃ ) sattārūpa svabhāvako rakhanevāle ( jīvāṇaṃ ) jīvoṃke ( taha ya poggalāṇaṃ) taise hī pahalakoṃke (ca ) aura anya dharma adharma ākāśake ( pariyaṭṭaṇasaṃbhūdo ) pariṇamanameṃ jo nimitta kāraṇa ho so ( ṇiyameṇa ) niścaya karake (kālo) kāla dravya ( paṇṇatto ) kahā gayā hai |
viśeṣārtha - dravyoṃke nae se jīrṇa honeko parivartana yā pariṇamana kahate haiṃ so jisase hotā hai vaha kālāṇu dravya kāla hai aisā sarvajñadevane kahā hai | yahā~ śiṣya śaṃkā karatā hai ki apane yaha pātanikā kī thī ki yaha paṃcāstikāyake vyākhyāna ko karate hue niścayakāla . dravyako na kahane para bhī bhāvase usako grahaṇa karalenā cāhiye so kisa taraha siddha hotā hai ? isa praśnakā samādhāna ācārya karate haiṃ ki ye pā~coṃ jīvādi astikāya pariṇamana karate rahate haiṃ | pariṇamana karanese pariṇāma yā paryāya rūpa kārya hotā hai| so kārya . kāraṇakī apekṣā rakhatā hai| yadyapi upādāna śakti dravyoṃme svayaṃ pariṇamanekī hai parantu nimitta kāraṇakī āvaśyakatā hai so dravyake pariṇamanameṃ nimittarūpa kālāṇurūpa dravyakāla hai isī yuktike sāmarthyase kāla dravya jhalakatā hai| śiṣya phira yaha pūrva pakṣa karatā hai ki puhala paramāṇuke gamanase utpanna jo samayarūpa sūkṣmakāla vahī niśyaca kāla kahā jātā hai tathā ghaḍa़ī ghaṃṭā ādirūpa sthūlakāla so vyavahāra kāla kahā jātā hai, so kāla ghaḍa़ī ghaṃṭe ādike nimitta kāraṇa jala bharane, bhājana va vastra va kāṣṭha banānemeṃ jo puruṣoṃ ke hāthoṃkī vyāpāra rūpa kriyā viśeṣa hotī hai usīse utpanna hotā hai | dravya kālase koī vyavahāra kāla nahīṃ hotā hai| isīkā ācārya samādhāna karate haiṃ ki yadyapi samayarūpa sūkṣma vyavahārakāla pudgala paramāṇukī maṃdagatise pragaṭa hotā hai yā jāna paḍa़tā hai tathā ghaḍa़ī ghaṃṭā ādi rūpa jo vyavahārakāla hai so ghaṭikā ādike nimitta kāraṇa jala, bartana, vastra ādi dravyaviśeṣako kriyāse jānā jātā hai tathāpi samaya yā ghaṭikā ādi paryāya rūpa jo vyavahārakāla hai usī kā upādāna kāraṇa kālāṇurūpa dravyakāla hai aisā mānanā hī cāhie

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta yahā~ śiṣyane praśna kiyā ki lokākāśake bāhara kāla dravya nahīṃ hai taba bāharake ākāśa dravyameṃ pariṇati kaise hogī? isakā uttara ācārya kahate hai ki-jaise lambī baḍa़ī rassīke lambe baḍa़e bāsaṃse yā kuṃbhārake cākake eka sthānako hilāte hue sarva ṭhikāne halana calana ho jātā hai athavā jaise kāmasparśana iṃdriyake eka sthānameṃ sparśa karate hue tathā rasana iṃdriya se svāda lete hue savāṃgameṃ sukhakā anubhava hotā hai athavā jaise sarpake.eka sthānapara kāṭate hue va ghāva ādike eka sthānapara hote hue sarva aṃgameṃ duḥkhakī vedanā hotī hai taise hī lokameṃ hī kāla dravya hai tobhī sarva ākāśameṃ pariṇatiko kāraṇa hai kyoṃki ākāśa eka akhaṃḍa dravya hai|
dūsarā praśna yaha hai ki dūsare dravyoṃke pariṇamanameṃ sahakārī kāraṇa kāla dravya hai taba kāla dravyake pariṇamanakā sahakārī kāraṇa kyā hai ? isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki jaise ākāśakā ādhāra ākāśa hai, jñāna, rala yā dīpaka-svapara prakāśaka haiṃ aise hī kāla dravyakī pariṇatiko kāla hī sahakārī kāraṇa hai| phira śiṣya praśna karatā hai ki yadi kāla dravya apanī pariṇatimeṃ āpa hī sahakārī kāraṇa hai vaise hī sarva dravya apanī-apanī pariṇatimeṃ sahakārī kāraṇa ho jāyeṃge, kāladravyase koī prayojana na rahegā|
isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki saba dravyoṃko sādhāraṇa pariṇamanameṃ sahakārī kāraṇapanā honā yaha kālakā hī guṇa hai| jaise ākāśakā guṇa sarvako sādhāraṇa avakāśa denā hai, dharmadravyakā guṇa sarva sādhāraṇako gamanameṃ kāraṇapanā hai tathā adharmadravyakā sarvasādhāraṇako sthitimeṃ sahakārīpanā hai| yaha isaliye ki eka dravyake guṇa dūsare dravyake guṇarūpa nahīṃ kiye jā sakate haiṃ | yadi aisā ho to saṃkara vyatikara doṣa ājāveṃ| yadi sarva dravya apanīapanī pariṇatike upādāna kāraṇa hote hue sahakārī kāraṇa bhī ho jāveṃ to phira gati, sthiti, avagāhake kāryoṃmeṃ dharma, adharma ākāśa dravyoṃke sahakārī kāraṇase kucha prayojana na rahe, svayaṃ hī gati, sthiti avagāha ho jāve | yadi aisā ho to yaha dūṣaṇa ho jāyegā ki jīva pudgala do hī dravya raha jāyeṃge | āgamase isameṃ virodha āvegā | __ yahā~ yaha bhāvārtha hai ki-yaha jīva viśuddha jñānadarśana svabhāvadhārī, śuddha jīvāstikāya kī prāpti na karake, gata anantakālase saṃsāracakrameṃ bhramatā calā āyā hai, isa kāraṇa aba ise vītarāga nirvikalpa samādhimeṃ ṭhaharakara sarva rāgadveṣādirūpa vikalpoṃkī laharoṃko tyāga karake usī śuddha jīvako sadā dhyānā cāhiye ||24||
isa taraha niścaya kālake vyākhyānakī mukhyatāse do gāthāeṃ pūrṇa huī|

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana māsa hotā hai, do māsakī eka ṛtu hotī hai, tīna ṛtukā eka ayana hotā hai, do ayanakā eka varṣa hotā hai, ityādi palyopama, sāgara ādi vyavahārakāla jānanā cāhiye| jo maṃdagatirūpa pariṇamana karate hue pudalake paramāṇuse pragaṭa ho vaha samaya hai | jo jalake bartana ādi bāharī nimittabhūta pugalakī kriyāse pragaṭa ho vaha ghaḍa़ī hai | sūryake bimbake gamana ādi kriyā viśeṣase pragaṭa ho vaha divasa ādi vyavahārakāla hai| jaise kuṃbhāra cāāka ādi bāharī nimitta kāraṇoṃse utpanna ghaṭa miṭṭīke piṃḍarūpa upādāna kāraṇase paidā huā hai, aise hī niścayanayase yaha vyavahārakāla dravyakālāṇuse utpanna huā hai to bhī vyahāranayase puchalādike gamanakā nimitta honese parādhīna hai| yahā~ koī śaṃkā karatā hai ki-jo anyakī kriyā viśeṣase arthāt sūryādike gamanādise jānā jāve va jo anya utpanna hue padārthoke janāvanekā kāraṇa ho vahī kāla hai dūsarā koī dravya yā niścayakāla nahīṃ hai | isakā uttara kahate haiṃ ki aisā nahīṃ hai ki jo pahale kahe pramāṇa samaya ādikī paryāyarūpa sūryakī gati ādise pragaṭa hotā hai vaha vyavahāra kāla hai parantu jo sūrya ādikī gatike pariṇamanameṃ sahakārī kāraṇa ho vaha dravya kāla yā niścaya kāla hai | phira śaṃkākāra kahatā hai ki sūryake gamana ādi pariṇatimeṃ dharma dravya sahakārī kāraṇa hai, kāla dravyakā yahā~ kyā kāma hai ? ācārya uttara dete haiṃ ki nahīṃ| gamanarūpa pariṇamanameṃ dharma dravya sahakārī kāraṇa hai vaise kāla dravya bhī sahakārī kāraṇa hai| sahakārī kāraṇa bahutase bhī ho sakate haiṃ jaise ghaṭakī utpattimeṃ kuṃbhāra, cāka, cīvara ādi aneka kāraṇa hai va machalī ādike liye jala ādi va manuṣyoṃke liye śakaṭa ādi va vidyātharoṃke lie mantra, auṣadhi ādi, va devoṃke liye vimāna gamanameṃ sahakārī kāraṇa haiṃ vaise kāla dravya bhī gamanameṃ sahakārī kāraṇa hai|

śaṃkākāra yaha śaṃkā karatā hai ki jitane kālameṃ eka pradeśakā ullaṃghana pudgala paramāṇu karatā hai vaha samaya hai, aisā kahā gayā hai | vahī paramāṇu jaba eka hī samaya meṃ caudaha rājū calā jātā hai taba jitane pradeśa caudaha rājūke haiṃ utane hī samaya hue, eka hī samaya kaise lagā? ācārya samādhāna karate haiṃ ki aisā nahīṃ hai | jaba maṃdagatise paramāṇu- gamana karatā huā eka pradeśa ullaṃghana karatā hai taba eka samaya utpanna hotā hai vahī paramāṇu utane hī eka samayameṃ caudaha rājū ullaṃghana karatā hai so śīghra gatise karatā hai aisā kahā hai, isaliye isameṃ koī doṣa nahīṃ hai| samayake vibhāga nahīṃ hote haiṃ| isameṃ dṛṣṭāṃta kahate haiṃ jaise koī devadatta nāmakā puruṣa sau yojana sau dinameṃ maṃdagatise jātā hai vahī yadi vidyāke prabhāvase eka

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana samayarūpa vyavahāra kālako hī māno, niścayakāla kālāṇu dravya rūpa koī nahīṃ hai? isakā samādhāna ācārya kahate haiṃ ki samaya sabase sūkṣma kāla rūpa prasiddha eka paryāya hai vaha dravya nahīṃ hai| paryāya isaliye hai ki samaya upajatā vinaśatā hai| kahā hai 'samao uppaṇṇa paddhaṃsī' paryāya binā dravyake nahīṃ ho sakatī hai| dravya niścayase avināśī hotā hai isaliye kālakī samaya paryāyakā upādāna kāraṇa kālāṇu rūpa kāla dravya hī hai pudgalādi nahīṃ hai kyoṃki yaha niyama hai ki jaisā upādāna kāraṇa hotā hai vaisā kārya hotā hai, miṭṭīkā piṃḍa jaisā hogā vaisā hī usake upādāna kāraṇake samāna ghaṭa banegā| aura to kyā ? kāla śabda hī paramārtha kālakā vācaka honese apane hī vācya paramārtha kālake svarūpako sthāpita karatā hai| jaise siṃha śabda siṃha padārthako, sarvajña śabda sarvajña padārthako, indra śabda indra padārthako siddha karatā hai| phira bhī saṃkocate huye niścaya tathā vyavahāra kālakā svarūpa kahate haiṃ|
samaya ādi rūpa sūkṣma vyavahāra kālakā va ghaṭikādirūpa sthūla vyavahāra kālakā jo koī upādāna kāraṇa hai tathā so samaya ghaṭikādike bhedase kahane yogya vyavahāra kālakī bhedakalpanāse rahita hai, va jo tīnoṃ kāloṃmeṃ rahanevālā anādi anaṃta lokākāśake asaṃkhyāta pradeśoṃke pramāṇa asaṃkhyāta kālāṇurūpa bhinna-bhinna dravya hai so niścaya kāla hai | tathā jo niśyacakālake upādāna kāraṇase paidā hone para bhī pudgala paramāṇu va jala pātrādise pragaṭa hotā hai so samaya ghaṭikā divasa ādi rūpase viśeṣa-viśeṣa vyavahārakī kalpanāmeṃ ānevālā vyavahāra kāla hai | isa vyākhyānameṃse yaha tātparya lenā ki jisakā lābha bhūtake anaṃta kālameṃ durlabha rahā hai aisā jo śuddha jīvāstikāya hai usīke hī cidānaṃdamaya eka svabhāvameṃ samyak śraddhāna karanā cāhiye, usīko rāgādise bhinna jānakara bhedajñāna prāpta karanā cāhiye tathā usīmeṃ hī rāgādi vibhāva rūpa sarva saṃkalpa vikalpa- jāla choḍa़kara sthira citta karanā cāhiye|
isa taraha vyavahārakālake vyākhyānakī mukhyattāse do gāthāe~ pūrṇa huīṃ|
isa paṃcāstikāya va cha; dravyake prarūpaṇa karanevāle āṭha aṃtara adhikāra sahita prathama mahā adhikārameṃ niścaya vyavahārakālako kahanevālā pā~ca gāthāoṃse tīna sthaladvārā tīsarā aṃtara adhikāra pūrṇa huā | isa prakāra samaya śabdārthapīṭhikā dravyapīṭhikā va niścaya vyavahārakāla ina vyākhyānoṃkī mukhyatāse tīna aṃtara adhikāroṃ se chaṭanīsa gāthāoṃke dvārā pīṭhikā samāpta huī|

atra saṃsārāvasthasyātmanaḥ sopādhi nirupādhi ca svarūpamuktam | ātmā hi niścayena bhāvaprāṇadhāraṇājjīvaḥ, vyavahāreṇa dravyaprāṇadhāraṇājjīvaḥ | niścayena cidātmakatvāt, vyavahāreṇa cicchaktitvāctabhitā | nivṛte vyavahāreṇa pṛthagbhūtena caitanyapariṇāmalakṣaṇenopayogenopalakṣitatvādupayogaviśeṣitaḥ | niścayanayena bhāvakarmaṇāṃ vyavahāreṇa dravyakarmaṇāmāstravaṇabaṃdhanasaṃvaraṇanirjaraṇamokṣaṇeṣu svayamīśatvāt prabhuḥ | niścayena paugalikakarmanimittātmapariṇāmānāṃ vyavahāreṇātmapariṇāmanimittapauṅgalikakarmaṇāṃ kartṛtvātkartā | niścayena śubhāśubhakarmanimittasukhaduḥkhapariṇāmānāṃ vyavahāreṇa śubhāśubhakarmasaṃpāditeṣṭāniṣṭaviṣayāṇāṃ bhoktṛtvāddhoktā | niścayena lokamātro'pi viśiṣṭāvagāhapariṇāmaśaktiyuktatvānnāmakarmanirvṛttamaṇu mahacca śarīramadhitiṣṭhan vyavahāreṇa dehamātraḥ | vyavahāreṇa karmabhiḥ sahaikatvapariṇāmānmūrto'pi niścayena nīrūpasvabhāvatvānna hi mūrtaḥ | niścayena pulapariṇāmānurūpacaitanyapariṇāmātmabhiḥ, vyavahāreṇa caitanyapariṇāmānurūpapulapariṇāmātmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ saṃyuktatvātkarmasaṃyukta iti || 27 ||

ṣaḍdravya - paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
hai, vyavahārase, citśaktiyukta honese 'cetayitā' hai, niścayase apṛthagbhūta aise caitanyapariṇāmasvarūpa upayoga dvārā lakṣita honese 'upayogalakṣita' hai, vyavahārase pṛthagbhūta aise caitanyapariṇāmasvarūpa upayoga dvārā lakṣita honese 'upayogalakṣita' hai| niścayase bhāvakarmoke āsrava, baṃdha, saṃvara, nirjarā aura mokṣa karane meṃ svayaṃ īśa ( samartha ) honese 'prabhu' haiṃ, vyavahārase dravyakarmoke āsrava, baṃdha, saṃvara, nirjarā aura mokṣa karanemeṃ svayaṃ īśa honese 'prabhu' hai, niścayase paugalika karma jinakā nimitta hai aise ātmapariṇāmokā kartṛtva honese 'kartā' hai, vyavahārase ātmapariṇāma jinakā nimitta haiṃ aise paugalika karmoṃkā kartṛtva honese 'kartā' hai, niścayase śubhāśubha karma jinakā nimitta hai aise sukhaduḥkhapariṇāmoṃkā bhoktṛtva honese 'bhoktā' hai, vyavahārase śubhāśubha karmoṃse sampādita ( prāpta ) iṣṭāniṣṭa viṣayoṃkā 'bhoktṛtva honase se 'bhoktā' hai, niścayase lokapramāṇa hone para bhī, viśiṣṭa avagāhapariṇāmakī śaktivālā honese nāmakarmase race jānevāle choṭe baḍa़e śarīrameṃ rahatā huā vyavahārase 'dehapramāṇa' hai | vyavahārase karmoṃke sātha ekatvapariṇāma ke kāraṇa mūrta hone para bhī, niścayase arūpī svabhāvavālā honeke kāraṇa amūrta hai, niścaya se pudgalapariṇāmake anurūpa caitanyapariṇāmātmaka karmoke ( bhāva karma ke ) sātha saṃyukta honese 'karmasaṃyukta' hai, vyavahārase caitanya pariṇāmake anurūpa pudgala pariṇāmātmaka karmoṃke sātha saṃyukta honese 'karmasaṃyukta' haiṃ ||27||

pariṇāmapariṇāminau jīvapudgalau svabhāvavibhāvapariṇāmābhyāṃ śeṣacatvāri dravyāṇi vibhāvavyañcanaparyāyābhāvād mukhyavṛtyā punarapariṇāmīni jīvaḥ śuddhaniścayanayena viśuddhajñānadarśanasvabhāvaṃ śuddhacaitanyaṃ prāṇaśabdenocyate tena jīvatīti jīvaḥ vyavahāranayena punaḥ karmodayajanitadravyabhāvarūpaiścaturbhiḥ prāṇairjīvati jīviṣyati jīvitapūrvo vā jīva: pudgalādipañcadravyāṇi punarajīvarūpāṇi | muttaṃamūrtaśuddhātmano vilakṣaṇā sparśarasagaṃdhavarṇavatī mūrtirucyate tatsadbhāvāt mūrta: pudgalaḥ, jīvadravya punaranupacaritā sadbhūtavyavahāreṇa mūrtamapi śuddhaniścayanayenāmūrta, dharmādharmākāśakāladravyāṇi cāmūrtāni | sapadesaṃ- lokamātrapramitāsaṃkhyeyapradeśalakṣaṇaṃ jīvadravyamādiṃ kṛtvā paṃcadravyāṇi paṃcāstikāyasaṃjñāni sapradeśāni, kāladravyaṃ punarbahupradeśalakṣaṇakāyatvābhāvādapradeśaṃ | eya dravyārthikanayena dharmādharmākāśadravyāṇyekāni bhavanti jīvapudgalakāladravyāṇi punaranekāni | kheta- sarvadravyāṇāmavakāśadānasāmarthyākṣetramākāśamekaṃ śeṣapaṃcadravyāṇyakṣetrāṇi kiriyā ya kṣetrāt kṣetrāṃtaragamanarūpā parispaṃdavatī calanavatī kriyā sā vidyate yayostau kriyāvaṃtī jīvapudgalau dharmādharmākāśakāladravyāṇi punarniṣkriyāṇi | ṇiccaṃ dharmādharmākāśakāladravyāṇi yadyapyartha paryāyatvenānityāni tathāpi mukhyavṛtyā vibhāvavyaṃjanaparyāyābhāvānityāni dravyārthikanayena ca jīva pudgaladravye punaryadyapi dravyārthikanayāpekṣayā

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta nitye tathāpyagurulaghupariṇatirūpasvabhāvaparyāyāpekṣayā vibhāvavyañjanaparyāyāpekṣayā cānitye | kāraṇapudgaladhamādhamākāśakāladravyāṇi vyavahāranayana jīvasya śarīravāṅmanaḥ prāṇāpānādigatisthityavagāhavartanākāryāṇi kurvatīti kāraṇāni bhavanti, jīvadravyaṃ punaryadyapi guruśiṣyādirūpeṇa parasparopagrahaṃ karoti tathāpi pudgalādipaṃcadravyāṇāṃ kimapi na karoti ityakāraṇaṃ | kattā-śuddhapāriṇāmikaparamabhāvagrāhakeṇa śuddhadravyārthikanayena yadyapi baṃdhamokṣadravyābhāvarūpapuṇyapāpaghaṭapaṭādīnāmakartā jīvastathāpyaśuddhaniścayena śubhāśubhopayogābhyāṃ pariṇataḥ san puṇyapāpabaṃdhayo: kartā tatphalabhoktā ca bhavati | viśuddhajñānadarśanasvabhāvanijaśuddhātmadravyasamyakśraddhānajñānānuṣṭhānarūpeṇa śuddhopayogena tu pariṇataḥ san mokṣasyāpi kartā tatphalabhoktā ca, śubhāśubhaśuddhapariṇāmānāṃ pariṇamanameva kartṛtvaṃ sarvatra jñātavyamiti pudgalādīnāṃ pañcadravyāṇāṃ ca svakīyasvakīyapariṇāmena pariṇamanameva kartṛtvaṃ, vastuvṛtyā puna: puṇyapāpādirūpeṇākartṛtvameva, savvagadaṃ-lokālokavyāptyapekṣayā sarvagatāmākāśaṃ bhaṇyate, lokavyāptyapekṣayā dharmādharmī ca jīvadravyaṃ punarekaikajīvāpekṣayā lokapūraṇāvasthā vihāyāsarvagataṃ nānājīvāpekṣayā sarvagatameva bhavati | pudgaladravyaṃ punarlokarūpamahāskaṃdhāpekṣayā sarvagataṃ śeṣapudgalāpekṣayā sarvagataṃ na bhavatīti | kāladravyaṃ punarekakālāṇudravyāpekṣayā sarvagataṃ na bhavati, lokapradeśapramāṇanānākālāṇuvivakṣayā loke sarvagataṃ | idaraṃhi yappaveso-yadyapi sarvadravyāṇi vyavahāreṇakakṣetrāvagāhenānyonyānupraveśena tiṣṭhanti tathāpi niścayena cetanācetanādisvakīyasvakīyasvarūpaṃ na tyajaṃtīti | atra ṣaḍdravyeṣu madhye vītarāgacidānaṃdaikādiguṇasvabhāvaṃ śubhāśubhamanovacanakāyavyāpārarahitaṃ nijaśuddhātmadravyamevopādeyamiti bhāvārthaḥ ||1||
ita ūrdhvaṃ "jīvā poggalakāyā" ityādigāthāyāṃ pūrva paṃcāstikāyā ye sūcitāsteṣāmeva viśeṣavyākhyānaṃ kriyate | tatra pāṭhakrameṇa tripaṃcāśadgāthābhirnavāṃtarādhikārairjīrvavāstikāyavyākhyāna prārabhyate | tāsu tripaṃcāśadgāthāsu madhye prathamatastāvat cārvākamatānusāriśiṣyaṃ prati jīvasiddhipūrvakatvena navādhikārakramasūcanārtha “jīvotti havadi cedā" ityādyekādhikārasūtragāthā bhavati | "tatrādau prabhutā tāvajjīvatvaṃ dehamānatā | amūrtattvaṃ ca caitanyamupayogāttathā kramāt ||1|| kartṛtā bhoktṛtā karmāyuktatvaṃ ca trayaṃ tathā | kathyate yogapadyena yatra tatrānupūrvyataḥ || 2||"

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta tadanaṃtaraṃ evaṃ kattā' ityādigāthādvayena krameṇa karmasaṃyuktatvaṃ karmarahitatvaṃ ca kathayatīti parihāramukhyatvena saptagāthā gatāḥ | evaṃ pāṭhakrameṇāṣṭadaśagāthābhiḥ sthalapaṃcakenaikāṃtamatanirākaraṇāya tathaivānekāṃtamatasthāpanāya ca sāṃkhyamatānusāriśiṣyasaṃbodhanārthaṃ kartṛtvaṃ bauddhamatānuyāyiśiṣyaṃ prati bodhanārthaṃ bhoktṛttvaṃ sadāśivamatāśritaśiṣyasaṃdehavināśārtha karmasaṃyuktatvamiti kartṛtvabhoktṛtvakarmasuyuktavādhikāratrayaṃ jñātavyaṃ ! ita ūrdhvaṃ jīvāstikāyasaṃbandhinavādhikāravyākhyānānaṃtaraṃ “ekko jema mahappā' ityādigāthātrayeṇa jīvāstikāyacūlikā evaṃ paṃcāstikāyaṣadravyapratipādakaprathamamahādhikārasaṃbaṃdhikāreṣaṣṭāṃtarādhikāre madhye tripaṃcaśadgāthāpramitacaturthāṃtaradhikāre samudāyapātanikā |

śuddha niścayanayase viśuddha jñānadarśana svabhāvamaya śuddha caitanya prāṇoṃse jītā hai tathā vyavahāra nayase karmake udayase utpanna jo dravya va bhāvarūpa iṃdriyādi cāra prāṇa unase jītā hai, jīvegā yā pahale hī jī cukā hai so jīva eka sacetana hai, śeṣa pudgalādi pāṃca dravya acetana va ajīva haiṃ | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ jīva adhikāra dūsarā huā | amūrtika śuddha ātmāse vilakṣaṇa, sparśa rasa gaṃdhavarṇavālī mūrti kahalātī hai jisake yaha mūrti ho usako mūrta yā puhala kahate haiṃ | jīva dravya yadyapi anupacarita asadbhūta vyavahāra nayase mūrtika hai to bhī śuddha niścaya nayase amūrtika hai| dharma, adharma, ākāśa aura kāla dravya saba amūrtīka hai | niścayase puhala mūrtika hai| śeṣa pāṃca amūrtika haiṃ | chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ tīsarā mūrtta adhikāra huā |
lokamātrapramāṇa asaṃkhyeya pradeśadhārī eka jīva dravya hai isī taraha dharma adharma bhī asaṃkhyāta asaṃkhyāta padreśadhārī haiṃ, ākāśa anaṃta pradeśī hai va pula saṃkhyāta, asaṃkhyāta anaṃta pradeśa hai | isa taraha ye pā~ca dravya jinako paṃcāstikāya saṃjñā hai sapradeśī yā bahupradeśī hai jaba ki kāla dravya bahu pradeśamaya kāyapanekī śakti na rakhaneke kāraṇa va mātra eka pradeśa rakhaneke kāraṇa apradeśī hai | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ cauthā pradeśa adhikāra pūrṇa huā |
dravyārthikanayase dharma, adharma, ākāśa mātra eka-eka dravya haiṃ tathā jīva puhala aura kāla aneka dravya haiṃ | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ ekāneka adhikāra pā~cavā~ huā |
sarva dravyoṃko avakāśa denekī sāmarthya rakhanese kṣetramaya eka ākāśadravya hai, śeṣa pāṃca dravya usameṃ rahanevāle akṣetrī haiṃ | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ kṣetra adhikāra chaṭhā pūrṇa huā |
eka kṣetrase dūsare kṣetrameṃ jāneko halanacalanarūpa kriyā kahate haiṃ| isa kriyāko rakhanevāle jīva aura pudgala do hī dravya haiṃ| dharma, adharma, ākāśa aura kāladravya akriya haiṃ- kriyārahita haiṃ, kyoṃki sthira haiṃ | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ sātavā~ kriyā adhikāra huā |
dharma, adharma, ākāśa, kāladravya yadyapi arthaparyāyake pariṇamanakī apekṣā anitya hai tathāpi mukhyatāse ye nitya haiṃ kyoṃki inameṃ ākārake palaṭanerūpa vibhāva vyaṃjanaparyātha nahīṃ hotī hai | dravyārthikanayase yadyapi jīva aura pudraladravya nitya haiṃ tathāpi agurulaghukī pariṇatirūpa svabhāvaparyāya tathā vibhāva vyaṃjanaparyāya ( jisase ākāra palaṭatā hai ) kī apekṣāse anitya haiṃ | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ nitya nāmakā āṭhavā~ adhikāra huā |
pula, dharma, adharma, ākāśa aura kāladravya vyavahāranayase jīvake śarīra, vacana, mana, śvāsośvāsa banāne meṃ gatimeṃ sthitimeṃ avagāha pānemeṃ va vartana karanemeṃ kramase sahakārī hote haiṃ

isaliye ye kāraṇa kahalāte haiṃ jabaki jīvadravya yadyapi guru śiṣyādikī taraha paraspara eka dūsarekā kāma karate haiṃ tathāpi puddalādi pāṃca dravyoṃkā kucha bhī upakāra nahīṃ karate haiṃ| isaliye akāraṇa haiṃ- yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ navama kāraṇa adhikāra huā |
śuddha pāriṇāmika parama bhāvako grahaṇa karanevālī śuddha dravyārthika nayase yadyapi jīva baṃdha, mokṣa, dravya yā bhāva rūpa puṇya pāpa tathā ghaṭa-ghaṭa ādikā kartā nahīṃ hai tathāpi aśuddha niścaya nayase śubha aura aśubha upayogoṃse pariṇamana karatā huā puṇya tathā pāpake baṃdhakā kartā aura unake phalakā bhoktā hai tathā jaba yaha jīva viśuddha ātma dravyake samyak śraddhāna, samyak jñāna va samyak cāritramaya śuddhopayogase pariṇamana karatā hai taba mokṣakā bhī kartā hai aura mokṣake phalako bhoktā hai| śubha, aśubha tathā śuddha bhāvoṃmeṃ pariṇamanekā hī kartāpanā sarva ṭhikāne jānanā yogya hai| pudgalādi pā~ca dravya apane- apane svabhāvameṃ hī pariṇamana karate haiṃ yahī unameṃ kartāpanā hai| vāstavameṃ ve puṇya pāpādike kartā nahīṃ hai kintu akartā | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ dasavā~ kartā adhikāra pūrṇa huā |
loka va aloka meṃ phailā huā eka ākāśa dravya hai isaliye yaha ākāśa sarvagata kahā jātā hai| lokākāśameṃ vyāptikī apekṣā dharma-adharma sarvagata haiṃ| jīva dravya eka jīvako apekṣāse loka pūrṇakī avasthāko choḍa़kara asarvagata hai arthāt samudghātake sivāya śarīra pramāṇa ākāradhārī hai | nānā jīvoṃkī apekṣāse sarva lokākāśa jīvoṃse pūrṇa hai | pula dravya lokapramāṇa mahāskaṃdhakī apekṣāse sarvagata hai | śeṣa pugaloṃkī apekṣā sarvagata nahīṃ hai | lokabharameṃ pudgala bhare hue hai isaliye bhī puddala sarvagata hai tathā kāla dravya eka- eka kālāṇu dravyakī apekṣā sarvagata nahīṃ hai parantu loka ke pradeśoṃke pramāṇa asaṃkhyāta kāṇuoṃ kī apekṣā lokameṃ sarvagata hai| yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ gyārahavāṃ sarvagata adhikāra pūrṇa huā |
I
yadyapi sarva dravya vyavahāra nayase eka kṣetrameṃ avagāha pā rahe haiṃ isase eka dūsare meṃ praveśa kara rahate haiṃ tathāpi niścayanayase apane apane cetana yā acetana svarūpako nahīṃ choḍa़te haiṃ | yaha chaḥ dravyoṃmeṃ anyonya praveśa nāmakā bārahavā~ adhikāra pūrṇa huā |

i
ina daśa gāthāoṃke madhyameṃ jīva aura jñānakā abheda saṃkṣepase sthāpanake liye 'ṇa viapyadi' ityādi sūtra tīna haiṃ| phira dravya aura guṇoṃkā abheda honepara bhī nāma ādi kī apekṣā bheda haiṃ aisā samarthana karate hue 'vavadesā' ityādi gāthāaiṃ tīna haiṃ, phira eka kṣetrameṃ rahanevāle guṇa aura dravya jo paraspara ayutasiddha hai arthāt kabhī mile nahīṃ arthāt jinakā abheda siddha hai va jo paraspara amiṭa ādhāra ādheyarūpa haiṃ, una guṇa aura dravyarūpa bhinnabhinna jīvādi padārthoṃmeṃ paraspara pradeśa bheda hai to bhī ātmā aura jñānakā pradeśa bheda nahīṃ hai | ātmāyeṃ jñāna hai jaise taṃtuoṃmeṃ padapanā hai | ityādi jo sambandha hai ki yaha isameṃ hai so samavāya sambandha kahalātā hai | naiyāyikamatameṃ isī samavāyakā niṣedha hai isake batāneke liye 'ṇa hi so samavāyāhiṃ" ityādi sūtra do haiṃ| phira guṇa aura guṇīmeṃ kisī apekṣā abheda haiṃ isa sambandhameṃ dṛṣṭāṃta dāṣṭantikā vyākhyāna karaneke liye 'vaṇṇarasa' ityādi sūtra do haiṃ | dṛṣṭāṃtakā lakṣaṇa kahate haiṃ| 'dṛṣṭau aṃtau dharmoṃ svabhāva agnidhūmayoḥ iva sādhyasādhakayoḥ vādiprativādibhyāṃ kartṛbhūtābhyām avivādena yatra vastuni sa dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ" iti arthāt agnimeṃ dhūmakī taraha jisa padārthameṃ sādhya sādhakake svabhāva vādī prativādīko binā kisī virodha yā vivādake dikhalāī paḍa़e so dṛṣṭāṃta hai | saṃkṣepase jaise dṛṣṭāṃta lakṣaṇa hai vaise dāntikā lakṣaṇa hai | isa taraha pahale kahīṃ nava gāthāoṃmeṃ sthala pāṃca tathā yahā~ daśa gāthāoṃmeṃ sthala

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana bhaṭṭacākamatake āśrita śiṣyakī apekṣāse sarvajñasiddhi karane ke liye nīce likhe dohemeṃ kathita nava dṛṣṭāṃtoṃ se kathana kiyā hai kyoṃki bhaṭṭa-cārvāka mata kisī sarvajñako nahīṃ mānatā hai |
uddhṛtagāthārtha--yahā~ sālakī siddhi liye mai summata diye haiṃ| jaise ratnadīpameṃ prabhā kamatī baḍha़tī dikhanese anumāna hotā hai ki kisīmeṃ adhikase adhika teja honā cāhiye| isī taraha jagatake prāṇiyoṃmeṃ jñāna kamatī baḍha़tī dikhalāī paḍa़tā hai taba kisī bhī jīvameṃ jñānakī pūrṇatā saṃbhava hai| jisameṃ pūrṇa jñāna hai vahī sarvajña hai| yahī bhāva anya dṛṣṭātoṃkā bhī hai jaise (2) sūryakī kiraṇakā kamatī baḍha़tī teja, (3) candramākī cāṃdanī, (4) nakṣatrakī jyoti ( 5 ) ghātu pāṣāṇoṃkā prakāśa, (6) sonekī camaka (7) cāṃdīkī camaka (8) sphaṭikakī jyoti (9) āgakī tejī | sonā, cāṃdīkā dṛṣṭāṃta isaliye bhī kāryakārī hogā ki ye śuddha hote-hote śuddha bhī pāe jāte haiṃ| isī taraha aśuddha ātmā śuddha hotehote pūrṇa śuddha bhī pāyā jānā cāhiye, vahī sarvajña hai ||2||
yaha jīvahī śuddha aśuddha bhāvoṃkā kartā hai yaha vyākhyāna jīva akartā hai aise ekāṃta matadhārī sāṃkhyamatake anusārī śiṣyako samajhāneke liye kiyā hai| tathā yaha jīva bhoktā hai| yaha vyākhyāna 'kartā karmokā phala nahīṃ bhogatā hai kyoṃki vaha kṣaṇika hai isa matake mānanevāle bauddha matake anusārī śiṣyake saṃbodhanake liye kiyā hai| yaha jīva apane śarīrake pramāṇa rahatā hai, yaha kathana naiyāyika, mīmāṃsaka va kapila matānusārī ādi śiṣyoṃke saṃdeha nivāraṇake liye kiyā hai, kyoṃki ve ātmāko sarvavyāpī yā aṇumātra mānate haiṃ| yaha jīva amūrtika hai| yaha vyākhyāna bhaṭṭa cārvāka matake anusārī śiṣyake saṃbodhanake liye kiyā hai, kyoṃki ve jīvako atīndriya jñānadhārī śuddha jaḍa़se bhinna nahīṃ mānate haiṃ | yaha jīva dravyakarma va bhāvakarmase saṃyukta hotā hai, yaha vyākhyāna sadāśivamatake nirākaraṇake liye kiyā hai, kyoki ve ātmāko sadā mukta va śuddha hī mānate haiṃ | isa taraha matoṃke dvārā artha jānanā yogya hai | āgamadvārā arthakā vyākhyāna yaha hai ki yaha jīva jīvatva cetanā ādi svabhāvoṃkā dhārī hai yaha bāta paramāgamameṃ prasiddha hī hai| yahā~ yaha bhāvārtha hai ki-karmokī upādhise utpanna jo mithyātva va rāgādi rūpa samasta vibhāva pariṇāma unako tyāgakara upādhi rahita kevalajñānādi guṇoṃse yukta śuddha jīvāstikāya hī niścayanayase upādeyarūpase bhāvanā karane yogya hai|
isa taraha śabdārtha, nayārtha, matārtha, āgamārtha tathā bhāvārtha vyākhyānake kālameṃ sarva ṭhikāne yathāsaṃbhava jānanā yogya hai |

yahā~ śiṣyane praśna kiyā ki pahale jīvāstikāyakī samudāya pātanikāmeṃ cārvāka ādi ke abhiprāyasaṃ vyākhyāna kiyā thā phira yahā~ kyoṃ kahā gayā aisā pūrvapakṣa honepara ācārya samādhāna karate haiṃ ki pahale to isa vyākhyānake kramako batāneke liye prabhutā ādi adhikārakī mukhyatāse nava adhikāra sūcita kiye gaye ki vītarāga sarvajñakī siddha honepara hī vyākhyāna meṃ pramāṇapanā prāpta hotā hai, kyoṃki kahā hai- 'vaktṛprāmāṇyādvacanaprāmāṇyamiti' | bhāvārtha- vaktākī pramāṇatāse usake vaccanakī pramāṇatā hotī hai| yahā~ phira isaliye kahā hai ki dharmopadārthako sattā hone para hī usake dharma yā svabhāvoṃkā vicāra kiyā jātā hai yaha āgamakā vacana hai, isaliye cetanāguṇa ādi viśeṣa dharmakā ādhārabhūta viśeṣa lakṣaṇarūpa jīvarūpa dharmīkī siddhi honepara una cetanā guṇa ādi viśeṣa dharmokā vyākhyāna ghaṭa sakatā hai | isīko batāneke liye jīvakī siddhipūrvaka anyamatoṃkā nirākaraṇa karate hue nava adhikaroṃkā upadeśa kiyā gayā hai| isameṃ koī doṣa nahīṃ hai || 27 ||

hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-28 anvayārtha—( karmamalavipramukta: ) karmamalase mukta ātmā ( ūrdhva ) ūpara (lokasya antam ) lokake antako ( adhigamya ) prāpta karake ( sa: sarvajñānadarśī ) vaha sarvajña-sarvadarśī ( anaṃtam ) anaṃta ( anindriyam ) anindriya ( sukham ) sukhakā ( labhate ) anubhava karatā hai|

ātmā ( karmarajake ) paradravyapaneke kāraṇa karmarajase sampūrṇarūpase jisa kṣaṇa chūṭatā hai ( mukta hotā hai ), usī kṣaṇa ( apane ) ūrdhvagamana svabhāva ke kāraṇa lokake antako pākara āge gatihetukā abhāva hone se ( vahā~ ) sthira huā kevalajñāna aura kevaladarśana ( nija ) svarūpabhūta hone ke kāraṇa unase na chūṭatā huā anaṃta atīndriya sukhakā anubhava karatā hai | usa mukta ātmāko, bhāvaprāṇa jisakā lakṣaṇa ( svarūpa ) hai aisā jīvatva hotā hai cidrūpa jisakā lakṣaṇa hai aisā cetayitṛtva hotā hai, citpariṇāma jisakā lakṣaṇa hai aisā ‘upayoga' hotā hai, prāpta kiye gue samasta ( ātmika ) adhikāroṃ kī śaktimātrarūpa prabhutva hotā hai, samasta vastuoṃse asādhāraṇa aise svarūpakī niṣpattimātrarūpa ( nija svarūpako racanerūpa ) kartṛtva hotā hai, svarūpabhūta svātatrya jisakā lakṣaṇa hai aise sukhakī upalabdhi rūpa bhoktṛtva hotā hai, atīta anantara (antima) śarīrānusāra avagāhapariṇāmarūpa dehapramāṇapanā hotā hai, aura upādhike sambandhase ātyaṃtika ( sarvathā ) vivikta ho jāne se amūrtapanā hotā hai | ( mukta ātmāko ) karmasuyuktapanā to kadāpi nahīṃ hotā, kyoṃki dravyakarmoṃ aura bhāvakarmoṃse pūrṇa mukta ho gayā hai dravyakarma ve pudgalasvandha hai aura bhāvakarma ve cidvivarta caitanya ke vikāra haiṃ| citśakti anādi jñānāvaraṇādikarmose samparkase ( sambandhake ) saṃkucita vyāpāravālī honeke kāraṇa jñeyabhūta viśvake ( samasta padārthoke ) eka-eka deśameṃ kramaśa: vyāpāra karatī huī vivartanako prāpta hotī hai| kintu jaba jñānāvaraṇādikarmokā samparka vinaṣṭa hotā hai taba vaha jñeyabhūta viśvake sarva deśoṃmeṃ yugapad vyāpāra karatī huī kathaṃcit kūṭastha hokara, anya viṣayako prāpta na hotī huī vivartana nahīṃ karatī | vaha yaha ( citśaktike vivartanakā abhāva ), vāstavameṃ niścita ( niyata, acala ) sarvajñapanekī aura sarvadarśīpanekī upalabdhi hai yahī, dravyakarmoke nimittabhūta bhāvakoṃke kartṛtvakā vināśa hai yahī, vikārapūrvaka anubhavake abhāvake kāraṇa aupādhika sukhaduḥkhapariṇāmoṃke

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta bhoktṛtvakā vināśa hai, aura yahī, anādi vivartanake khedake vināśase jisakā anaṃta caitanya susthita huā hai aise ātmāko svataṃtrasvarūpānubhūtilakṣaṇa sukhakā bhoktṛtva hai ||28||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-28 atha mokṣasādhakatvaprabhutvaguṇadvāreṇa sarvajñasiddhayarthaṃ muktāvasthasyātmanaḥ kevalajñānādirūpaṃ nirūpādhisvarūpaṃ darśayati:. kammamalavippamukko-dravyakarmabhāvakarmavipramuktaḥ san uḍḍūṃ logassa aṃtamadhigaṃtā-ūrdhvagatisvabhāvatvāllokasyāṃtamadhigamya prāpya, so savvaṇāṇadarisī-parato dharmāstikāyābhāvāttatraiva lokāgre sthitaḥ san , sarvaviṣaye jñānadarśane sarvajñānadarśane te vidyete yasya sa bhavati sarvajñānadarśī| evaṃbhūtaḥ san kiṃkaroti ? 'lahai suhamaṇidiyamaṇaṃta' labhate | kiṃ ? sukhaṃ | kathaṃbhūtaṃ ? atīndriyaṃ | punarapi kathaṃbhūtaṃ ? anaṃtamiti | kiṃca viśeṣa—-pūrvasūtroditajīvatattvādinavādhikāreṣu madhye karmasaṃyuktatvaṃ vihāya śuddhajīvatvaśuddhacetanāśuddhopayogādayo'ṣṭādhikārā yathāsaṃbhavamāgamāvirodhenātra muktāvasthāyāmapi yojanīyā iti sūtrābhiprāya: ||28||
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā- 28 utthānikā-āge mokṣakā sādhakapanā va prabhutva guṇake dvārā sarvajñakī siddhike liye mukta ātmākā kevalajñānādi rūpa upādhirahita svabhāva hai aisā dikhalāte haiṃ____ anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-(so) so saṃsārī jīva ( kammamalavippamukko) karmoṃ ke malase mukta hokara (savaṇāṇadarisī) sarvajña aura sarvadarśī hotā huā ( uhuṃ) ūpara jākara va ( logassa aṃtaṃ) lokākāśake aṃtameṃ ( adhigaṃtā ) prāpta hokara ( aṇiṃdiyaṃ) indriya rahita ( suhaṃ) sukhako ( lahadi ) prāpta karatā yā anubhava karatā rahatā hai |
viśeṣārtha-yaha jīva jñānāvaraṇādi dravya karma va rāgadveṣādi bhāva karma va śarīrādi no karma ina tīna prakāra karmoṃse bilakula chūṭakara kevalajñāna aura kevalajñānadarśanase sarvajña aura sakaladarśī hotā huā apane ūrdhvagamana svabhāvase ūpara jākara lokākāśake aṃtameṃ ṭhahara jātā hai-āge tharmāstikāyake na honese nahīṃ jātā hai| vahā~ siddhakṣetra meṃ ṭhaharā huā kyā karatā hai ? usakā samādhāna karate haiṃ ki vaha siddhātmā atīndriya anaṃta svābhāvika ānandako bhogā karatā hai| isa sūtrakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki pūrva sūtrameṃ kahe pramāṇa nau adhikāroṃmeṃse karmasaṃyukta choḍa़kara śuddha jīvapanā, śuddha cetanapanā, śuddha upayogapanā ādi āṭha adhikāra yathāsambhava āgama meṃ virotha na lāte hue muktāvasthāmeṃ bhī jāna lene cāhiye|

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
samayavyākhyā gāthā--29 jādo sayaṃ sa cedā savvaṇhū savva-loga-darasī ya | pappodi suha-maṇaṃtaṃ avvābādhaṃ sagama-muttaṃ ||29|| jātaḥ svayaṃ sa cetayitā sarvajñaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvalokadarśī ca|
prāpnoti sukhamanaṃtamavyābādhaṃ . svakamamūrtam || 29|| idaṃ siddhasya nirupādhijñānadarśanasukhamarthanam | ātmā hi jñānadarśanasukhasvabhāva: saṃsārāvasthāyāmanādikammarāsaṃkociśamaśaśipathyasaṃpaṇa kidhit kicijjānāti paśyati, parapratyayaṃ mūrtasaṃbaddhaṃ savyābādhaṃ sāntaṃ sukhamanubhavati ca | yadā tvasya karmakleśāḥ sāmastyena praṇaśyanti, tadā'nargalāsaṃkucitātmaśaktirasahāyaḥ svayameva yugapatsamayaṃ jānāti paśyati, svapratyayamamūrtasaṃbaddhamavyābādhamanantaṃ sukhamanubhavati ca | tata: siddhasya samastaṃ svayameva jānataḥ paśyataḥ, sukhamanubhavataśca svaṃ, na pareṇa prayojanamiti ||29||
hindī samayavyākhyā gāthā-29 anvayārtha (sa: cetayitā ) vaha cetayitā (ātmā) ( sarvajñaḥ ) sarvajña ( ca ) aura ( sarvalokadarśī ) sarvalokadarśī ( svayaṃ jātaḥ ) svayaṃ hotā huā, ( svakam ) svakīya ( amūrtam ) amūrta ( avyābādhaṃ ) avyābādha ( anaṃtam ) anaṃta ( sukham ) sukhako ( prāpnoti ) prāpta karatā
ṭīkā-yahā~ siddhake nirupādhijñāna, darśana aura sukhakā samarthana hai|
vāstavameṃ jñāna, darśana aura sukha jisakā svabhāva hai aisā ātmā saṃsāradaśāmeṃ, anādi karmakleśa dvārā ātmaśakti saṃkucita kī gaī honese, paradravyake samparka dvārā ( indriyādike sambandha dvārā ) kramaśa: kucha-kucha jānatā hai aura dekhatā hai tathā parāśrita, mūrta ( indriyādi ) ke sātha sambandhavālā, savyābādha ( bādhāsahita ) aura sānta sukhakā anubhava karatā hai, kintu jaba usake karmakleśa samasta vināśako prāpta hote haiṃ taba, ātmaśakti anargala ( niraṃkuśa )
aura asaṃkucita honese, vaha asahāyarūpase svayameva yugapad saba ( sarva dravyakṣetrakālabhāva ) jānatā hai aura dekhatā hai tathā svāśrita, mūrta ( indriyādi ) ke sātha sambandha rahita, avyābādha
aura anaṃta sukhakā anubhava karatā hai| isaliye saba svayameva jānane aura dekhanevāle tathā svakīya sukhakā anubhavana karanevāle siddhako parase ( kucha bhī ) prayojana nahīṃ hai ||29||

atha yadeva pūrvoktaṃ nirupādhiśānadarśanavarūna 'jāda samiti' vacanena punarapi samarthanaṃ karotiḥ -- jādo sayaṃ sa cedā savvaṇhū savvaloyadarisī ya - ātmā hi niścayanayena kevalajñānadarśanasukhasvabhāvastāvat ityaṃbhūtopi saṃsārāvasthāyāṃ karmāvṛtaḥ san kramakaraṇavyavadhānajanitena kṣāyopaśamikajñānena kimapi kimapi jānāti tathābhūtadarśanena kimapi kimapi paśyati tathā cendriyajanitaṃ bādhāsahitaṃ parādhīnaṃ mūrtasukhaṃ cānubhavati sa eva cetayitātmā niścayanayena svayameva kālādilabdhivaśātsarvajño jātaḥ sarvadarśī ca jātaḥ | evaṃ jātaḥ san kiṃkaroti ? pāvadi iṃdiyarahidaṃ avvābāhaṃ sagamamuttaṃ prāpnoti labhate | kiṃ ? sukhamityadhyāhāraḥ | kathaṃbhūtaṃ sukhaṃ ? indriyarahitaṃ | punarapi kathaṃ bhūtaṃ ? bādhārahitaṃ | punarapi kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ? svakamātmatvaṃ | punaśca kiṃrūpaṃ ? mūrtendriyanirapekṣatvādamūrtaṃ ca | atra svayaṃ jātamiti vacanena pūrvoktameva nirupādhitvaṃ samarthitaṃ | tathā ca svayameva sarvajño jātaḥ sarvadarśī ca jāto niścayanayeneti pūrvoktameva sarvajñatvaṃ sarvadarśitvaṃ ca samarthitamiti |
111
atha bhaṭṭacārvākamatānusārī kaścidāha - nāsti sarvajño'nupalabdheḥ kharaviṣāṇavat | tatra pratyuttaraṃ dīyate - kutra sarvajño nāstyatra deśe tathā cātrakāle kiṃ jagattraye kālatraye vā ? yadyatra deśe kāle nāstīti bhaṇyate tadā sammatameva | atha jagattraye kālatrayepi nāsti tatkathaṃ jñātaṃ bhavatā ? jagattrayakālatrayaṃ sarvajñarahitaṃ jñātaṃ cedbhavatā tarhi bhavāneva sarvajñaḥ | kuta iti cet ? yo sau jagattrayaṃ kālatrayaṃ jānāti sa eva sarvajñaḥ, yadi punaḥ sarvajñarahitaṃ jagattrayaṃ kālatrayaṃ na jñātaṃ bhavatā tarhi jagattraye kālatrayepi sarvajño nāstīti kathaṃ niṣedhaḥ kriyate tvayā |
atha mataṃ—kimatrodāharaṇaṃ yathā kaściddevadatto ghaṭarahitabhūtalaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā paścād brūte atra bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti yuktameva, anyaḥ kopyaṃdhaḥ kimevaṃ brūte atra bhūtale ghaṭo nāstyapi tu naivaṃ, tathā yosau jagattrayaṃ kālatrayaṃ sarvajñarahitaṃ pratyakṣeṇa jānāti sa eva sarvajñaniṣedhe samartho, na cānyo'ndha iva, yastu jagattrayaṃ kālatrayaṃ jānāti sa sarvajñaniṣedhaṃ kathamapi na karoti | kasmāt ? jagattrayakālatrayaviṣayaparijñānasahitatvena svayameva sarvajñatvāditi | kiṃcānupalabdheriti hetuvacanaṃ tadayuktaṃ | kathamiti cet ? kiṃ bhavatāṃ sarva jñānupalabdhiruta jagattrayakālatrayavartipuruṣāṇāṃ vā, yadi bhavatāmanupalabdhiretāvatā sarvajñābhāvo na bhavati | kathamiti cet ? paramāṇvādisūkṣmapadārthāḥ paracetovṛttayaśca bhavadbhiryadi na jñāyaṃte tarhi kiṃ na santi atha jagattrayakālatrayavartipuruṣāṇāṃ sarvajñānupalabdhistatkathaṃ jñātaṃ bhavadbhiriti pūrvamevaṃ vicāritaṃ tiṣṭhati iti hetudūṣaṇaṃ | yadapyuktaṃ kharaviṣāṇavaditi dṛṣṭāṃtavacanaṃ tadapyayuktaṃ | kathamiti cet ? khare viṣāṇaṃ nāsti na sarvatra, gavādau pratyakṣeṇa dṛśyate tathā sarvajñopi vivakṣitadeśakāle nāsti na ca sarvatra iti saṃkṣepeṇa hetudūṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtadūṣaṇaṃ ca jñātavyaṃ |
