ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana atha mataṃ-sarvajñābhāve dūṣaṇaṃ dattaṃ bhavadbhistarhi sarvajñasadbhāve kiṃ pramāṇaṃ? tatra pramāṇaṃ kathyate-asti sarvajña: pūrvoktaprakāreṇa bādhakapramāṇābhāvāt svasaṃvedyasukhaduḥkhādivaditi, athavā dvitīyamanumānapramāṇaṃ kathyate| tadyathā-sūkṣmā vyavahitadeśāṃtaritakālāntaritasvabhāvāṃtaritārthā dharmiṇaḥ kasyāpi puruṣaviśeṣasya pratyakṣā bhavaṃtītisādhyo dharmaḥ | kasmāddheto: ? anumānaviṣayatvāt, yadyadanumānaviṣayaṃ tattatkasyāpi pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathāgnyādi| anumānaviṣayāścaite tasmātkasyāpi pratyajñā bhavaṃtīti | yadyanna kasyāpi pratyajñaṃ tattannānumānaviṣayaṃ yathā khapuṣpādi anumānaviṣayāścaite | tasmātkasyāpi pratyajñā bhavanti | iti saṃkṣepeṇa sarvajñasadbhāba pramāṇaṃ jñātavyaṃ | vistareṇāsiddhaviruddhānaikāntikākiṃcitkarahetudūṣaṇasamarthanamanyatra sarvajñasiddhau vistareṇa bhaṇitamāste, atra punaradhyātmagraṃthatvānnocyate | idameva vītarāgasarvajñasvarūpaṃ samastarāgādi-vibhāvatyāgena niraṃtaramupādeyatvena bhāvanīyamiti bhāvārtha: ||29|| evaṃ prabhutvavyākhyānamukhyatvena gāthādvayaṃ gataṃ |
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-29 | utthānikā-āge pahalī gāthāmeṃ jo siddha bhagavānake uyādhi rahita jñānadarśana sukha batāyā hai usī kā hī 'jādo hī sayaṃ' isa vacanase phira bhī samarthana karate haiṃ
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( sa cedā) vaha ātmā ( sayaṃ) apane āpa hī ( saviṇhu) sarvajña (ya) aura ( savvalokadarasī) sarva lokālokakā dekhanevālā ( jādo) hotā huā ( aṇataṃ) aṃtarahita, ( avyābādhaṃ) bādhā rahita ( sagam) apane ātmāse hī utpanna tathā (amutta) amūrtika (suha) sukhako ( pappodi) pātā hai yā anubhava karatā hai|
viśeṣārtha-yaha ātmā niścayanayase kevalajñāna kevaladarśana va parama sukhamaya svabhāvako rakhanevālā honepara bhī saṃsārakī avasthāmeṃ karmose ācchādita hotā huā kramase jānanevālā indriya jñānarūpī kṣayopaśama jñānase kucha-kucha jānatā hai | tathā cakṣu, acakṣu darśana se kuchakucha dekhatā hai tathā iṃdriyoṃse utpanna bādhā sahita parādhīna mūrtika sukhakā anubhava karatā hai| dahī cetanevālā ātmā jaba kāla ādikī labdhike vaśameṃ svayameva sarvajña aura sarvadarśī ho jātā hai taba atīndriya bādhā rahita ātmīka svādhīna amūrtika sukhakā hī anubhava kiyā karatā hai | yahā~ jo yaha kahā hai ki yaha ātmā svayaṃ hī sarvajña sarvadarśī ho jātā hai, isa vacanase yaha samarthana kiyā hai ki niścayanayase yaha pahilese hī upādhi rahita hai tathā sarvajña aura sarvadarśī hai | __ yahā~ koī bhaṭṭacārvāka matake anusāra calanevālā kahatā hai ki sarvajña koī nahīṃ hai kyoṃki koī dekhanemeṃ nahīṃ ātā hai| jaise gadhāke sīṃga nahīṃ dekhanemeṃ āte haiṃ ? isa

﻿________________

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta śaṃkākā samādhāna karate haiṃ ki tūne kahā ki kahīṃ sarvajña dikhalāī nahīṃ paḍa़tā hai to yahā~ isa kālameṃ nahīṃ dikhalāī paḍa़tā hai ki tīna jagata tīna kālameṃ koī sarvajña nahīṃ hotā hai, so yadi terā kahanā hai ki isa melā yā isameṃ sārvaja nahīṃ hai to hameṃ mānya hī hai aura jo tū kahe ki tīna jagat yā tīna kālameṃ koī sarvajña nahīṃ hai to tumane kaise jānā ? yadi tumane tīna jagat aura tīna kālako sarvajña binā jāna liyā hai to tuma hī sarvajña ho, kyoki sarvajña vahīṃ hotā hai jo koī tīnoṃ lokoṃ ko jānatā hai aura yadi tū sarvajña nahīṃ hai aura tū tīna jagat tīna kālako nahīṃ jānatā hai taba tū yaha kaise niṣedha kara sakatā hai ki tīna jagat va tīna kālameṃ bhī koī sarvajña nahīṃ hotā hai| isī para dṛṣṭāṃta kahate haiṃ-jaise koī devadatta ghaṭa binā pṛthvītalako āṃkhoṃ se dekha kara phira kahatā hai ki yahā~ isa pṛthvītalapara ghaṭa nahīṃ hai to usakā kahanā ṭhīka hī hai, anya koī andha puruṣa binā dekhe kyā yaha kaha sakatā hai ki yahā~ bhī ghaṭa nahīṃ hai arthāt vaha nahīṃ kaha sakatā| isī taraha jo koī tīna loka va tīna kālako dekhakara pratyakṣa yaha jāna sake ki sarvajña nahīṃ hai vahī sarvajñakā niṣedha kara sakatā hai| dūsarā jo saba jānatā hī nahīṃ vaha andheke samāna niṣedha nahīṃ kara sakatā hai parantu jo tīna loka tīna kālako jānatā hai vaha sarvajñakā niṣedha kisī taraha nahīṃ kara sakatā hai, kyoṃki vaha svayaṃ sarvajña hogayā-usako tīna loka tīna kālake viṣayakā jñāna hai | āpane yaha hetu kahā ki sarvajñakī prāpti nahīṃ hai so bhī ṭhīka nahīṃ hai kyoṃki isameṃ praśna hai ki āpako sarvajñakī prāpti nahīṃ hai yā tīna jagat va tīna kālake puruṣoṃko bhī sarvajñakī prāpti nahīṃ hai| yadi āpako sarvajñakī prāpti nahīṃ hai to isase sarvajña kā abhāva nahīṃ ho sakatā hai, kyoṃki āpa to paramāṇu ādi sūkṣma padārthoko va dūsare ke cittakī bātoṃko bhī nahīṃ jānate haiṃ to āpake na jānane se ye saba nahīṃ hai aisā mānā jāyagā, so nahīṃ sakatā hai yadi kaho ki tīna jagat va tīna kālake puruṣoṃko bhī sarvajñakī prāpti nahīṃ hai to yaha āpane kaise jānā ? isakā pahale hī vicāra kara cuke haiṃ| yaha doṣa āpake hetumeṃ ātā hai tathā jo āpane 'gadheke sīṃga samāna hai" aisā dṛṣṭāṃta rūpa vacana kahā so bhī ṭhīka nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki gadhemeṃ sīṃga nahīṃ hai parantu sarva ṭhikāne sīṃga nahīṃ hai aisā nahīṃ hai-go ādimeṃ sīṃga pratyakṣa dikhalāī paḍa़tā hai taise hī sarvajña bhī isa deśameṃ yahā~ nahīṃ hai kintu sarvatra nahīṃ hai aisā nahīṃ hai| isa taraha saṃkṣepase āpake hetu tathā dṛṣṭāṃtako doṣa ātā hai, aisā jānanā cāhiye |
phira śaṃkākāra kahatā hai ki sarvajñake abhāvameṃ to āpane dūṣaṇa diyā, parantu yaha to batāiye ki sarvajñake sadbhāvameṃ kyā pramāṇa hai ? yahā~ pramāṇa kahate haiṃ-sarvajña koī hai, kyoṃki jaisā pahale kahā hai usa taraha usake liye bādhaka pramāṇa koī nahīṃ hai jaise apane anubhavameṃ āne yogya sukha duḥkha hai | athavā dūsarā anumāna pramāṇa yaha kahā jātā hai ki sūkṣma padārtha vyavahita yā dūsare se ḍhake padārtha, dūradeśavartī padārtha, bhūta bhāvīkālake

siddhoṃke vāstavameṃ dravyaprāṇake dhāraṇasvarūpase jīvasvabhāva mukhyarūpase nahīṃ hai, ( unheṃ ) jīvasvabhāvakā sarvathā abhāva bhī nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki bhāvaprāṇake dhāraṇasvarūpa jīvasvabhāvakā mukhyarūpase sadbhāva hai | aura unheṃ śarīrake sātha nīrakṣīrakī bhāṃti ekarūpavṛtti nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki śarīrasaṃyogake hetubhūta kaṣāya aura yogakā viyoga ho gayā hai isaliye ve atīta anantara śarīrapramāṇa avagāharūpa pariṇata hone para bhī atyanta deha rahita haiṃ| aura vacanagocarātīta unakī mahimā hai, kyoṃki laukika prāṇake dhāraṇa binā aura śarīrake sambandha binā sampūrṇarūpame prāpta kiye hue nirupādhi svarūpa dvārā ve satata pratapate haiṃ ( pratāpavaṃta vartate hai ) ||35||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-35 atha siddhānāṃ śuddhajīvatvaṃ atītaśarīpramāpākāśavyāpakatvāditi vyavahāreṇa bhūtapūrvakanyāyena kiṃcannyūnacaramaśarīrapramāṇaṃ ca vyavasthāpayati jesiṃ jīvasahāo ṇatthi-yeṣāṃ karmanitadravyaprāṇabhāvaprāṇarūpo jīvasvabhāvo nāsti, te hoti siddhā—te bhavanti siddhā iti saṃbaṃdhaḥ | yadi tatra dravyabhāvaprāṇā na saṃti tarhi bauddhamatavatsarvathā jīvābhāvo bhaviṣyatītyāśaṃtryottaramāha-abhāvā ya savvahā tattha ṇatthi-śuddha-sattācaitanyajñānādirūpaśuddhabhāvaprāṇasahitatvāttatra siddhāvasthāyāṃ sarvathā jīvābhāvopi nāsti ca | siddhāḥ kathaṃbhūtāḥ | bhiṇṇadehā-aśarīrāt śuddhātmo viparītāḥ śarīrotpattikāraṇabhūtā: manovacanakāyayogāḥ krodhādikaṣāyāśca na saṃtīti bhinnadehā aśarīrā jñātavyāḥ | - punaśca kathaṃbhūtā: vacigoyaramatīdā--sāṃsārikadravyaprāṇabhāvaprāṇarahitā api vijayaṃ te prattapaṃtīti hetorvacanagocarātītasteṣāṃ mahimā svabhāvaḥ athavā samyaktvādyaṣṭaguṇaistadaṃtargatānaṃtaguṇairvā sahitāstena kāraṇana vacanagocarātītā iti | athātra yathā paryātharūpeṇa padārthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ dṛṣṭvātivyāpti kṛtvā dravyarūpeṇāpi kṣaṇikatvaṃ manyate saugataḥ tathendriyādidaśaprāṇasahitasyāśuddhajīvasyābhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā mokṣāvasthāyoṃ kevalajñānādyanaṃtaguṇasahitasya śuddhajīvasyāpyabhāvaṃ manyata iti bhāvārtha: ||35||

hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-37 utthānikā--āge jīvakā abhāva honā so mukti hai aisā jo saugata yā bauddhakā mata hai usakā nirākaraṇa karate haiṃ
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( sassadam ) śāśvatapanā ( aya) aura ( ucchedaṃ ) vyayapanā [bhavyam ] bhavyapanā (ca) aura [ abhavyaṃ] abhavyapanā, (suṇṇaṃ) śūnyapanā [ca ] aura ( idaraṃ ) dūsarā aśūnyapanā (vipaṇāṇaṃ) vijñāna [ aviṇṇāṇaṃ] tathā avijñāna ( sambhāve asadi) siddha jīvakī sattā vidyamāna na rahate hue [ṇa vi jujjadi ] nahīṃ ho sakate haiṃ
viśeṣārtha-siddha bhagavānakī sattā sadā banī rahatī hai isīse unameṃ nīce likhe āṭha svabhāva siddha hote haiṃ ( 1) śāśvatapanā isaliye hai ki ve siddha bhagavāna apane ṭaṃkotkīrṇa jñātā draṣṭāmaya eka svabhāva rūpase sadā bane rahate haiṃ, naṣṭa nahīṃ hote haiṃ| (2) uccheda yā vyayapanā isaliye hai ki paryāyakī apekṣā agurulaghuguṇameṃ ṣaṭsthāna patita hāni vṛddhikī apekṣāse sadā hī paryāyoṃkā nāśa huā karatā hai ye vyayapanā utpādakā avinābhāvī hai | yaha utpāda vyaya honā haraeka dravyakī paryāyakā svabhāva hai | (3) bhavyapanā isalie ki vikāra rahita cidānaṃdamaya eka svabhāvase ve sadā pariṇamana karate rahate haiṃ, yaha unameṃ honāpanā yā bhavyapanā hai| ( 4 ) abhavyapanā-isaliye ki ve siddha avasthāmeṃ kabhī bhī atīta mithyātva va rāgādi vibhāva pariṇāmoṃmeṃ nahīṃ pariṇamana kareṃge| ina rūpa na honā yahī abhavyapanā hai | (5) śūnyapanā-isaliye ki apane śuddhātpadvyase vilakṣaṇa jo paradravya, parakṣetra, parakāla va parabhāva catuṣṭaya hai inakā nāstipanā yā śūnyapanā yā abhāva siddhoṃke vidyamāna hai| (6) aśūnyapanā-isaliye hai ki apane paramātmā sambandhī nijadravya, nijakṣetra, nijakāla va nijabhāva rūpa catuṣṭayase unameṃ astipanā hai | ve kabhī apane śuddha guṇoṃse rahita nahīṃ hote haiṃ (7) vijñāna-isaliye ki ve sarva dravyake sarvaguṇa va sarva paryāyoṃko eka samaya prakāśa karaneko samartha pūrṇa nirmala kevalajñāna guṇase pūrṇa haiṃ | (8) avijñāna-isaliye ki unameṃ aba matijñānādi kṣayopaśamarūpa alpajñānakā abhāva hai arthāt aba ve ina vibhāvarūpa aśuddha jñānoṃse śūnya hai| isa taraha ye nityapanā, anityapanā, bhavyapanā, abhavyapanā, śūnyapanā, aśūnyapanā, vijñāna, avijñāna se āṭha svabhāva- yadi jīvakī sattā mokṣameṃ na mānī jāve to-siddha nahīṃ ho sakate haiṃ | jīvakī sattā rahate hue hī siddha hote haiṃ inake astitvase hī muktimeṃ śuddha jīvakī sattā rahatī hai| yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki vahī śuddha jīva grahaṇa karane yogya hai || 37 ||

( aba unake svarūpakā kathana kiyā jātā hai—) ātmā vāstavameṃ anaṃta, sarva ātmapradeśoṃmeṃ vyāpaka, viśuddha jñānasāmānyasvarūpa hai | vaha ( ātmā ) vāstavameṃ jñānāvaraṇakarmase ācchādita pradeśavālā vartatā huā, (1) usa prakārake ( arthāt matijñānake ) āvaraṇake kṣayopaśamase aura indriya-manake avalambanase mūrta-amūrta dravyakā vikalarūpase ( apūrṇa rūpase) viśeṣataḥ avabodhana karatā hai vaha ābhinibodhikajñāna hai, (2) usa prakārake ( arthāt śrutajñānake ) āvaraṇake. kṣayopaśamase aura manake avalambanase mūrta-amūrta dravyakā vikalarūpase viśeṣata: avabodhana karatā hai vaha śrutajñāna hai, (3) usa prakārake ( avadhi jñānake ) āvaraṇake kṣayopaśamase hī mūrta dravyakā vikalarūpase viśeṣataḥ avabodhana karatā hai vaha avadhijñāna hai, (4) usa prakārake ( manaḥ paryaya jñāna āvaraṇake ) kṣayopaśamase hī paramanogata ( dūsaroṃke manake sātha sambandhavāle ) mūrta dravyakā vikalarūpase viśeṣata: avabodhana karatā hai vaha manaḥ paryayajñāna hai (5) samasta āvaraṇake atyanta kṣayase, kevala hī ( akalā ātmā hī) mūrta-amūrta dravyakā sakalarūpase viśeṣata: avabodhana karatā hai vaha svābhāvika kevalajñāna hai | (6) mithyādarśanake udayake sātha ābhinibodhikajñāna hī kumatijñāna hai, (7) mithyādarśanake udayake sākā śrutajñāna hī kuśrutajñāna hai, (8) mithyādarśanake udayake sātha avidhijñāna hī vibhaṃga jñāna hai | isa prakāra ( jñānopayogake bhedoṃkā ) svarūpakā kathana hai| isa prakāra matijñānādi āṭha jñānopayogoṃkā vyākhyāna kiyā gayā ||41||
saṃskṛta tātparya vṛtti gāthā-41 || atha jñānopayogabhedānāṃ saṃjñā pratipādayati,-ābhinibodhikaṃ matijñāna śrutajñānamavadhijñānaṃ manaḥ paryayajñānaṃ kevalajñānamiti jñānāni paṃcabhedāni bhavanti | kumatijñānaṃ kuśrutajñāna vibhaṃgāvadhijñānamiti ca mithyājñānatrayaṃ bhavati | ayamatra bhāvārthaḥ | yathaikopyādityo meghāvaraṇavaśena bahudhā bhidyate tathā niścayanayenākhaṃḍaikapratibhāsasvarūpopyātmā vyavahāranayena karmapaṭalaveṣṭitaḥ sanmatijñānādibhedena bahudhā bhidyata iti ||41|| ityaṣṭavidhajñānopayogasaṃjñākathanarūpeṇa gāthā gatā|

sudaṇāṇaṃ puṇa ṇāṇī bhāṃti laddhīya bhāvaṇā ceva | uvaogaṇayaviyapyaṃ ṇāṇeṇa ya vatthu atyassa ||2||

viśeṣārtha - vahī ātmā jisane matijñānase padārthako jānā thā, jaba śrutajñānāvaraṇīya karmake kṣayopaśama honepara jo mūrta aura amūrta padārthoṃko jānatā hai usako jñānījana śrutajñāna kahate haiṃ | vaha śrutajñāna jo śaktikī prāpti rūpa hai so labdhi hai, jo bāra-bāra vicāra rūpa hai so bhāvanā hai | usīke upayoga aura naya aise bhī do bheda haiṃ| upayoga śabdase vastuko grahaṇa karanevapalā pramāṇa jñāna lenā cāhiye tathā naya śabdase vastuke eka deśako grahaṇa karanevālā jñātākā abhiprāya mātra lenā cāhiye, kyoṃki kahā hai- "nayo jñāturabhiprāyaḥ " ki naya jñātākā abhiprāya mātra hai| jo guṇaparyāya rūpa padārthakā sarva rūpase jānanā so pramāṇa hai aura usake kisī eka guṇa yā kisī eka paryāya mātrako mukhyatāse jānanā so naya hai | yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki grahaṇa karane yogya paramātma tattvakā sādhaka jo viśuddha jñānadarśana svabhāva rūpa śuddha ātmīka tattvakā samyak śraddhāna jñāna va ācaraṇa rūpa jo abheda ratnatrayarūpa bhāvaśruta hai so niścayanayase grahaṇa karane yogya hai aura vyavahāranayase isī bhāvaśrutajñānake sādhaka dravyaśrutako grahaṇa karanā cāhiye ||2||

anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-[ puṇa] phira ( ajjavaṇāṇaṃ) ṛjupatijñāna (ca) aura ( viulamadī ṇāṇaṃ) vipulamatijñāna ( duvihaṃ) yaha do prakārakā [ maṇaṇāṇaṃ ] manaḥparyayajñāna hotā hai [ ede ] ye donoṃ [ appamattassa ] apramatta munike ( uvaoge) upayogameṃ [ saṃjamaladdhī ] saṃyamake dvārā prāpta hote haiṃ|

anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-(davvaguṇāṇaṃ) dravya aura guṇoṃkā ( avibhattaṃ ) ekapanā tathā ( aṇaṇṇataṃ) abhinnapanā hai ( ṇiccayāhū ) niścayanayake jñātā ( vibhattaṃ aṇṇattaṃ) unakā vibhāga va bhinnapanā ( ṇicchati) nahīṃ cāhate haiṃ| (vā) athavā ( tersi) unakā ( tabivarīdaṃ) usase viparīta svabhāna arthāt bhikāpanese viṇīta abhinanā (hi) niścayase sarvathā nahīṃ mānate haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-jaise paramāṇukā varṇādi guṇoṃ ke sātha abhinnapanā hai arthāt unameṃ paraspara pradeśoṃkā bheda nahīṃ hai taise śuddha jīva dravyakā kevalajñānādi pragaṭarūpa svābhāvika guṇoṃke sātha aura aśuddha jīvakā matijñāna ādi pragaṭarūpa vibhāva guṇoṃke sātha tathā śeṣa dravyoṃkā apane- apane guṇoṃke sātha yathāsaṃbhava ekapanā hai arthāt dravya aura guṇoṃke bhinna-bhinna pradeśoṃkā abhāva jānanā cāhiye niścaya svarūpake jñātā jainācārya jaise himācala aura vidhyācala parvatameṃ bhinnapanā hai athavā eka kṣetra meṃ rahate hue jala aura dūdhakā bhinna pradeśapanā hai aisā bhinnapanā dravya aura guṇoṃkā nahīṃ mānate haiṃ to bhī ekāṃtase dravya aura guṇoṃkā anyapanese viparīta ekapanā bhī nahīṃ mānate haiṃ | arthāt jaise dravya aura guṇoṃmeṃ pradeśoṃ kī apekṣā abhinnapanā hai taise saṃjñā ādikī apekṣāse bhī ekapanā hai aisā nahīṃ mānate haiṃ | arthāt ekāṃtase dravya aura guṇoṃkā na ekapanā mānate haiṃ na bhinnapanā mānate haiṃ | binā apekṣā ke ekatva va anyatva donoṃko nahīṃ mānate haiṃ, kiṃtu bhinna-bhinna apekṣāse donoṃ svabhāvoṃko mānate haiṃ| pradeśoṃkī ekatāse ekapanā hai | saṃjñādikī apekṣā dravya aura guṇoṃkā anyapanā hai aisā ācārya mānate hai | yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki viśuddha jñāna darśana svabhāvamayī ātmatattvase bhinnarūpa jo viṣaya va kaṣāya haiṃ unase rahita hokara usī parama caitanya svarūpa paramātmā tattva se jo ekatā rūpa nirvikalpa parama āhlādamayī sukhāmṛta rasake svādakā anubhava hai usako dhāranevāle jo puruṣa hai unako vahī ātmā grahaṇa karane yogya hai jo lokākāśa pramāṇa asaṃkhyāta śuddha pradeśoṃke sātha tathā apane kevalajñānādi guṇoṃke sātha eka rūpa hai || 45|| __ isa taraha guṇa aura guṇīmeṃ saṃkṣepase abheda aura bhedake vyākhyānakī apekṣā gāthā tīna kahīṃ| ye gāthāeṃ naṃ0 43, 44 va 45 jānanī |

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta vavadesā saṃṭhāṇā saṃkhā visayā yā hoti te bahugā | te tesi-maṇaṇṇatte aṇṇatte cāvi vijjate ||46||
vyapadeśāḥ saṃsthānāni saṃkhyā viṣayāśca bhavanti te bahukāḥ |
te teṣāmananyatve anyatve cāpi vidyante ||46|| yathā devadattasya gaurityanyatve ṣaṣṭīvyapadeśaḥ, tathā vṛkṣasya śākhā dravyasya guṇā ityananyatve'pi | yathā devadattaḥ phalama1śena dhanadattāya vṛkṣāvāṭikāyāmacinotītyanyatve kārakavyapadeśaḥ, tathā mṛttikā ghaṭabhāvaṃ svayaṃ svena svasmai svasmāt svasmin karotītyātmānamātmātpanātmane ātmana ātmani jānātītyananyatve'pi | yathā praśodevadattasya prāṃśugaurityanyatve saṃsthānaṃ, tathā prāṃśovṛkṣasya prāṃśuḥ śākhābharo mūrtadravyasya guṇā ityananyatve'pi | yathaikasya devadattasya daśa gāva ityanyatve saṃkhyā, tathaikasya vṛkṣasya daśa śākhāḥ ekasya dravyasyānaṃtā guṇā ityananyatve'pi | yathā goṣṭhe gāva ityanyatve viṣayaḥ, tathā vṛkṣe śākhā: dravye guṇā ityananyatve'pi | tato na vyapadeśādayo dravyaguṇānāṃ vastutvena bhedaṃ sādhayaṃtīti ||46||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-46 anvayārtha--[ vyapadeśā: vyapadeśa, [ saṃsthānāni ] saṃsthāna | saṃkhyā. [ca ] aura [ viṣayāḥ ] viṣaya [te bahukāḥ bhavanti ] aneka hote haiṃ| [te] ve [vyapadeśa ādi ], ( teṣām ) dravya-guṇoṃka ( anyatve ) anyapane meṃ ( ananyatve ca api ) tathā ananyapanemeṃ bhī [vidyate ] ho sakate haiṃ|
ṭīkā—yahā~ vyapadeśa ādi ekāntase dravya-guṇoṃke anyapanekā kāraṇa honekā khaṃḍana kiyā hai|
jisa prakāra “devadatta kī gāya'' isa prakāra anyapanemeṃ ṣaṣṭhīvyapadeśa ( chaṭhī vibhaktikā kathana ) hotā hai, usī prakāra "vṛkṣakī śākhā," "dravyake guṇa', aise ananyapanemeṃ ( ṣaṣṭīvyapadeśa ) hotā hai, jisa prakāra 'devadatta phalako aṃkuśa dvārā dhanadattake liye vṛkṣa parase bagīce meṃ toḍa़tā hai, aise anyapanemeṃ kārakavyapadeśa hotā hai, usī prakāra 'miṭṭī svayaṃ ghaṭabhāvako ( ghaḍārūpa pariṇāmako ) apane dvārā apane liye apanemeṃse apanemeṃ karatī hai, ātmā ātmāko ātmā dvārā ātmāke liye ātmāmeṃse ātmāmeṃ jānatā hai, aise ananyapane meṃ bhī [ kārakavyapadeśa ] hotā hai | jisa prakāra 'ū~ce devadattakī ū~cī gāya' aisā anyapane meṃ saṃsthāna hotā hai, usī prakāra 'viśāla vṛkṣakā viśāla śākhāsamudāya, “mūrta dravyake mūrta guṇa' aise ananyapane meṃ bhī [saṃsthāna ] hotā hai| jisa prakāra 'eka devadattakī dasa gāyeṃ aise anyapane meṃ meṃ saṃkhyā hotī hai, usī prakāra ‘eka vṛkṣako dasa śākhāe~', 'eka dravyake anaṃta guṇa' aise ananyapanemeṃ bhī ( saṃkhyā ) hotī hai| jisa prakāra ‘bāḍa़emeṃ gāyeṃ' aise anyapane meṃ viṣaya ( ādhāra ) hotā hai

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana usī prakāra 'vṛkṣameṃ śākhāe~, 'dravyameṃ guṇa' aise ananyapanemeṃ bhī ( viṣaya arthāt ādhāra ) hotā haiṃ : isaliye vyapadeśa ādi, dravya guṇoṃmeṃ vasturūpase bheda siddha nahīṃ karate ||46||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā-46 atha vyapadeśādayo dravyaguṇānāmekāṃtena bhinnatvaṃ sādhayaṃtīti samarthayati, -babadesā saṃṭhāṇā saṃkhā visayā ya-vyapadeśā: saṃsthānāni saṃkhyā viṣayāśca hoṃti-bhavanti te-te pūrvoktavyapadeśādaya: kati saṃkhyopetā: bahugā pratyekaṃ bahavaḥ te tesimaṇapaṇatte vijjaṃte te vyapadeśādayasteṣāṃ dravyaguṇānāṃ kathaṃcidananyatve vidyate | aṇṇatte cāvi kathaṃcidanyatve cāpi | naiyāyikāḥ kila vadanti dravyaguṇānāṃ yadyekāṃtena bhedo nāsti tarhi vyapadeśādayo na ghaṭate, tatrottaramāhuḥ | dravyaguṇānāṃ kathaṃcidrede tathaivābhedepi vyapadeśādayaḥ saṃtīti | tadyathā-ṣaṭ ( ṣaṣṭī ) kārakabhedena saṃjñā dvividhā bhavati devadattasya gaurityanyatve vyapadeśaḥ, tathaiva vṛkṣasya śākhā jīvasyānaṃtajñānādiguṇā ityananyatvepi vyapadeśaḥ | kārakasaṃjñā kathyate| devadatta:-kartā phalaṃ karmatāmannamaṃkuśena karaṇabhūtena dhanadattāya nimitta vṛkṣātsakāśādvāṭikāyāmadhikaraṇabhūtāyāmavacinotītyanyatve kārakasaṃjñā tathaivātmā kartātmānaṃ karmatāpatramātmanā karaṇabhūtenātmane nimittamātmanaḥ sakāśādātmanyadhikaraṇabhūte dhyāvatītyananyatvepi kārakasaṃjñā | dīrghasya devadattasya dīghoṃ gaurityanyatve saṃsthānaṃ dīrghasya vṛkṣasya dīrghaśākhābhāra: mūrtadravyasya mūrtā guṇā ityabhede ca saṃsthānaṃ | saṃkhyā kathyate | devadattasya daśagāva ityanyatve saṃkhyā tathaiva vṛkṣasya daśaśākhā dravyasyānaṃtaguṇā ityabhedepi | viṣaya: kathyate goṣṭhe gāvaḥ iti bhede viṣaya: tathaiva dravyaguṇā ityabhedepi | evaṃ vyapadeśādayo bhedābhedābhyāṃ ghaṭate tena kāraṇena dravyaguṇānāmekāṃtena bhedaṃ na sādhayaṃtīti | atra gāthāyāṃ nāmakarmodayajanitanaranārakādirūpavyapadeśābhāvepi śuddhajīvāstikāyaśabdena vyapadeśyaṃ vācyaṃ niścayanayena samacaturasrādiṣaṭsasthānarahitamapi vyavahāreṇa bhūtapūrvakanyāyena kiṃcidūnacaramaśarīrākāreṇa saṃsthānaṃ | kevalajñānādyanaṃtaguṇarūpeṇānaṃtasaṃkhyānamapi lokākāśapramitāsaṃkhyeyaśuddhapradeśarūpeṇāsaṃkhyātasaṃkhyānaṃ paṃcendriyaviṣayasukharasāsvādaratānāmaviṣayamapi paṃcendriyaviṣayātītaśuddhātmabhāvanotpannavītarāgasadānaṃdaikasukharūpasarvātmapadeśaparamasamarasībhāvapariṇatadhyānaviṣayaṃ ca yacchuddhajīvāstikāyasvarūpaṃ tadevopādeyamiti tātparya ||46||
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā-46 utthānikā-āge yaha batāte haiṃ ki dravya aura guṇoṃmeṃ nāma ādikī apekṣā bheda hai to bhī ve ekāṃtase dravya aura guṇoṃkā bhinnapanā nahīṃ sādhate haiṃ|
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( vavadesā) kathana yā saṃjñāke bheda ( saṃṭhāṇā) ākārake bheda ( saṃkhā ) saṃkhyā yā gaṇanā ( ya visayā ) aura viṣaya yā ādhāra ( te bahugā hoti) ye bahuta prakārake hote haiṃ ( te) ye cāroṃ ( tesiṃ) una dravya aura guṇoṃkī ( aṇaṇṇatte ) ekatāmeṃ ( cāvi ) taise hī ( aṇṇatte ) usakī bhinnapanāmeṃ ( vijjate ) hote haiṃ|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta
155 viśeṣārtha-naiyāyika aisā kahate haiṃ ki yadi ekāṃtase dravya aura guṇoṃkā bheda nahīṃ hai to vyapadeśa ādi siddha nahīṃ hote haiṃ ? isakā uttara yaha hai ki dravya aura guṇoṃkī kisī apekṣā bheda va kisī apekṣā abheda honepara bhī vyapadeśa ādi ho sakate haiṃ| jaise ṣaṣṭhī vibhakti va kartā, karma, karaṇa, sampradāna, apādāna aura adhikaraṇa ye chaḥ kāraka do taraha hote haiṃ | eka bhedameṃ jaise devadattakī gau aisā kahā jāya, dūsare abhedameṃ jaise vṛkṣakī śākhā, jīvake anantajñānādi guṇa | kārakako batāte haiṃ ki devadatta nāmakā puruṣa kartā hokara phalarūpa karmako apane aṃkuśarūpa kāraṇase dhanadattake liye vṛkṣase bāga rūpa adhikaraṇameṃ toḍa़tā hai| yaha bhedameṃ saṃjñākārakakā dṛṣṭāṃta kahā, isameṃ chahoṃ hī kāraka bhinna-bhinna haiṃ| taise hī ātmā kartā hokara apane hī ātmarūpa karmako apane hī ātmārūpa karaṇa dvārā apane hī ātmāke nimitta apane ātmāko nikaṭatāse apane hī ātmārūpa ādhārameṃ dhyātā hai-yaha abhedameṃ cha: kārakoṃkā dṛṣṭāṃta hai | ina donoṃ dṛṣṭāṃtoṃmeṃ saṃjñākā bheda va abheda batāyā gayā| aba ākārakī apekṣā batāte haiṃ | aura dīrgha devadattasī sī hī hai-- gṛha bhedameṃ saṃsthāna hai, tathā dīrgha vṛkṣake dīrgha śākhākā bhāra hai tathā mūrta dravyake mūrtaguṇa hote haiṃ- yaha abhedameṃ saṃsthāna hai|
aba saṃkhyāko kahate haiṃ—devadattake dasa gāṃva haiṃ- yaha bhedameṃ saṃkhyā hai taise hī vṛkṣakī dasa śākhā haiṃ yā dravyake anaṃta guṇa haiṃ yaha abhedameṃ saṃkhyā hai| yahā~ gāthāmeṃ viṣaya śabdakā artha ādhāra hai use dikhāte haiṃ jaise goṣṭha ( gauśālā ) meṃ gāyeṃ haiṃ yaha bhedameṃ viṣaya kahā taise hī dravyameṃ guṇa hai yaha abheda meṃ viṣaya kahā| isa taraha vyapadeśa ādi bheda tathā abheda donoṃmeṃ siddha hote haiṃ isaliye dravya aura guṇoṃkā ekāṃtase bheda nahīṃ siddha hotā hai| isa gāthāmeṃ nāmakarma udaya se utpanna nara-nāraka ādi nāmoṃko niścayase na rakhatā huā bhī jo śuddha jīvāstikāyake nāmase kahane yogya hai, va niścayanayase jo samacaturastra ādi cha: śarīra ke saṃsthānoṃse rahita hai to bhī vyavahāranayase bhūtapūrva nyāyase aṃtima śarīrake ākārase kucha kama ākāradhārī saṃsthāna rakhatā hai tathā jo kevalajñāna ādi anaṃta guṇarūpase anaṃta saṃkhyāvāna hai to bhī lokākāśa pramāṇa asaṃkhyāta śuddha pradeśa rakhanese asaṃkhyāta saṃkhyā rakhatā hai tathā jo paṃcendriyake viṣayasukhake rasāsvādī jīvoṃkā viṣaya na honepara bhī paṃcendriyoṃke viṣayoṃse rahita śuddha ātmākī bhāvanāse utpanna jo vītarāga sadānaṃdamayī eka sukha rūpa dhyānakā viṣaya hai jo dhyāna sarva ātmāke pradeśoṃmeṃ parama samatā rasake bhāvameṃ pariṇamana kara rahā hai, aisā jo śuddha jīvāstikāya svarūpa ātmā hai vahī grahaṇa karane yogya hai, yaha tātparya hai ||46||

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
samaya vyākhyā gāthā-47 vastutvabhedābhedodāharaṇametat | ṇāṇaṃ dhaṇaṃ ca kuvvadi dhaṇiṇaṃ jaha ṇāṇiṇaṃ ca duvidhehiṃ | bhaṇṇaṃti taha pudhattaṃ eyattaṃ cāvi taccaṇhū ||47||
jñānaṃ dhanaṃ ca karoti dhaninaṃ yathā jñāninaṃ ca dvividhābhyām |
bhaṇaṃti tathā pṛthaktvamekatvaṃ cāpi tattvajñāḥ || 47|| yathā dhanaṃ bhinnāstitvanirvṛttaṃ bhinnāstitvanirvṛttasya, bhinnasaṃsthānaṃ bhinnasaṃsthānasya, bhinnasaṃkhyaṃ pinasaṃkhyā , bhinnatipayalayanika dhinnatiṣayalabdhavṛttikasya puruṣasya dhanīti vyapadeśaṃ pṛthaktvaprakāreṇa kurute, yathā ca jñānamabhinnāstitvanirvṛttamabhinnāstitvanirvṛttasyābhinnasaṃsthānamabhinnasaṃjñānasyābhinnasaṃkhyamabhinnasaṃkhyasyābhinnaviṣayalabdhavṛttikamabhinnaviṣayalabdhavṛttikasya puruṣasya jñānīti vyapadeśamekatyaprakāreṇa kurute, tathānyatrāpi | yatra dravyasya bhedena vyapadeśādiḥ tatra pṛthaktvaṃ, yatrābhedena tatraikatvamiti || 47||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā-47 anvayārtha— [ yathā ] jisa prakāra [ dhanaṃ ] dhana [ca ] aura [jñānaṃ ] jñāna [ninaṃ ] [puruṣako ] 'dhanī' [ca ] aura [ jñāninaṃ ] jñānī [ karoti ] karate haiṃ..[ dvividhābhyāma bhaṇati ] aisā do prakārase kahā jātā hai, [ tathā ] usī prakāra [ tattvajñāḥ ] tattvajña ( pṛthaktvaṃ ) [ca api ] tathā [ ekatvam ] ekatvako kahate haiṃ |
ṭīkā-yaha, vasturūpase bheda aura abhedakā udāharaṇa hai| jisa prakāra ( 1) bhinna astitvasaṃ racita ( 2 ) bhinna saṃsthānavālā (3) bhinna saṃglyāvālā aura (4) bhinna viṣayamaṃ ādhāra meṃ sthita aisā dhana (1) bhinna astittvase racita (2) bhitra saṃsthānavāle (3) bhinna saṃkhyāvāle aura (4) bhinna viṣayameṃ sthita aise puruṣako 'dhanī' esā vyapadeśa pṛthakva prakārase karatā hai, tathā jisa prakāra (1) abhinna astitvase racita (2) abhinna saṃsthānavālā (3) abhinna saṃkhyāvālā aura (4) abhinna viṣayameṃ sthita aisā jñāna (1) abhinna astitvase racita, (2) abhinna saṃsthānavāle, (3) abhitra saṃkhyāvāle aura (4) abhinna viṣaya meṃ sthita aise puruṣa ko 'jñānī' aisā vyapadeśa ekattvaprakārase karatā hai, usī prakāra anyatra samajhanā cāhiye | jahā~ dravyake bhedase vyapadeśa ādi hoṃ vahāṃ pṛthaktva hai, jahā~ ( dratyake ) abhedame ( vyapadeśa ādi ) hoṃ vahā~ ekatva hai ||47||

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta ṭīkā-dravya aura guṇoṃko arthāntarapanā ( bhinna padārthapanā ) ho to yaha nimnānusāra doṣa āyaṃgā| __ yadi jñānī [ātmā ] jñānase arthāntarabhūta ho to ( ātmā ) apane karaṇaaṃśa bimā kulhāḍa़ī rahita devadattakī bhāṃti karaṇakā vyāpāra karane meṃ asamartha honese na cetatā ( jānatā ) huā acetana hī hogā aura yadi jñāna jñānīse ( ātmāse ) arthāntarabhṛta ho to jñāna apane kartṛ aṃśake binā, devadattarahita kulhāḍokī bhāṃti, apane kartākā vyāpāra karane meṃ asamartha honese na cetatā ( jānatā ) huā acetana hī hogā, punaśca, yutasiddha pṛthak siddha aise jñāna

saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā 48 atha jñānajñāninoratyaṃtabhede doṣaṃ darśayati,—ṇāṇī-jñānī jīvaḥ, ṇāṇaṃ ca tahā-jñānaguṇāpi tathaina, atyaṃtariṃdo du-arthātarito bhinnastu yadi bhavati | kathaṃ | aṇṇamaṇṇassa-anyonyasaṃbandhitvena | ladā kiṃ dūṣaṇaṃ | doṇhaṃ acedaṇattaṃ-dvayorjñānajñāninoracetanatvaṃ jaḍatvaṃ, pasajadi-prāpnoti | tacca jaḍa़tvaṃ kathaṃbhūtaṃ | samma jiṇābamadaṃ– samyakaprakāreṇa jinānāmavamatamasaṃmatamiti | tathāhi | yathāgneguṇinaḥ sakāśādatyaṃtabhitraḥ satruṣṇatvalakṣaṇo guṇo dahanakriyā pratyasamartha: sanniścayena śītalo bhavati tathā jīvād guṇinaḥ sakāśādatyaṃtabhinno jñānagaṇaḥ padārthaparicchiti pratyasamartha: saniyamena jaḍa़o bhavati | yathoṣṇaguṇādatvaṃtabhinnaḥ san vahnirguṇī dahanakriyāṃ pratyasamartha: santriścana śītalo bhavati tathā jñānaguṇādatyaṃtabhinna: san jīvo guṇī padārthavicchitti pratyasamarthaḥ sanniścayena jahā bhavati | atha mataṃ yathā bhinnadātropakaraṇena devadatto lāvako bhavati tathā bhinnajānena jñānī bhavatīti | naivaṃ vaktavyaṃ | chedanakriyāṃ prati dātraṃ bāhyopakaraṇaṃ, vīryāṃtarāyakṣayopaśamajanitaḥ puruṣasya śaktiviśeṣastatrābhyaṃtaropakaraṇaṃ śaktyabhāve dātropakaraṇe hastavyāpāre ca sati chedanakriyā nāsti tathā prakāśopādhyāyādibahiraṃgasahakārisadbhāve satyabhyaṃtarajñānopakaraṇābhāve puṣasya padārthaparicchitikriyā na bhavatīti | atra yasya jñānasyābhāvājjīvo jaḍa: san vītarāgasahajasuṃdarānaṃdasyandi paramārthikasukhamupādayamajānana saṃsāre paribhramati tadeva rāgādivikalparahitaṃ nijaśuddhātmānubhūtijñānamupādeyamiti 'bhāvārthaḥ ||48|| evaṃ vyapadeśādivyākhyānamukhyatvena gāthātrayaṃ gataṃ |

ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana gāthā 3 meghāṭa lāvṛte dinakare pūrvameva prakāśastiṣṭhati paścātpaṭalavighaṭanānusāreṇa prakaṭo bhavati tathā jīve niścayanayana kramakaraṇavyavadhānarahitaṃ trailokyodaravivaravartisamastavastugatānaṃtadharmaprakāśakamakhaṃḍapratibhāsamayaṃ kevalajñānaṃ pūrvameva tiṣṭhati kiṃtu vyavahāranayenānādikarmāvṛtaḥ sanna jñāyane paścātkarmapaṭalavighaṭanānusāreṇa prakaṭībhavati na ca jīnādbahirbhūtaṃ tat jñānaṃ kimapi tiṣṭhanīti paścātmamavāyasaṃbaṃdhabalena jīva saṃbaddhaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvārtha: ||49||

saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā 64 atha parihāramukhyatve gāthāsaptakaṃ | taba gāthāsu saptasu madhye pudgalasya svayamupādāna kartṛtvamukhyatvena "āgāḍhagāḍha'' ityādipāṭhakrameṇa gāthātrayaṃ, tadanaṃtaraṃ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvavyākhyānopasaṃhāramukhyatvena ca "jīvā poggalakāyā" ityādi gāthādvayaṃ, tadanaṃtaraṃ baṃdhaprabhutvena mokṣaprabhutvena ca “evaṃ kattā bhottā" ityādi gāthādvayaṃ | evaṃ samudāyena parihāragāthāsūtrāṇi sapta | tadyathā | yathā śuddhaniścayena śaktirūpeṇa kevalajñānādyanaṃtaguṇapariṇataḥ sūkṣmajīvairniraṃtaraṃ loko bhṛtastiṣṭhati tathā pudattarapīti nirūpayati, ogāhagāḍhaṇicido-avagāḍhagāḍhanicitaḥ yathā pṛthvīkāyikādipaṃcavidhasūkṣmasthāvarairaṃjanacūrṇapūrṇasamudrakanyāyenāvagāḍhagāḍharūpeṇa nairaṃtayeṇa nicito bhṛtaḥ | kosauṃ | logo—lokaḥ | poggalakāyehiṃ tahā-pudgalakāyaiśca | kathā ? savvado-sarvapradeśeṣu | kathaṃbhṛtaḥ puga़lakāyaiḥ | suhumehi bādarehi ya-sūkṣmadṛṣṭyagocarairvādarairdṛṣṭiviṣayaiśca | katisaṃkhyopete: ? aṇaṃtāṇaṃnehianaṃtānaṃtaiḥ | kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ | vivihehi-vividhairaṃtarbhedena bahubhedairitti | atra karmavargaṇāyogyapudgalā vatrātmā tiṣṭhati tatrānānītā evaṃ pūrva tiṣṭhanti baṃdhakāle paścādāgamiṣyatyeva | yadyapi pūrva te tatrātmāvagāḍhagāḍhakṣetre kṣīranīranyāyena tiṣṭhanita tathāpi te heyāstebhyo bhinna: śuddhabuddhakasvabhāva: paramātmā sa evopādeya iti bhāvārthaḥ || 64||

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana svayaṃ upādāna kartāpanā haiṃ isakī mukhyatāse "ogāḍhagāḍha" ityādi pāṭhakramase tīna gāthāe~ haiṃ phira kāpanā aura bhoktāpanāke vyākhyānake saṃkocakī mukhyatāse 'jīvā poggalakāyā' ityādi gāthā do haiṃ phira baṃdhakā svāmīpanā aura mokṣakā svāmīpanā batāte hue "evaṃ kattā bhottā'' ityādi gāthā do haiṃ | isa taraha samudāyase pūrva pakṣake samādhānameṃ sāta gāthāeṃ haiṃ| pahalī gāthā kahate haiṃ ki jaise yaha loka sūkṣma jīvoṃse binā antarake bharā hai ( jo jīva śuddha niścayanayase kevalajñānādi anaṃtaguṇoṃke dhārī hai) vaise yaha pugaloṃse bhī bharā hai|
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-(logo) yaha loka ( sambado) saba taraphase ( suhamehi) sūkṣma ( vādarahiṃ ya) aura sthūla ( vivihehi ) nānā prakārake ( tāṇatehiṃ ) anaṃtānaṃta ( poggalakāyehiṃ) pudgalake skaṃdhose ( ogāḍha gāḍha ṇicito) pūrṇa rūpase bharā huā hai |
viśeṣārtha-jaise yaha loka pṛthvīkāya ādi pāṃca prakārake sūkṣma sthāvara jīvoṃse kajjalase pūrṇa bhī huī kajjaladānīkī taraha binā antarake bharā huā hai usī taraha yaha loka apane sarva asaṃkhyāta pradeśoṃmeṃ dṛṣṭigocara nānā prakārake anaṃtānaṃta pudgala skaṃdhoṃse bhī bharā hai| yahā~ prakaraṇameṃ jo karma vargaṇā yogya pudgalaskaṃdha hai ve vahā~ bhī maujūda haiṃ jahā~ ātmā hai | ve vahā~ binā anyatrase lāe hue maujūda haiṃ| pīche baṃdhakālameṃ aura bhī vargaṇāe~ āveṃgī| yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki yadyapi ve vargaṇāe~ jahā~ ātmā hai vahā~-pānīkī taraha kūṭakūṭakara bharī huī haiṃ tathāpi ve tyāgane yogya haiṃ| unase bhinna jo śuddha buddha eka svabhāvarūpa paramātmā hai so hī grahaṇa karane yogya hai || 64||

ātmā karoti svabhāvaṃ tatra gatāḥ pudgalāḥ svabhāvaiḥ |
gacchanti karmabhāvamanyonyāvagāhāvagāḍhāḥ || 65|| ātmā hi saṃsārāvasthāyāṃ pāriṇāmikacaitanyasvabhāvamaparityajannevānādigaṃdhanabaddhatvādanādimoharāgadveṣasnigthairaviśuddhaireva bhāvavivartate | sa khalu yatra yadā moharūpaṃ rāgarūpaṃ dveṣarūpaṃ vā svasya bhāṣamārabhate, tatra tadā tameva nimittīkṛtya jīvapradeśeṣu parasparāvagāhenānupraviṣṭā: svabhāvaireva pudgalāḥ karmabhāvamāpadhaṃta iti ||65||

anvayārtha - ( ātmā ) ātmā ( svabhāvaṃ ) ( moharāgadveṣarūpa ) apane bhāvako ( karoti ) karatā hai, (tatra gatā: pudgalāḥ ) ( taba ) vahā~ rahanevāle pudgala ( svabhāvaiḥ ) apane bhāvoṃse ( anyonyāvagāhāvagāḍhā: ) jīvameṃ ( viśiṣṭa prakārase ) anyonya- avagāharūpase praviṣṭa hue ( karmabhāvam gacchanti ) karmabhāvako prāpta hote haiṃ |
I
ṭīkā - anya dvārā kiye gaye binā karmakī utpatti kisa prakāra hotī hai usakā kathana haiṃ ātmā vāstava meṃ saṃsāra avasthāmeṃ pāriṇāmika caitanyasvabhāvako choḍa़e binā hī anādi baṃdhana dvārā baddha honese anādi moharāgadveṣa dvārā snigdha aise aviśuddha bhāvoṃrūpase hī vivartanako prāpta hotā hai ( pariṇamita hotā hai ) | vaha ( saṃsārastha ātmā ) vāstavameṃ jahā~ aura jaba moharūpa, rāgarūpa yā dveṣarūpa aise apane bhāvako karatā hai, vahā~ aura usa samaya usī bhāvako nimitta banākara pudgala apane bhāvoṃse hī jīvake pradeśoṃ meṃ (viśiṣṭattāpūrvaka ) paraspara- avagāharūpase praviṣṭa hue karmabhāvako prāpta hote haiṃ || 65 ||

ṣadravya--paṃcāstikāyavarṇana hokara ( avagāḍhā) atyanta gāḍhapaneke sātha ( kammabhāvaṃ) dravya karmapaneko ( gacchaṃti) prāpta ho jāte haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-praśna-śuddha niścayanayase rāgadveṣa moha rahita nirmala caitanyamayī jyoti sahita vītarāga ānandarūpa hī svabhāva pariṇāma ātmākā kahā jātā hai | rāgādi vibhāva pariṇāma ko svabhāva śabda se kyoṃ kahā ? uttara-baṃdhaprakaraṇa ke vaśa se aśuddha niścayanaya kī apekṣā rāgādi vibhāva pariṇāma ko svabhāva kahate haiṃ| isameṃ koī doṣa nahīṃ hai| yahā~ yaha kahā hai ki jaba yaha aśuddha ātmā apane rāgadveṣa moha sahita pariṇāmako karatā hai taba ātmāke dvārā roke hue śarīrakī avagāhanāke kṣetrameṃ ṭhahare hue yā prāpta hue karmavargaṇā yogya pudgala skandha apanī hī upādāna kāraṇarūpa śaktise dravyakarmakī avasthāko prāpta hojāte haiṃ aura te jīvale pradeśoṃ meṃ hama taraha paraspara eka kṣetrāvagāharūpa baṃdha jāte haiṃ jisa taraha dūdha pānī mila jātā hai ||65||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā 66 ananyakṛtatvaṃ karmaṇāṃ vaicitryasyātroktam | jaha puggala-davvāṇaṃ bahuppayā-rehiṃ khaṃdha-ṇivyattī | akadā parehiṃ diṭṭhā taha kammāṇaṃ viyāṇāhi ||66|| yathā pudgaladravyāṇāṃ bahuprakāraiḥ skaṃdhanirvṛttiḥ |
akṛtā parairdṛṣṭā tathā karmaṇāṃ vijānīhi ||66|| yathā hi svayogyacaṃdrārkaprabhopalaṃbhe saṃdhyābeṃdracāpapariveṣaprabhṛtibahubhiḥ prakāraiḥ pudgalaskaṃdha. vikalpā karjataranirapekṣā evotpacate, tathā svayogyajīvapariṇāmopalaṃbhe jñānāvaraṇaprabhṛtibhibahubhiḥ prakāraiḥ karmāṇyapi karjataranirapekṣāṇyevotpadyate iti || 66 ||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā 66 • anvayārtha—( yathā ) jisa prakāra ( pudgaladravyāṇāṃ ) pudgaladravyokī ( bahuprakāraiḥ ) aneka prakārako ( skaṃdhanirvṛttiḥ ) skaṃdharacanā ( paraiḥ akṛtā ) parase kiye gaye binā ( dṛṣṭā ) hotī dīkhatī haiṃ, ( tathā ) usī prakāra ( karmaṇāṃ ) karmoṃkī bahuprakāratā ( vijānīhi ) parase akṛta jāno|

viśeṣārtha-jaise isa lokameṃ candramā va sūryakī prabhāke nimitta hote hue bādala va saṃdhyāke samaya lālī va indradhanuṣa yā maṃḍala ādike rūpameṃ nānā prakārase pudgala vargaṇāe~ svayaṃ binā kisīkī kī huī pariṇamana kara jātī haiṃ vaise una jīvoṃke jo viśuddha jñāna darśana svabhāva thārī ātmatattavake samyaka śraddhāna jñāna va caritrakī bhāvanā rūpa abheda ratnatrayamaya kāraṇa samayasārase rahita haiṃ unake mithyādarśana va rāgadveṣādi pariṇāmoṃke nimittase karmavargaṇā yogya pudgala apane hī upādāna kāraṇoṃse binā jīvake upādāna kāraṇake jñānāvaraṇādi mūla va uttara prakṛti rūpa nānā prakārase pariṇamana kara jāte haiṃ || 66 ||

saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā 67 athākṛtakarmaṇa: kathaṃ phalaṃ bhukte jīva iti yosau pūrvapakṣaḥ kṛtastatra phalabhoktṛtvaviṣaye nayavibhāgena yuktiṃ darśayati, jīvā poggalakāyā-jīvakāyā: pudgalakāyāśca | kathaṃbhūtāḥ | aṇṇoṇṇāgāḍhagahaṇapaḍibaddhā-anyonyāvagāḍhagrahaṇapratibaddhāḥ svakīyasvakīyarāgādisrigdharūkṣādipariṇāmanimittena pūrvamevānyonyāvagāhena saṃśliṣṭarūpeṇa pratibaddhāḥ saṃtaḥ tiṣṭhanti tāvat| kāle vijujjamāṇāudayakā svakīyaphalaṃ datvā tinujārā nirjaśaṃ gataḥ kiṃ kurvanti | diti-nirvikāracidānaṃdaikasvabhāvajīvasya mithyātvarāgādibhiḥ sahaikatvarucirūpaṃ mithyātvaṃ taireva sahakatvapratipattirūpaṃ mithyājñānaṃ tathaivaikatvapariṇatirūpaṃ mithyācāritramiti mithyātvādibayapariṇatajīvānāṃ pudgalāḥ kartāro dadati prayacchati | kiṃ dadati ? suhadukkhaṃ-anākulatvalakṣaṇapāramārthikasukhādviparītaṃ paramākulatvotpādakamabhyaṃtare niśayena harṣaviṣādarūpaṃ vyavahāre punarvahirviṣaye vividheṣṭāniṣṭendriyaviṣayaprāptirūpaṃ kaṭukaviṣarasāsvādasvabhāvaṃ sāṃsārikasukhadu:khaṃ bhujaṃti-vītarāgaparamāhādaikarūpasukhāmṛtarasāsvādabhojanarahitā jīvā niścayena bhāvarūpaṃ vyavahāreṇa dravyarūpaṃ ca bhujaṃte sevaṃta ityabhiprāya: ||67|| evaṃ bhoktṛtvavyākhyānamukhyatvena gāthā gatā|
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā 67 utthānikā-āge śiṣyane jo pūrvapakṣa kiyā thā ki binā kiye hue karmoṃkā phala jīva kisa taraha bhogatā hai usīkā uttara naya vibhāgase jīva phalako bhogatā hai-aisā yuktipūrvaka dikhāte haiṃ|
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( jīvā ) saṃsārī jīva aura ( puggalakāyā) dravya karmavargaṇāoṃke puṃja ( aṇṇoṇṇāgāḍhagahaṇapaḍibaddhā) paraspara eka dūsaremeṃ gāḍha़ rūpase baṃdha rahe haiṃ [kāle ] udayakālameṃ [vijujjamāṇā ] pudgala jīvake viyoga pāte hue [ suhadukkhaṃ] sātā yā asātā rūpa sukha duḥkha [diti ] dete haiṃ [ bhuṃjaṃti ] taba jīva unako bhogate haiṃ |
viśeṣārtha-saṃsārī jīvoṃke apane-apane rāgādi pariṇāmoṃke tathā padaloṃmeṃ snigdha rukṣa guṇake kāraṇa dravya karmavargaṇāeṃ jīvake pradeśoṃmeṃ jo pahalese hī baṃdhī huī hotī haiṃ ve hī apanī sthitike pūrī hote hue udayameṃ ātī haiṃ taba apane-apane phalako pragaṭa kara jhaḍa़ jātī haiṃ-usī samaya ve karma anākulatā lakṣaṇa jo pāramārthika sukha hai usase viparīta parama ākulatāko utpanna karanevāle sukha tathā duḥkhako una jīvoṃko mukhyatāse detī haiṃ jo

198
ṣaḍdravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana mithyādṛṣṭi haiṃ arthāt jo nirvikāra cidānaṃdamaya eka svabhāvarūpa jīvako aura mithyātva rāgādi bhāvoṃko eka rūpa hī mānate haiṃ aura jo mithyājñānī haiṃ arthāt jinako yaha jñāna hai ki jīva rāga dveṣa mohādirūpa hī hote haiṃ tathā jo mithyācāritrī haiṃ arthāt jo apaneko rāgādike pariṇamanameṃ hī rata rakhate haiṃ aise mithyādarśana jñāna cāritra meṃ pariṇamana karate hue jīva abhyaṃtarameṃ aśuddha niścayase harṣa yā viṣādarūpa tathā vyavahārase bāharī padārthāsaṃ nānāprakāra iṣṭa aniṣṭa indriyoṃke viṣayoṃke prāptirūpa madhura yā kaṭuka viṣake rasake āsvādarūpa sāṃsārika sukha yā duḥkhako, vītarāga paramānaṃdamaya sukhāmṛtake rasāsvādake bhogako na pāte hue bhogate haiṃ | niścayase to ve apane bhāvoṃko hī bhogate haiṃ, vyavahārase ve padārthoko bhogate haiṃ aisā abhiprāya jānanā ||67|| . isa prakāra karmasaṃyogako mukhyatāse gāthā kahīṃ |
samaya vyākhyā gāthā 68 kartṛtvabhoktṛtvavyākhyopasaṃhāro'yam | tamhā kammaṃ kattā bhāveṇa hi saṃjudodha jīvassa | bhottā hu havadi jīvo cedaga-bhāveṇa kammaphalaṃ ||68||
tasmātkarmakartṛbhāvena hi saṃyutamatha jīvasya |
bhoktā tu bhavati jīvaścatakabhāvena karmaphalam ||68|| tata etat sthitaṃ niścayenātmanaḥ kartṛ, vyavahāreṇa jīvabhāvasya, jīvo'pi niścayenātmabhāvasya kartā, vyavahāreṇa karmaṇa iti | yathātrobhayanayābhyāṃ karma kartṛ, tathaikenāpi nayena na bhoktṛ | kutaḥ ? caitanyapūrvakānubhūtisadbhāvābhāvāt | tataścetanatvāt kevala eva jīvaḥ karma-phalabhūtānāṃ kathaṃcidātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhapariṇāmānāṃ kathaṃcidiṣṭāniṣṭaviṣayāṇāṃ bhoktā prasiddha iti ||67||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā 68 anvayārtha—-[tasmāt ] isaliye [atha jīvasya bhāvena hi saṃyutam ] jīvake bhāvase saṃyukta ( nimitta sahita ) aisā ( karma ) karma ( dravyakarma ) ( kartṛ ) kartā hai (niścayase apanā kartā aura vyavahārase jīvabhāvakā kartā, parantu vaha bhoktā nahīṃ hai)| ( 4 ) aura ( jīvaḥ ) ( mātra ) jīva hī ( cetakabhāvake kāraṇa ) ( karmaphalam ) karmaphalakā ( bhoktā ) bhoktā hotā hai|

paṃcāstikāya prābhṛta ṭīkā--yaha, kartṛtva aura śonāpakī kā khākā upasaṃhāra hai|
isaliye ( pūrvokta kathanase ) aisā niścita huā ki--karma niścayase apanā kartā hai, vyavahārase jīva bhāvakā kartā haiṃ, jīva bhī niścayase apane bhāvakā kartā hai, vyavahārase karmakā kartā hai|
jisa prakāra yahā~ donoṃ nayoṃse karma kartā hai, usī prakāra eka bhī nayase vaha bhoktā nahīṃ hai| kisaliye? kyoṃki use caitanyapūrvaka anubhūtikā sadbhāva nahīṃ hai| isaliye cetanapaneke kāraṇa mātra jīva hī karmaphalakā—kathaṃcit ātmāke sukhaduḥkhapariṇāmoṃkā aura kathaṃcit iṣṭāniṣṭa viṣayoṃkā-bhoktā prasiddha hai ||68||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā 68 atha kartṛtvabhoktṛtvopasaṃhāra: kathyate | tamhā-yasmātpūrvoktanavibhāgena jīvakarmaṇoḥ parasparopādānakartṛtvaṃ nāsti tasmātkāraṇāt, kamma kattā-karma kartṛ bhavati | keṣāṃ | niścayena svakīyabhāvānāṃ vyavahāreṇa rāgādijīvabhāvānāṃ jīvopi vyavahāreṇa dravyakarmabhāvānāṃ niścayena svakīyacaitanyabhāvānāṃ | kathaṃ bhūtaṃ satkarma svakīyabhāvānāṃ kartṛ bhavati | saṃjudā-saṃyuktaṃ, adha-atho| kena saṃyuktaṃ | bhāveṇa mithyātva rāgādibhāvena pariṇāmena, jīvasya-jīvasya jīvopi karmabhāvena saṃyukta iti bhoktā du-bhoktā puna: | havadi bhavati | kosau | jīvo-nirvikāracidānaṃdaikānubhūtirahito jīvaḥ | kena kṛtvā | cedagabhāveṇa-paramacaitanyaprakāśaviparītenāśuddhacetakabhāvena | kiṃ bhoktā bhavati | kammaphalaṃ. śuddhabuddha kasvabhāvaparamātmatattvabhāvanotpatraṃ yatsahajaśuddhaparamasukhānubhavanaphalaṃ tasmādviparītaṃ sāṃsārikasukhaduḥkhānubhavanarūpaṃ śubhāśubhakarmaphalamiti bhāvārtha: ||68|| evaṃ pūrvagāthā karmabhoktṛtvamukhyatvena, iyaṃ tu gāthā karmakartṛtvabhoktṛtvayorupasaṃhāramukhyatveneti gāthādvayaṃ gataṃ |
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā 68 utthānikā-āge kartā bhoktāpanekā kathana saṃkoca karate haiṃ |
anyayasahita sāmānyārtha-( tamhā) isaliye ( kamma) dravyakarma ( jīvassa ) jīvake [ bhāveṇa saṃjudo] bhāvase saṃyoga hotā huā [hi] niścayase [kattā] apanī karmarūpa avasthāoṃkā kartā hai ( adha) aise hī jīva bhī dravyakarmake udayake nimittase apane rāgādi bhāvoṃ kā kartā hai (du) paraṃtu [jīvo] jīva akelā ( cedagabhāveṇa) apane aśuddha cetanabhāvase ( kammaphalaṃ) karmoka phalakā [ bhottā] bhoganevālā ( havadi) ho jātā hai |
viśeṣārtha-kyoṃki pahale yaha kaha cuke haiṃ ki niścayase jīva dravya karmakā upādāna kāraṇa nahīṃ hai aura dravyakarma jīvake bhāvakā upādāna kāraṇa nahīṃ hai isaliye dravyakarma upādānarūpa apane jñānāvaraṇādi pariṇāmoṃkā kartā hai | vyavahārase jīvake rāgādi bhāvoṃkā

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana kartā hai, aise hī jīva bhī niścayase apane hī caitanya bhāvoṃkā kartā hai| vyavahārase dravyakarmabaṃdhakā kartā hai| yaha pudgala dravya jīvasambandhī mithyātva rāgādi bhāvake nimittase saṃyukta hokara apane karmarūpa avasthāoṃkā kartā hai| aise hī jīva bhī pūrva karmaki udayake nimittase rāgādi bhāvoṃkā kartā hai| tathā yaha jīva akelā nirvikāra cidānaṃdayaya eka anubhūtise rahita hotā huā apane parama caitanyake prakāśase viparīta aśuddha cetakabhāvase, śuddha buddha eka svabhāva paramātma tattvakī bhāvanā se utpanna jo sahaja hī śuddha parama sukhakā anubhava rūpa phala usase viparīta, sāṃsārika sukha aura duḥkhake anubhavarūpa śubha yā aśubha karmake phalako bhogatā hai yaha tātparya hai ||68||
isa taraha pūrvagāthāmeṃ karmoka bhoktāpanekī mukhyatāse yahā~ karmakā kartā aura bhoktāpanā donoṃke saṃkoca kathanakī mukhyatāse do gāthāeṃ kahīṃ|

śu gatat | evaṃ kattā bhottā hojjaṃ appā sagehi kammehiṃ | hiṃḍadi pāra-mapāraṃ saṃsāraṃ moha-saṃchaṇṇo || 69||
evaṃ kartā bhoktā bhavanātmā svakaiḥ karmabhiḥ ||

hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā 69 anvayārtha ( evaṃ ) isa prakāra ( svakaiḥ karmabhiḥ ) apane karmoṃse ( kartā bhoktā bhavan ) kartā bhoktā hotā huā ( ātmā ) ātmā ( mohasaṃchannaḥ ) mohācchādita vartatā huā ( pāram apāraṃ saṃsāraṃ ) sāṃta athavā anaṃta saṃsārameṃ ( hiṃḍate ) paribhramaṇa karatā hai|
ṭīkā-yaha, karmasaṃyuktapanekī mukhyatāse prabhutvaguṇakā vyākhyāna hai |
isa prakāra pragaṭa prabhutvaśaktike kāraṇa jisane apane karmoṃ dvārā kartṛtva evaṃ bhoktṛtvakā adhikāra grahaṇa kiyā hai aise isa ātmāko, anādi mohācchāditapaneke kāraṇa viparīta abhiniveśakī utpatti honese samayagjñānajyoti asta ho gaī hai, isaliye vaha sāṃta athavā anaṃta saṃsārameṃ paribhramaṇa karatā hai ||69||

201 saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā 69 atha pūrvaṃ bhaṇitamapi prabhutvaṃ punarapi karmasaṃyuktatvamukhyatvena daśayati, evaṃ kattā bhoktā hojjaṃ niścayena karmakartṛtvabhoktṛtvarahitopi vyavahāreṇaivaṃ pūrvoktanayavibhāgena kartā bhoktā ca bhūtvā | sa kaḥ | appā-ātmā | kai kāraṇabhūtaiḥ | sagehi kammehi--svakīyaśubhāśubhadravyābhāvakarmabhiḥ | evaṃbhṛtaṃ: san kiṃ karoti | hiṃḍadi-hiṃḍate bhramati | kaṃ | saṃsāraṃ niścayanayenānaṃtasaṃsāravyāptirahitatvenānaṃtajñānādiguṇādhārātparamātmano viparītaṃ caturgatisaṃsāraṃ | punarapi kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ | pāramapāraṃbhavyāpekṣayā sapāraṃ abhavyāpekṣayā tvapāraṃ | punarapi kathaṃbhūtaḥ sa ātmā ? mohasaṃchaṇṇo-viparītābhiniveśotpādakamoharahitatvena niścayenānaṃtasaddarśanādiśuddhaguṇopi vyavahāreṇa darśanacāritramohasaṃcchanna pracchādita ityabhiprāya: ||69|| evaṃ karmasaṃyuktatvamukhyatvena gāthā gatā|
hindī tātparyavṛtti gāthā 69 utthānikā-āge pahale jisa prabhutva svabhāvako batāyā thā usīko phira saṃyogapanekī mukhyatāse batāte haiṃ
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( evaṃ ) jaisā ūpara kaha cuke haiṃ isa taraha [ apyā ] yaha saṃsārī ātmā ( sagehiṃ kammehiṃ) apane hī śubha aśubha bhāva karmoke dvārā [ kattā] kartā (bhottā) aura bhoktā ( hojjhaṃ) ho karake ( mohasaṃchaṇṇo) moha yā mithyādarśanase chāyā huā ( pāram ) pāra hone yogya ( apāraṃ) athavā na pāra hone yogya ( saṃsāraṃ ) saṃsārameṃ ( hiṃḍati) bhramaṇa kiyā karatā hai |
viśeṣārtha-yadyapi niścayanayase bhāva karma aura dravya karmakā kartā tathā bhoktā jīva nahīṃ hai kintu apane śuddha bhāvakā hī kartā aura bhoktā hai tathāpi vyavahārase hī jaisā pahale kaha cuke haiṃ aśuddha niścayanayase apane hī śubha aśubha bhāvoṃkā aura vyavahārase śubha aśubha dravya karmokā kartā aura bhoktā huā isa cāra gatimaya saṃsārameṃ bhramaṇa kiyā karatā hai | yaha saṃsāra niścayanayase anaṃta saṃsārakī vyāptise rahita honeke kāraṇa anaṃta jñānādiguṇoṃke ādhārabhūta paramātmāse viparīta hai tathā bhavyakī apekṣā para hone yogya tathā abhavyakī apekṣā pāra hone yogya nahīṃ hai | yaha saṃsārī ātmā niścayanayase viparīta abhiprāyako paidā karanevāle mohase rahita hai aura anaṃta samyagdarśana ādi śuddha guṇoṃkā dhārī hai to bhī vyavahārase darśanamoha aura cāritramohakarmase ācchādita hotā hai ||69||

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana
samaya vyākhyā gāthā 70 karmaviyuktatvamukhena prabhutvaguṇavyākhyānametat | uvasaṃta-khīṇamoho maggaṃ jiṇa-bhāsideṇa samuvagado| ṇāṇāṇu-maggacārī ṇivvāṇa-puraṃ vajadi dhīro ||7||
upaśāṃtakṣīṇamoho mārga jinabhāṣitena samupagataḥ | 4
jñānānumārgacārī nirvāṇapuraṃ vrajati dhīraḥ ||70|| ayamevātmā yadi jinājñayā mārgamupagamyopaśāṃtakṣīṇamohatvātpahīṇaviparītābhiniveśaḥ samuddhitrasamyagjñānajyotiḥ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādhikāra parisamāpya samyakprakaṭitaprabhutvaśaktirjñānasyaivānumārgeṇa carati, tadā viśuddhātmatattvopalabharūpamapavarganagaraṃ vigāhata iti ||70||
hindī samaya vyākhyā gāthā 70 anvayārtha-( jinabhāṣitena mārga samupagataḥ ) jo ( puruṣa ) jinavacana dvārā mārgako prāpta karake { upaśāṃtakṣīṇamohaḥ ) upaśāṃtakṣīṇamoha hotā huā ( arthāt jise darśanamohakā upaśama, kṣaya athavā kṣayopaśama huā hai aisā hotā huā ) ( jñānānumārgacārī ) jñānānumārgameṃ vicaratā hai ( jñānakā anusaraṇa karanevāle mārgameṃ vartatā hai ), ( dhīraḥ ) vaha dhīra puruṣa (nirvāṇapuraṃ vrajati ) nirvāṇapurako prāpta hotā hai|
ṭīkā-yaha, karmaviyaktapanekī mukhyatāse prabhūtvaguṇakā vyākhyāna hai|
jaba yahī ātmā jinājñā dvārā mārgako prāpta karake, upaśāṃtakṣīṇamohapaneke kāraṇa ( darśanamohake upaśama, kṣaya athavā kṣayopaśamake kāraṇa ) jise viparīta abhiniveśa naṣṭa ho jānese samyagjñānajyoti pragaṭa huī hai aisā hotā huā, kartṛtva aura bhoktṛtvake adhikārako samāpta karake samyakapase pragaṭa prabhutvaśaktivāna hotā huā jñānakā hī anusaraṇa karanevāle mārgameṃ vicaratā hai ( ācaraṇa karatā hai ), taba vaha viśuddha ātmatattvako upalabdhirūpa apavarganagarako ( mokṣapurako ) prāpta karatā hai ||7||
saṃskṛta tātparyavṛtti gāthā 70 athātrāpi pūrvoktamapi prabhutvaṃ punarapi karmarahitatvamukhyatvena pratipādayati, uvasaṃtakhīṇamoho upaśāṃtīṇamoha; anopaśamaśabdenaupaśamikasamyaktvaṃ kṣīṇaśabdena kṣāyikasamyaktvaṃ dvābhyāṃ tu kṣāyopaśamikasamyaktvamiti grāhyaṃ | magga-bhedābhedaratnatrayātmakaṃ niścayavyavahāramokṣamārga, samuvagadosamupagataḥ prāpta:, kena? jiṇabhāsideṇa-vītarāgasarvajñabhāṣitena | ṇāṇaṃ-nirvikārasvasaṃvedanajñānaṃ abhedena tadādhāraṃ śuddhātmānaṃ bā, aṇu-anulakṣaṇīkṛtya samāśritya taṃ jñānaguṇamātmānaṃ vā |

viśeṣārtha- jaise suvarṇa apane śuddha solahavarṇapaneke guṇakī apekṣā sarva suvarṇa meṃ sādhāraṇa hai, isase suvarṇarāśi eka hai taise hī sarvajīvoṃmeṃ sādhāraṇa pāe jānevāle kevalajñāna ādi anaṃta guṇoṃke samūhakī apekṣā arthāt śuddha jīvajātipanekī apekṣā saṃgrahanayase eka rūpa hī yaha jīva dravya hai athavā sarva jīvoṃmeṃ kevaladarśana aura kevalajñānarūpa upayoga maujūda hai | isa sādhāraṇa lakṣaṇakī apekṣā jīvarāśi eka prakāra hai| yahā~ kisīne kahā ki jaise eka hī candramā bahutase jalake bhare hue ghaḍa़oṃ meṃ bhinna bhinna rūpa dikhalāī paḍa़tā hai taise eka hī jīva māno, jo bahutase śarīrameṃ bhinna-bhinna rūpase dikhalāī paḍatā hai| isa śaṃkākā samādhāna karate haiṃ ki bahutase jalake ghaḍoṃmeṃ candramākī kiraṇakī upādhike vaśase jalake pudgala hī candramāke ākārameṃ parigaṇata ho gae haiṃ, na ki ākāśameṃ sthita caṃdramā anekarūpa

hai tathāpi vyavahāranayase pṛthvī, jala, agni, vāyu, pratyeka vanaspati, sādhāraṇa vanaspati, dvīndriya, trīndriya, turindriya, paṃcendriyarūpa honese dasa sthānagata yā dasarūpa hai | athavā yadi ina pṛthvī ādike dasa sthānoṃko alaga-alaga le leveṃ aura uparyukta padakā pṛthak vyākhyāna karalene para usake bhī dasa sthāna hote haiṃ| una donoṃko milānese yahī jīva bīsa bhedarūpa ho jātā hai| yaha bhāvārtha hai ||71-72||
samaya vyākhyā gāthā 73
payaḍiṭṭhidi - aṇubhāga-ppadesa baṃdhehiṃ savvado mukko |
uḍḍuṃ gacchadi sesā vidisā - vajjaṃ gadiṃ jaṃti || 73 || prakṛtisthityanubhāgapradeśabaṃdhaiḥ sarvato muktaḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ gacchati śeṣā vidigvaja gatiṃ yāṃti || 73 ||
baddhajīvasya ṣaḍgatayaḥ karmanimittāḥ | muktasyāpyūrdhvagatirekā svābhāvikī - tyatroktam || 73 || || iti jīvadravyāstikāyavyākhyā samāptā ||

viśeṣārtha-mile hue samudāyako ghaṭa ghaṭa ādi akhaṃḍarūpa eka ko sakala kahate haiṃ, yaha anaṃta paramāṇuoṃkā eka piṃḍa hai isīko skaṃgha saṃjñā hai | yahā~ dṛṣṭāṃta kahate haiṃ ki jaise solaha paramāṇuoṃko piṃḍarūpa karake eka skaṃdha banā isameṃ eka eka paramāṇu ghaṭāte hue nava paramāṇuoṃke skaṃdha taka skaṃdhake bheda hoṃge arthāt nau paramāṇuoṃkā jaghanya skaṃdha, solaha paramāṇuoṃkā utkṛṣṭa skaṃtha śeṣa madhyake bheda jānane | āṭha paramāṇuoṃke piṃḍako skaṃghadeśa kaheṃge kyoṃki vaha solahase ādhā raha gayā| isameṃ bhī eka eka paramāṇu ghaṭāte hue pāṃca paramāṇuke skaṃdha taka skaṃthadeśake bheda hoṃge| unameṃ jaghanya skaṃdhadeśa pāṃca paramāṇuoṃkā tathā utkṛṣṭa āṭha paramāṇuoṃkā va madhyake aneka bheda haiṃ | cāra paramāṇuoṃke piṃḍako skaṃdhapradeśa saṃjñā kahī jātī hai| isameṃse bhī eka eka paramāṇu ghaṭāte hue do paramāṇuke skaṃdha taka pradeśake bheda haiṃ arthāt jaghanya skaṃdha pradeśa do paramāṇu skaṃdha hai, utkṛṣṭa cāra paramāṇukā skaṃdha hai, madhya tīna paramāṇukā skaṃdha hai-ye skaṃdhake bheda jānane | sabase choṭe vibhāga rahita pudgalako paramāṇu kahate haiṃ| paramāṇuoṃke paraspara milanese skaṃdha banate haiṃ | do paramāṇuoṃkā vyaguṇa skaṃdha hogā, tīna paramāṇuoṃke saṃghātase tryaṇuka skaṃdha hogā| isī taraha anantaparamāṇuoṃ takake skandha jānane cāhiye| isa taraha bheda aura saṃghāta tathā bhedasaṃghāta donoṃse ananta prakārake skaṃdha hojāte haiṃ arthāt paramāṇu yā skandhoṃke milanese skaṃdha banate haiṃ tathā baḍa़e skandhoṃke bhedase choṭe skaṃdha banate haiṃ tathā kucha paramāṇuoṃke nikala jānese va kucha ke milajāne se aise bhedasaṃghāta donoṃse skaṃdha banate haiṃ | ___ yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki grahaṇa karane yogya paramātmatasvase ye saba pudgala bhinna haiṃ yahī anubhava honā isa pudgalake jñānakā phala hai ||75|| skaṃdhānāṃ pudalavyavahārasamarthanametat | bādara-suhuma-gadāṇaṃ khaṃdhāṇaṃ puggalo tti vavahāro| te hoti chappayārā telokkaṃ jehiṃ ṇippaṇṇaṃ ||76||

anvayārtha ( bādarasaukṣmyagatānāṃ ) bādara ora sūkṣmarūpase pariṇata ( skandhānāṃ ) skandhoṃkā ( pudgalaḥ ) “pudgala" ( iti ) aisā ( vyavahāra: ) vyavahāra hai| ( te) ve ( ṣaṭprakārā: bhavanti ) chaha prakārake haiṃ, ( yaiḥ ) jinase [ trailokyaṃ ] tīna loka ( niṣpannaṃ ) niṣpanna haiṃ|
ṭīkā–skandhoṃmeṃ “pudgala' aisā jo vyavahāra hai usakā yaha samarthana hai|
(1) jinameṃ ṣaṭsthānapatita vṛddhihāni hotī hai aise sparśa-rasa-gaṃdha, varṇarūpa guṇāviśeṣoṃne kāraṇa ( paramāṇu ) pūraṇa-galana-dharmavāle honese tathā (2) skandhavyaktike ( skandhaparyāyake ) āvirbhāva aura tirobhāvakī apekṣāse bhī ( paramāṇuoṃme ) pūraṇa-galana ghaṭita honese paramāṇu pudgala haiṃ esā niścaya kiyā jātā hai | skandha to anekapudgalamaya ekaparyāyapaneke kāraṇa pudgaloṃse ananya honese pudgala haiṃ aisā vyavahāra kiyā jātā hai tathā ve] bādaratva aura sūkṣmatvarūpa pariṇāmoṃke bhedoṃ dvārā chaha prakāroṃko prāpta karake tīna lokarūpa hokara rahe haiṃ | ve chaha prakārake skandha isa prakāra hai-(1) bādarabādara, (2) bādara, (3) bādarasūkṣma, (4) sūkṣmabādara, (5) sūkṣma, (6) sūkṣmasūkṣma | vahā~, (1) kāṣṭhāpāṣāṇādika ( skandha ) jo ki chedana hone para svayaṃ nahīṃ juḍa़ sakate, bādarabādara haiṃ, (2) dūdha, ghī, tela, jala, rasa ādi ( skandha ), jo ki chedana hone para svayaṃ juḍa़ jāte haiṃ, bādara haiṃ (3) chāyā, dhūpa, aṃdhakāra, cāṃdanī ādi ( skandha ) sthūla hone para bhī jinakā chedana, bhedana athavā ( hastādi dvārā ) grahaṇa nahīṃ kiyā jā sakatā bādarasūkṣma haiṃ, (4) sparśa-rasa-gaṃdha-śabda, jo ki sūkṣma hone para bhī sthūla jñāta hote haiṃ, sūkṣmabādara haiṃ, (5) karmavargaṇādi ( skandha ) ki jinheṃ sūkṣmapanā hai tathā jo indriyoṃse jñāta na hoṃ aise haiṃ, ve sūkṣma haiṃ (6) karmavargaṇāse nīceke dviaṇuka-skandha takake ( skandha ) jo ki atyanta sūkṣma haiṃ ve sūkṣmasūkṣma haiṃ ||76||

221 kriyate na ca sattāpradeśabhedena | vastutastu ya eva paramāṇorādimadhyāṃtabhūtapradeśaḥ sa eva rūpādiguṇānāmapi athavā mūrta ityādiśyate kathyate na ca dṛṣṭyā dṛśyate tenādeśamātramūrtaḥ, dhāucaukkassa kāraṇaṃ jo duniścayena śuddhabuddhakasvabhāvairapi pṛthivyādijīvairvyavahāreṇānādikarmodayavaśena yāni pṛthivyaptejovāyudhātucatuṣkasaṃjñāni śarīrāṇi gṛhītāni tiṣṭhanti teṣāmanyeṣāṃ ca jīvenāgṛhītānāṃ hetutvena nimittatvāddhātucatuṣkasya kāraṇaṃ yastu 'so ṇeo paramāṇū' ya: pūrva kathita ekopi paramāṇuḥ pṛthivyādidhātucatuṣkarūpeṇa kālāṃtareṇa pariṇamati sa paramāṇuriti jñeyaḥ | pariṇāmaguṇo audayikādibhāvacatuṣṭayarahitvena pāriṇāmikaguṇa: | puna: kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ | sayamasaddo-ekapradeśatvena kṛtvānaṃtaparamāṇupiṃḍalakṣaṇena śabdaparyāyeṇa saha vilakṣaṇatvātsvayaṃ vyaktirūpeṇāśabda iti sūtrārtha: ||78|| evaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ pṛthivyādijātibhedanirākaraṇakathanena dvitīyagāthā gatā|

anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-( jo du) jo koī ( ādesamattamutto) mūrtika kahalātā hai hai va ( dhāducadukkassa kāraṇaṃ) cāra dhātuoṃkā kāraṇa hai ( pariṇāmaguṇo) pariṇamana honā jisakā svabhāva hai va jo (sayam ) svayaṃ ( asaho) śabdarahita hai ( so paramāṇu) so paramāṇu (ṇeo) jānanā cāhiye|
viśeṣārtha-paramāṇu meṃ varṇādi guṇa rahate haiṃ unakā bheda saṃjñā ādikī apekṣāse hī hai pradeśoṃkī apekṣā unakā bheda nahīṃ kiyā jā sakatā hai| ve varṇādi guṇa paramāṇumeṃ sarvāṃga vyāpaka haiṃ | vastusvarūpa yaha hai ki jo ādi, madhya, aṃta pradeśa paramāṇukā hai vahī usake bhītara vyāpta unake rūpādi guṇoṃkā hai athavā vaha paramāṇu mūrtika kahā jātā hai, dṛṣṭise nahīṃ dekhā jātā hai to bhī rūpādi kāraṇoṃse paramāṇu mūrtika hai | niścayanayase pṛthvī, apa, teja, vāyukāyika jīva śuddha buddha eka svabhāvadhārī hai parantu vyavahāranayase anādikarmoke udayake yaśase jo una jīvoṃne pṛthvī, jala, agni tathā vāyu nāmake śarīra grahaṇa kara rakkhe haiṃ una śarīroṃke tathā una jīvoṃse na grahaṇa kiye hue pṛthvī, jala, agni va vāyukāyake skaṃdhoṃke upādāna kāraṇa paramāṇu haiṃ isase ye paramāṇu cāra dhātuoṃke kāraṇa haiṃ| yaha paramāṇu jaḍa़ honese audayika, aupaśamika, kṣāyopaśamika kṣāyika ina cāra bhāvoṃse rahita kevala apane pāriṇāmikabhāvoṃko rakhanevālā honese pariṇamanaśīla haiṃ| eka hī paramāṇu kālāṃtarameṃ badalate badalate pṛthvī yā jala yā agni yā vāyu ho jātā hai | yaha paramāṇu eka pradeśī hotā hai isase yaha anaṃta paramāṇuoṃkā piṃḍa rūpa jo śabdaparyāya hai usase vilakṣaṇa hai | isaliye svayaṃ vyaktarūpase śabdarahita hai aisā paramāṇu jānanā cāhiye ||78||

(kisīse nahīṃ nivārā jā sakatā ) isaliye loka aura alokakā vibhāga siddha nahīṃ hogā kintu yadi jīva-pudgalakī gatike aura gatipūrvakasthitike bahiraṃga hetuoṃke rūpameṃ dharma aura adharmakā sadbhāva svīkāra kiyā jāye to loka aura aloka kā vibhāga ( siddha ) hotā hai| ( isaliye dharma aura adharma vidyamāna haiṃ|) dharma aura adharma donoṃ paraspara pṛthagbhūta astitvase niṣpanna honese vibhakta [bhinna ] haiṃ, ekakṣetrāvagāhī honese avibhakta ( abhinna ) haiṃ, samasta lokameṃ pravartamāna jīva-pudgaloṃko gati-sthitimeṃ niṣkriyarūpase anugraha karate haiṃ isaliye lokapramāṇa haiṃ ||87||
saṃ0 tā0-atha dharmādharmasadbhāve sādhye hetuṃ darśayati, jādo-jātaṃ | kiṃ kartṛ | alogalogo— lokālokadvayaṃ | kasmājjātaṃ | jesiṃ sambhāvado ya-yayordharmādharmayo: svabhāvataśca | na kevalaṃ lokālokadvayaṃ jātaṃ | gamaṇaṭhidī-gatisthitiścaitau dvau| kathaṃbhūtau | dovi ya mayā-dvau dharmādharmī matau saṃmatau sta: athavā pāṭhāṃtaraṃ "amayā" amayau na kenāpi kṛtau| vibhattā-vibhakto, avibhattā-avibhaktau, loyamettā ya-lokamātrau ceti | tadyathā-dharmādharmī vicaṃte lokālokasadbhāvāt ṣadravyasamūhātmako lokaḥ tasmādvahirbhūtaṃ śuddhamākāśamalokaḥ, tatra loke gatiṃ tatpūrvakasthitimāskaṃdato: svīkurvatorjīvapudgalayoryadi bahiraṃgahetubhūtadharmādharmoṃ na syātāṃ tadā lokādahibhūtabāhyabhāgepi gati: kena nāma niṣidhyate | na kenāpi tato lokālokavibhāgādeva jñāyate dharmādharmī vidyate | tau ca kiṃviśiṣṭau | bhitrāstitvaniṣpannatvātriścayanayena pṛthagbhūtau ekakṣetrābagāhatvādasadbhūtavyavahāranayena siddharāśivadabhinnau sarvadaiva ni:kriyatvena lokavyāpakatvāllokamātrāviti sūtrārthaḥ ||87||
hiṃdī tā0 -utthānikā-āge dharma aura adharmadravyakī sattāko siddha karaneke liye hetu dikhāte haiṃ
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-[ jesi ] jina dharma adharma dravyoṃkī [ sambhāvado ] sattā honese [alogalogo] aloka aura loka [jādo] hue haiṃ [ya] aura [gamaṇaṭhidī] jīva pugaloṃkī gamana aura sthiti hotī hai [ do vi ya] ve donoṃ hī dharma adharma [vibhattā] paraspara bhinna va [ avibhattā] eka jagaha rahanese abhinna [ya loyamettā] aura lokākāśa pramāṇa [matau ] māne gae haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-vṛttikārane "amayā" pāṭhāṃtara lekara yaha artha kiyā hai ki ye donoṃ hī kisī ke kiye nahīṃ hai akṛtrima haiṃ| jo chaḥ dravyoṃkā samūha hai use loka kahate haiṃ, usase bāhara jo śuddha ākāśa mātra hai usako aloka kahate haiṃ | isa loka aura alokakī sattā hai isīse dharma aura adharmakī sattā siddha hai| yadi isa lokameṃ jīva aura paraloke calane meṃ aura calate-calate ṭhahara jānemeṃ bāharī nimittakāraṇa dharma aura adharma dravya na hoveṃ so lokake bāharībhāgameṃ gamana

ko kauna niṣedha kara sakatā hai ? koī bhī rokanevālā na ho taba loka aura alokakā vibhāga hī na rahe, parantu jaba loka aura aloka haiṃ taba yaha jānā jātā hai ki avaśya dharma aura adharma dravya haiṃ | ina donoṃkī sattā bhinna bhinna hai, ye niścayase jude haiṃ| donoṃ eka kṣetrameṃ avagāha pā rahe haiṃ, isase asadbhūta vyavahāranayase jaise siddharāśi eka kṣetrameṃ rahanese abhinna hai vaise ye abhinna haiṃ| ye donoṃ sadā hī kriyārahita haiṃ tathā lokavyāpī honese lokamātra haiṃ - yaha sūtrakā artha hai ||87 ||
dharmādharmayorgatisthitihetutve'pyatyaṃtaudāsīnyākhyāpanametat |
ṇaya gacchadi dhammatthī gamaṇaṃ ṇa karedi aṇṇa-daviyassa |
havadi gadissa-ppasaro jīvāṇaṃ puggalāṇaṃ ca || 88 || na ca gacchati dharmāstiko gamanaṃ na karotyanyadravyasya |
bhavati gateḥ saḥ prasaro jīvānāṃ puhalānāṃ ca || 88 ||
yathā hi gatipariṇataḥ prabhañjano vaijayaṃtīnāṃ gatipariṇāmasya hetukartā'valokyate na tathā dharmaḥ | sa khalu niṣkriyatvāt na kadācidapi gatipariṇāmamevāpadyate | kuto'sya sahakāritvena pareṣāṃ gatipariṇāmasya hetukartṛtvam | kiṃtu salilamiva matsyānāṃ jīvapuṅgalānāmāśrayakāraṇamātratvenodāsīna evāsau gateḥ prasaro bhavati | api ca yathā gatipūrvasthitipariṇatasturaṃgo'śvavārasya sthitipariṇāmasya hetukartāvalokyate na tathā'dharmaḥ | sa khalu niṣkriyatvāt na kadācidapi gati pūrvasthitipariṇāmamevāpadyate | kuto'sya sahasthitipariṇāmasya hetukartṛtvam kiṃ tu pṛthivīvatturaṃgasya jīvapudgalānāmāśrayakāraṇamātratvenodāsīna evāsau gatipūrvasthite: prasaro bhavatīti || 88 ||
anvayārtha – ( dharmāstika: ) dharmāstikāya ( na gacchati ) gamana nahīṃ karatā (ca) aura ( anyadravyasya ) anya dravyako ( gamanaṃ na kārayati) gamana nahīṃ karātā, ( sa ) vaha ( jīvānāṃ pudgalānāṃ ) ( jīvoṃ tathā pudgaloṃko ) ( gate prasaraḥ ) gatikā prasāraka (bhavati) hotā hai | ṭīkā -- dharma aura adharma gati aura sthitike hetu hone para bhī ve atyanta udāsīna haiṃ aisā yahāṃ kathana hai |
jisa prakāra gatipariṇata pavana dhvajāoṃke gatipariṇāmakā hetukartā dikhāī detā hai, usa prakāra dharma nahīṃ hai | vaha ( dharma ) vāstavameṃ niṣkriya honese kabhī gati pariṇāmako hī prāpta nahīṃ hotā, to phira use sahakārīpane se parake gatipariṇāmakā hetukartṛtva kaise hogā ? ( nahīṃ ho sakatā | ) kintu jisa prakāra pānī machaliyoṃko (gatipariṇāmameṃ ) mātra āśrayarūpa kāraṇapanese

243 gatikā udāsīna hī prasāraka hai, usī prakāra dharma jīvapudgaloṃko ( gatipariṇāma meṃ ) mātra āśrayarūpa kāraṇapanese gatikā udāsīna hī prasāraka hai|
aura ( adharmāstikāyake sambandhameṃ bhī aisā hai ki ) jisa prakāra gatipūrvakasthitipariṇata aśva aśvasavārake ( patipūrvaka ) sthitipariṇāmakā hetukartā dikhāī detā hai, usa prakāra adharma nahīṃ hai | vaha (adharma ) vāstavameṃ niṣkriya honese kabhī gatipūrvaka sthitipariṇāmako hī prāpta nahīṃ hotā, to phira use sahasthāyīpanese parake gatipūrvaka sthitipariṇāmakā hetukartṛtva kahāṃse hogā ? ( nahīṃ ho sakatā ) kintu jisa prakāra pṛthvī aśvako ( gatipūrvaka sthitipariṇāmameṃ ) mātra āśrayarūpa kāraṇakī bhāṃti gatipūrvaka sthitikī udāsīna hī prasāraka hai, usī prakāra adharma jīva-punaloṃko pūrvaka pāsadhāraṇā meṃ , mātra āśrayarūpa kāraṇapanese gatipūrvaka sthitikā udāsīna hī prasāraka hai ||88||
saṃ0 tā0-atha dharmādharmī gatisthitihetutvaviṣaye'tyaṃtodāsīnāviti niścinoti, ṇa ya gacchadinaiva gacchati | sa kaḥ | dhammatthī-dharmāstikāyaḥ | gamaṇaṃ ṇa karedi aṇṇadaviyassa-gamanaṃ na karotyanyadravyasya, havadi-tathāpi bhavati | sa kaḥ | pasaro-prasaraḥ pravṛtti: | kasyāśca | gadissa ya-gateśca | keṣāṃ gateḥ | jīvāṇaṃ poggalāṇaṃ ca jīvānāṃ pudgalānāṃ ceti | tathāhi yathā turaṃgama: svayaṃ gacchan svakīyārohakasya gamanaheturbhavati na tathā dharmāstikāyaḥ ? kasmāt ? niṣkriyatvāt kiṃtu yathā jalaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatsatsvayaṃ gacchatāṃ matsyānāmaudāsīnyena gatenimittaṃ bhavati tathā dhopi svayaṃ tiṣṭhansan svakīyopādānakāraṇena gacchatāṃ jīvapudgalānāmaprerakatvena bahiraṃgagatinimittaṃ bhavati | yadyapi dharmāstikāya udāsīno jīvapudgalagativiṣaye tathāpi jīvapugalānāṃ svakīyopādānabalena jale matsyānāmiva gatiheturbhavati, adharmastu punaḥ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatsan svakīyopādānakāraṇena tiṣṭhatāṃ jīvapudgalānāṃ tiṣṭhatāmaśvādīnāṃ pṛthivīvatpathikānāṃ chāyāvadvā sthiterbahiraṃgaheturbhavatīti bhagavatāṃ śrīkundakundācāryadevānāmabhiprāya: ||88||
hiṃdī tā0-utthānikā-āge yaha niścaya karate haiṃ ki dharma aura adharma gati aura sthitike kāraṇa hote haiṃ tathāpi una kriyāoṃke prati svayaṃ atyaṃta udāsīna haiṃ preraka nahīṃ hai |
anyayasahita viśeṣārtha-(dhammatthī) dharmāstikāya ( ṇa ya gacchadi ) na to svayaṃ gamana karatā hai (ṇa aṇṇadaviyassa gamaṇaṃ karedi) na dūsare dravyoṃko gamana karātā hai to bhī (sa) vaha jīvāṇaṃ poggalāṇaṃ ca) jīvoṃkī aura puloṃkī (gatī) gatimeṃ (ppasaro) pravartaka yā nimitta hotā hai| .
viśeṣārtha-jaise ghoḍa़ā svayaṃ calatā huā apane ūpara caḍha़e hue savārake gamanakā kāraṇa hotā hai aisā dharmāstikāya nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki vaha kriyārahita hai, kiṃtu jaise jala svayaṃ ṭhaharā huā hai to bhī svayaṃ apanī icchāse calatī huī machaliyoṃke gamanameṃ udāsīnapanese nimitta ho

ṣaḍvya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana ātā hai, vaise dharma dravya bhī svayaṃ ṭhaharā huā apane hī upādāna kāraṇase calate hue jīva aura pudgaloṃko binā preraṇā kiye hue unake gamanameṃ bāharī nimitta ho jātā hai| yadyapi dharmāstikāya udāsīna hai to bhī jīva punaloṃkī gatimeṃ hetu hotā hai | jaise jala udāsīna hai to bhī yaha machaliyoṃke apane hī upādāna balase gamanameṃ sahakārī hotā hai| jaise svayaṃ ṭhaharate hue ghoḍa़oṃ ko pṛthvī va pathikoṃko chāyā sahāyaka hai vaise hī adharmāstikāya svayaṃ ṭhaharā huā hai to bhī apane upādāna kāraṇa se ṭhahare hue jīva aura mugaloṃkī sthitimeṃ bāharī kāraṇa hotā hai aisā bhagavān śrī kundakundācārya devakā abhiprāya hai ||88|| tharmādharmayoraudāsīnye hetūpanyāso'yam | vijjadi jesiṃ gamaṇaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ puṇa tesi-meva saṃbhavadi | te saga-pariṇāmehiṃ du gamaṇaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ ca kuvvaṃti || 89|| vidyate yeṣāṃ gamanaṃ sthānaṃ punasteṣāmeva saṃbhavati |
te svakapariṇāmaistu gamanaṃ sthānaṃ ca kurvanti || 89|| dharmaḥ kila na jīvapudgalānāṃ kadācitihetutvamabhyasyati, na kadācitsthitihetutvamadharmaḥ tau hi pareṣāṃ gatisthityodi mukhyahetū syātāṃ tadā yeṣāṃ gatisteṣāṃ gatireva na sthitiḥ, yeṣāṃ sthitisteṣāṃ sthitireva na gatiḥ | tata ekeṣāmapi gatisthitidarśanādanumīyate na tau tayormukhyahetū | kiṃtu vyavahāranayavyavasthāpitau udāsīnau | kathamevaṃ gatisthitimatāṃ padārthānāṃ gatisthitī bhavata iti cet, sarve hi gatisthitimaṃtaḥ padārthāḥ svapariṇāmaireva niścayena gatisthitī kurvatīti ||89||
iti dharmādharmadravyāstikāyavyākhyānaṃ samāptam | anvayārtha-( yeṣāṃ gamanaṃ vidyate ) jinake gati hotī hai ( teṣām eva puna: sthānaṃ saṃbhavati ) unhīṃke phira sthiti hotī hai [ aura jinheṃ sthiti hotī hai unhīṃko phira gati hotī hai | ] ( te tu ) ve ( gatisthitimāna padārtha ) to ( svakapariṇāmaiḥ ) apane pariṇāmoṃse ( gamanaṃ sthānaṃ ca ) gati aura sthiti ( kurvanti ) karate haiṃ|
ṭīkā—yaha, dharma aura adharmakī udāsīnatāke sambandhameṃ hetu kahā gayā hai|
vāstavameṃ dharma jīva-pudgaloṃko kabhī gatihetu nahīṃ hotā, adharma-kabhī sthitihetu nahīṃ hotā, kyoṃki ve parako gatisthitike yadi mukhya hetu (preraka hetu ) hoṃ, to jinheṃ gati ho unheṃ gati hī rahanā cāhiye, sthiti nahīṃ honā cāhiye, aura jinheṃ sthiti ho unheṃ sthiti hī rahanā cāhiye, gati nahīṃ honā cāhiye | kintu ekako hī ( usī eka padārtha ko ) gati aura sthiti

245 dekhanemeṃ ātī hai, isaliye anumāna ho sakatā hai ki ve [ dharma-adharma ] gati-sthitike mukhya hetu nahīṃ haiṃ, kintu vyavahāranayasthāpita ! byānahāranana nāga sthāpita-kathita ) udāsīna hetu
praśna-aisā ho to gatisthitimāna padārthoṃko gatisthiti kisa prakāra hotī hai ?
uttara-vāstavameṃ samasta gatisthitimāna padārtha apane pariṇāmoṃse hī niścayase gatisthiti karate haiṃ ||89||
isa prakāra dharmadravyāstikāya aura adharmadravyāstikāyakā vyākhyāna samāpta huā|
saṃ0 tā0-atha dharmādharmayorgatisthitihetutvodāsīnaviṣaye yuktimudyotayati,-vidyate yeṣāṃ gamanaṃ sthānaṃ punasteṣāmeva saṃbhavati te jīvapudgalā: svakapariṇāmaireva sthānaṃ gamanaṃ ca kurvatīti | tathāhi-~-dharmastāvatkvāpi kāle gatihetutvaṃ na tyajati na cādharmaḥ sthitihetutvaṃ, to yadi gatisthityormukhyahetū syātāṃ tadā gatisthitikāle parasparaṃ matsaro bhavati | kathamiti cet ? yeṣāṃ gatisteṣāṃ sarvadaiva gatireva na ca sthiti; yeṣāṃ punaḥ sthitisteṣāṃ sarvadaiva sthitireva na ca gatiḥ | na tathā dṛśyate | kiṃtu ye gatiṃ karvanti ta eva punarapi sthitiṃ kurvanti, ye sthitiṃ kurvanti ta eva punargatiṃ kurvanti | tato jñāyate na to dharmādharmī gatisthityormukhyahetū | yadi mukhyahetū na bhavetāṃ tarhi gatisthitimatāṃ jīvapudgalānāṃ kathaṃ gatisthitī iti cet ? te niścayena svakīyapariṇāmaireva gatiṃ sthitiṃ ca kurvatīti | atra sūtre nirvikāracidānaṃdaikasvabhāvādupādeyabhūtāt śuddhātmatattvādbhinnatvāddheyatattvamityabhiprāyaḥ ||89|| evaṃ dharmādharmobhayavyavasthāpanamukhyatvena tṛtīyasthale gāthātrayaṃ gataṃ |
iti gāthāsaptakaparyaṃtaṃ sthalatrayeṇa paṃcāstikāyaṣaḍdrvya pratipādakaprathamamahādhikāramadhye dharmādharmavyākhyānarūpeṇa ṣaṣṭhāṃtarādhikāraḥ samāptaḥ ||
hiṃdī tā0-utyānikā-āge phira prakaṭa karate haiṃ ki dharma aura atharma gati aura sthitike karanemeṃ bilakula udāsīna haiṃ
anvaya sahita sāmānyārtha-(jesiṃ) jina jīva aura pudgaloṃkā ( gamaṇaṃ ) gamana ( puṇa) tathā ( ṭhāṇaṃ) ṭhaharanā ( vijjadi) hotā hai ( tesimeva ) unhīṃkā gamana va ṭhaharāva ( saṃbhavadi) saṃbhava hai (te) ve jīva aura pudgala ( sagapariṇāmehiṃdu) apanī hī gamana aura sthitike pariṇamanakī śaktise ( gamaṇaṃ ṭhāṇaṃ ca ) gamana aura ṭhaharāva ( kuvvaṃti ) karate rahate haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-dharmadradhya kabhī apane ga़manahetupaneko choḍa़tā nahīṃ hai taise hī adharma kabhī sthiti hetupaneko choḍa़tā nahīṃ hai | yadi ye hī gamana aura sthiti karānemeṃ mukhya preraka kāraṇa ho jāveṃ to gati aura sthitimeṃ paraspara īrṣā ho jāve| jina dravyoṃkī gati ho ve sadā hī calate raheṃ aura jinakī sthiti ho ve sadā ṭhahare hī raheṃ unakī kabhī gati na ho| aisā nahīṃ

ṣadravya-paṃcāstikāyavarṇana dikhalāī paḍa़tā hai, kintu yaha dekhā jātā hai ki jo gamana karate hai ve hī ṭhaharate haiṃ yā jo ṭhahare hue haiṃ ve hī gamana karate haiṃ | isīse siddha hai ki ye dharma aura adharma mukhya hetu nahīṃ haiṃ| yadi ve mukhya hetu nahīṃ haiṃ to jīva aura pugaloṃkī kaise gati aura sthiti hotī hai | isaliye kahate haiṃ ki ve niścayase apanī hī pariṇamana śaktiyoṃse gati yā sthiti karate haiṃ| yahā~ yaha abhiprāya hai ki nirvikāra cidānaṃdamaya eka svabhāva jo paramātmatattva hai vahī upādeya hai, usa śuddhātmatattvase bhinna ye dharma adharmadravya haiṃ isaliye ye heyatattva haiṃ || 89||
isa taraha dharma adharma dravya dānīko sthāpanāko mukhyatāse tīsare sthalameṃ gāthā tīna kahīṃ| aise sāta gāthāoṃmeṃ tīna sthaloṃke dvārā paṃcāstikāya chaḥ dravyake pratipādaka prathama mahā adhikārake madhyameṃ dharma adharmakā vyākhyānarūpa chaṭhā aṃtara adhikāra pūrṇa huā|
ākāśadravyāstikāyasvarūpākhyānametatsavvesiṃ jīvāṇaṃ sesāṇaṃ taha ya puggalāṇaṃ ca | jaṃ dedi vivara-makhilaṃ taṃ loe havadi āyāsaṃ ||9|| sarveṣāṃ jīvānāṃ śeṣāṇāṃ tathaiva pulānāṃ ca |
yaddadāti vivaramakhilaṃ talloke bhavatyākāśaṃ ||90|| ṣadravyātmake loke sarveṣāṃ śeṣadravyāṇāṃ yatsamastāvakāśanimittaṃ viśuddha kṣetrarūpaṃ tadākāśamiti ||9||
aba ākāśadravyāstikāyakā vyākhyāna hai|
anvayārtha ( loke ) lokameṃ ( jīvānām ) jīvoṃko ( ca ) aura [ pudgalānām ] pudgaloko ( tathā eva ) vaise hī ( sarveṣām śeṣāṇām ) śeṣa samasta dravyoṃko ( yad ) jo ( akhilaṃ vivaraṃ ) sampūrṇa avakāśa ( dadāti ) detā hai, ( tad ) vaha [ ākāśam bhavati ] ākāśa hai |
ṭīkā-yaha, ākāśake svarūpakā kathana haiṃ| ___ghaṭadravyātmaka lokameṃ śeṣa sabhī dravyoṃko paripūrṇa avakāśakā nimitta hai, vaha ākāśa haijo ki [ ākāśa ] viśaddhakṣetrarūpa hai ||10|| ___ saṃ0 tātparyavṛttiḥ– athānaṃtaraṃ śuddhabuddhakasvabhāvātriścayamokṣakāraṇabhūtātsarvaprakāropādeyarūpāt śuddhajīvāstikāyātsakāśāndrinna ākāśāstikāyaḥ saptagāthāparyaṃtaṃ kathyate | tatra gāthāsaptakamadhye prathamatastāvallokālokākāśadvayasvarūpakathanamukhyatvena “savvesiṃ jīvāṇaṃ'' ityādi gāthādyaṃ, atha ākāśameva gatisthitidvayaṃ kariṣyati dharmādharmābhyāṃ kiṃ prayojanamiti pūrvapakṣaniṃgakaraṇamukhyatvana "āgāsaṃ avagāse'' ityādi pāṭhakrameṇa gāthācatuṣṭayaṃ, tadanaṃtaraṃ dharmādharmalokākāśānāmekakṣetrāva.

anvayārtha --- ( saha jīvāḥ pudgalakāyāḥ ) bāhyakaraṇa sahita sthita jīva aura pudgala (sakriyāḥ bhavanti ) sakriya haiṃ, ( na ca śeṣāḥ) śeṣa dravya sakriya nahīṃ haiṃ, ( jīvāḥ ) jīva (pudgalakaraṇā: ) pudralakaraṇavāle ( jinheṃ sakriyapanemeṃ pudgala bahiraṃga sādhana ho aise ) haiṃ ( skandhāḥ khalu kālakaraṇā: tu ) aura skandha arthāt pudgala to kālakaraṇavāle ( jinheṃ sakriyapanemeṃ kāla bahiraṃga sādhana ho aise ) haiṃ |

pradeśāntaraprāptikā hetu aisī jo parispandarūpa paryāya, vaha kriyā hai | vahā~ bahiraṃga sādhanake sātha rahanevāle jīva sakriya haiṃ, (bahiraṃga sādhanake sātha rahanevāle pudgala sakriya haiṃ ) ākāśa niṣkriya hai, dharma niṣkriya hai, adharma niṣkriya hai, kāla niṣkriya hai|

paṃcāstikāya prāmṛta haiṃ| usake abhāvake kāraṇa siddhoṃko niṣkriyapanā hai| pudgaloṃko sakriyapanekā bahiraṃga sādhana pariṇāmaniṣpādaka kāla hai, isaliye pudgala kālakaraṇavāle haiṃ|
karmādikakī bhāṃti kālakā abhāva nahīṃ hotā, isaliye siddhoṃkī bhāṃti pudgaloṃko niṣkriyapanā nahīṃ hotā ||98||
saṃtā0-atha dravyāṇāṃ sakriyaniṣkriyatvaṃ kathayati, jīvāḥ pudgalakāyā saha sakiriyā havaṃti-sakriyā bhavaṃti | kathaṃ | saha | saha korthaḥ | bahiraṃgasahakārikāraṇaiḥ sahitāḥ | ṇa ya sesāna ca jīvapudgalābhyāṃ śeṣadravayāṇi sakriyāṇi | jīvānāṃ sakriyatve bahiraṃganimittaṃ kathyate | poggalakaraṇā jīvā—manovacanakāyavyāpārarūpakriyāpariṇataini:kriyanirvikāraśuddhātmānubhūtibhāvanācyutai vaiye samupārjitā: karmanokarmapudgalāsta eva karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ yeṣāṃ te jīvāḥ pudgalakāraṇā bhayaṃte | khaṃdā-skaṃdhā skaṃdhaśabdenātra skaṃdhāṇubhedabhitrā dvidhā pudgalā gṛhyante | te ca kathaṃbhūtā: ? sakriyā: | kai:kṛtvā ? kālakaraṇehi-pariṇāmanivartakakālāṇudravyaiḥ khalu sphuṭaṃ | atra yathā śuddhātmānubhūtibalena karmakṣaye jāte karmanokarmapudgalānāmabhāvātsiddhānāṃ ni:kriyatvaṃ bhavati, na tathā pudgalānāṃ | kasmāt ? kālasya sarvadaiva varṇavatyā mūrtyā rahitatvādamūrtasya vidyamānatvaditi bhāvārtha: ||98|| evaṃ sakriyaniṣkriyatvamukhyatvena gāthā gatā|
hiṃdī tā0-utthānikā-āge dravyoṃ meṃ kriyāvānapanā aura niḥkriyāpanā batāte haiṃ
anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-( jīvā ) jīva aura ( poggalakāyā) pudalakāya ye do dravya (saha) bāharī kāraṇoṃke honepara ( sakkiriyā) kriyā sahita ( havaṃti) hote haiṃ ( sesā) śeṣa cāra dravya (ṇa ya) kriyāvāna nahīṃ hai | ( jīvā) jīva ( puggalakaraṇā) pugaloṃkī sahāyatāse aura ( khaṃdhā) pudgaloṃke skandha ( khalu ) vāstavameṃ ( kālakaraṇā du) kāladravyake kāraṇase kriyāvāna hote haiṃ|
viśeṣārtha-jīvoṃne kriyā rahita nirvikāra śuddhātmāke anubhavakī bhāvanāse girakara apane mana, vacana, kāyakī halanacalana kriyākī pariṇatiyoṃse jo dravyakarma yā nokarma pudgala ekatra kiye haiṃ ve hī jīvoṃkī kriyā kāraṇa haiṃ tathā puraloṃke skandha aura paramāṇu ina do prakārake pudraloke pariṇamana honemeṃ bāharī kāraṇa kālāṇurūpa dravya haiṃ, unake nimittase ye kriyāvāna hote haiṃ| yahā~ yaha tātparya hai ki jīva jo śuddhātmānubhavakī bhāvanāke balase karmokā kṣayakara tathā sarva dravyakarma aura nokarma pudaloṃkā abhāva karake siddha ho jāte haiṃ
aura taba ve kriyārahita hojāte haiṃ aisā pugaloṃmeṃ nahīṃ hotā hai, kyoṃki kāla jo varṇādise rahita amūrtika hai so sadā hī vidyamāna rahatā hai | unake nimittase pudgala yathāsambhava kriyā karate rahate haiṃ ||98 ||
isa taraha sakriya niḥkriyapanekī mukhyatāse gāthā samāpta huī|

1
iha hi jīvaiḥ sparśanarasanāghrāṇacakṣubhirindriyaistadviṣayabhūtāḥ sparśarasagaṃdhavarṇasvabhāvā arthā gṛhyante | śrotrendriyeṇa tu ta eva tadviṣayahetubhūtaśabdākārapariṇatā gṛhyante | te kadācitsthūlaskaṃdhatvamāpannāḥ kadācitsūkṣmatvamāpannāḥ kadācit paramāṇutvamāpannāḥ indriyagrahaṇayogyatāsadbhāvād gṛhyamāṇā agṛhyamāṇā vā mūrtā ityucyate | śeṣamitarat samastamapyarthajātaṃ sparśarasagaṃdhavarṇābhāvasvabhāvamindriyagrahaṇayogyatāyā abhāvādamūrtamityucyate | cittagrahaṇayogyatāsadbhāva bhāgbhavati tadubhayamapi, cittaṃ hyaniyataviṣayamaprāpyakāri matiśrutajñānasādhanībhūtaṃ mūrtamamūrta ca samādadātīti || 99 ||
- iti sūlikā mamatā |
anvayārtha - ( ye khula) jo padārtha ( jīvaiḥ indriyagrāhyāḥ viṣayāḥ ) jīvoṃke indriyagrāhya viṣaya haiṃ ( te mūrtāḥ bhavanti ) ve mūrta haiṃ aura [ śeṣa ] śeṣa padārthasamūha ( amūrta bhavati ) amūrta hai | (cittam ) citta ( mana ) (ubhayaṃ ) una donoṃko [ mūrta amūrta ko ] ( samādadāti ) grahaṇa karatā hai (jānatā hai ) |
ṭīkā- yaha, mūrta aura amūrtake lakṣaṇakā kathana hai |
isa lokameṃ jīvoṃ dvārā sparśanendriya, rasanendriya, ghrāṇendriya aura cakṣurindriya dvārā unake viṣayabhūta sparśa rasa gaṃdha varṇasvabhāvavāle padārtha grahaṇa hote haiṃ aura śrotrendriya dvārā vahī padārtha usake ( śrotrendriyake ) viṣayahetubhūta śabdākāra pariṇamita hue grahaṇa hote haiṃ | (ve padārtha ), kadācit sthūla skandhapaneko prāpta hote hue, kadācit sūkṣmatvako prāpta hue aura kadācit paramāṇupako prāpta hote hue indriyoṃ dvārā grahaṇa hote hoṃ yā na hoṃ, indriyoṃ dvārā grahaṇa hone kī yogyatākā ( sadaiva ) sadbhāva honese mūrta kahalāte haiṃ |
sparśa-rasa-gaṃdha-varṇakā abhāva jisakā svabhāva hai aisā śeṣa anya samasta padārthasamūha indriyoṃ dvārā grahaṇa honekī yogyatāke abhāvake kāraṇa 'amūrta' kahalātā hai |
ve donoṃ (pūrvokta donoṃ prakārake arthāt mūrta amūrta padārtha ) citta ( mana ) dvārā grahaṇa honekī yogyatāke sadbhāvavāle haiṃ, citta-jo ki aniyata viṣayavālā, aprāpyakārī aura matiśrutajñānako sādhanabhūta hai vaha mūrta tathā amūrtako grahaṇa karatā hai ( jānatā hai ) ||99|| isa prakāra cūlikā samāpta huī |

261 saṃ0 tā0-atha punarapi prakārāṃtareṇa mūrtāmūrtasvarūpaṃ kathayati, je khalu indiyagejjhā visayāye khalu indriyaiḥ karaṇabhūtaihyā viṣayāḥ karmatāpatrāḥ | kai: kartṛbhūtaiḥ | jīvehiṃ—viṣayasukhānaṃdarataiīrāganirvikalpanijānaṃdaikalakṣaṇasukhāmṛtarasāsvādacyutairbahirmukhajīvai:, hoti te muttā-bhavanti te mūrtāḥ viṣayātītasvābhāvikamukhasvabhāvātmatattvaviparītaviṣayāste ca sūkṣmatvena kecana yadyapīndriyaviṣayāḥ vartamānakāle na bhavanti tathāpi kālāṃtare bhaviṣyaṃtītīndriyagrahaṇayogyātāsadbhāvādindriyagrahaṇayogyā bhaṇyate | sesaṃ havadi amuttaṃ-amūrtātīndriyajñānasukhādiguṇādhāraṃ yadātpadravyaṃ tatprabhṛti paṃcadravyarūpaṃ pudgalādanyat yaccheṣaṃ tadbhavatyamūrta | cittaṃ ubhayaṃ samādiyadi-cittamabhayaṃ samādadāti| cittaṃ hi matiśrutajñānayorupādānakāraṇabhūtamaniyataviṣayaṃ ca taccā śrutajñānasvasaṃvedanajñānarūpeṇa yadātmagrāhakaṃ bhāvaśrutaṃ tatpratyakṣaṃ yatpunādaśāṃgacaturdaśapūrvarūpaparamāgamasaṃjña tacca mūrtāmūbhiyaparicchittiviṣaye vyāptijñānarūpeṇa parokṣamapi kevalajñānasadṛśamityabhiprāyaḥ | tathā coktaṃ- "sudakevalaṃ ca ṇāṇaṃ doṣiṇavi sarisāṇi hoti bohādo| sudaṇāṇaṃ ca parokkhaṃ paccakkhaṃ kevalaṃ ṇāṇaṃ' ||99|| evaṃ prakārāṃtareṇa mūrtāmūrtasvarūpakathanagāthā gatā | ___ hiṃdī tā0 - utthānikā-āge phira bhī anya prakārase mūrta aura amūrtakā svarūpa kahate haiṃ___ anvayasahita sāmānyārtha-(jīvahiṃ) jīvoṃke dvārā ( khalu) niścaya karake ( je viṣayā) jo jo padārtha ( iṃdiyagejjhā) iṃdriyoṃkī sahāyatāse grahaṇayogya ( hu~ti) hote haiṃ ( te muttā) ve mūrtika haiṃ| (sesa) śeṣa sarva jīvādi pāṃca dravya ( amuttaṃ) mūrtika (havādi) hote haiṃ| (cittaṃ ) mana ( ubhayaṃ) mūrtika amūrtīka donoṃko ( samādiyadi ) grahaṇa karatā hai|
viśeṣārtha-jo jīva viṣayasukhake ānaṃdameṃ rata haiṃ tathā vītarāga nirvikalpa ātmānandamayī sukhāmṛtarasake āsvādase bāhara haiṃ ve jina indriya viṣayoṃko grahaṇa karate haiṃ ve mūrtika haiṃ | ve indriyoṃke viṣaya, viṣayoṃse rahita svābhāvika sukha svabhāvadhārī ātmatattvase viparīta haiṃ| ina pudgala mūrtika dravyoṃmeṃ koī aise sūkṣma hote haiṃ jo vartamānakālameṃ indriyoṃke dvārā grahaṇameṃ nahīṃ āte haiṃ tathāpi kālāṃtarameṃ jaba ve iṃdriyoṃke dvārā grahaṇa kiye jāne lāyaka yogyatāko prāpta kara leṃge taba ve indriyoṃse grahaṇa yogya ho jāyeṃge| amūrtika atīndriya jñāna aura sukhādi guṇoṃkā ādhāra jo ātmadravya hai usako lekara pulake sivāya jo pāṃca dravya haiṃ ve amūrtika haiṃ| citta mūrta amūrta donoṃko grahaṇa karatā hai|
yaha citta matijñāna aura śrutajñāna upādāna kāraṇa hai| isakā viṣaya niyata nahīṃ hai| unameṃse jo bhāvanuta svasaṃvedanajñāna rūpase ātmāko grahaṇa karanevālā hai vaha pratyakṣa hai tathā jo śrutajñāna bāraha, aṃga-caudaha pūrvarūpa paramāgama nāmase hai vaha mūrtika amūrtika donoṃko ānaneko samartha . hai | yaha jñāna vyāpti-jñānakī apekṣāse parokṣa hai, tobhī kevalajñānake samāna hai| jaisā kahā hai
